Yeesiga bazadde be, abamulabirira, n’abasomesa be. Ayinza n’okwesiga abantu abamu abatasaanira, olw’obwesige bwe obw’obuzaaliranwa. Era okwesiga kwe kuddibwamu n’omutima omugabi. Teyeetegekera kintu kyonna, naye afuna buli kintu. Tategeka bya nkya. Naye, obulamu bwe butegekebwa. Amakubo ge gamugguka nga bw’agatuukako, essaawa ku ssaawa, olunaku ku lunaku. Ayingira era afuluma mu nnyumba ya kitaawe nga talina ky’atya era mu ddembe.

Anyumirwa obugagga bwayo, nga talina ky’asasudde okubufuna.

Kawumpuli ayinza okutambula mu nguudo z’ekibuga kye, naye ye tafaayo. Enjala, omuliro, n’entalo biyinza okumwetooloola. Naye, mu kulabirira kwa kitaawe, awummula mu mirembe egituukiridde. Abeera mu kiseera kino, ng’akkiriza obulamu nga bwe bujja. Lumu nnakyalira ennyumba y’abagagga eyalimu omwana omu yekka gwe baali bafudde owaabwe. Yafunanga okwagala kwonna n’okulabirirwa emitima gy’abantu n’obugagga bwe byali biyinza okuwa. Bwe nnali ndaba omwana oyo ng’adduka ng’ayingira era ng’afuluma, olunaku ku lunaku, ne ndaba ekifaananyi ky’embeera yaffe ey’ekitalo ng’abaana mu nnyumba ya Kitaffe. Omwana oyo yali wa ddembe era nga talina kimuzitoowerera mu mutima, ng’alina obutafaayo obw’essanyu obw’obuto.

Ne ndowooza nti, “Singa waliwo ekintu kyonna ekyandinakuwazizza abaagalwa be, kyandibadde kulaba omwana ono ng’yeeraliikirira ku bubwe.”

Omutima gwa Katonda waffe ogw’okwagala teguyinza kusingawo nnyo okunakuwala olw’okweraliikirira kw’abaana be? Ne ntegeera ensonga lwaki Mukama waffe yakkaatiriza nti, “Temweraliikiriranga.” Ani asinga okulabirirwa obulungi mu buli maka?

Si baana abato? Era asinga obuto ku bonna, omwana omuwere atalina ky’ayinza, si y’afuna omugabo ogusinga obunene? Omuwandiisi omu eyafa gye buvuddeko yagamba nti omwana omuwere “tafuba, so talanga; naye omuntu amuliisa, amwambaza, amwagala, era amusanyukira.” Tewali n’omu amusanyukira okusinga bw’asanyuka ye.

Obulamu buno obw’okukkiriza, kale, bwe mpandiikako, buli mu kino: okuba omwana mu nnyumba ya Kitaffe.

Omuntu bw’ayogera kino, aba ayogedde ekimala. Kisobola okukyusa buli bulamu obukooye era obuzitoowereddwa ne bufuuka obw’omukisa n’okuwummula.

Obwesige obutaliimu kweraliikirira obw’abaana bammwe abato bubayigirize engeri y’okubeera ne Katonda. Bubasanyusa era buwamba emitima gyammwe. Mwerekere mu mikono gye. “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.”

Abafiripi 4:6-7 Mwetegereze ebigambo ‘kintu na kimu’ mu kitundu ekyo waggulu. Bizingiramu buli nsonga yonna eyinza okuleeta okweraliikirira, ey’omunda n’ey’ebweru. Tutera okuwulira nga tunyigirizibwa okukkiriza nti obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe kwe kweraliikirira ku nsonga ezimu.

Tujja kulowooza nti, “kituufu okulekera awo okweraliikirira kwonna. Mu nsonga ez’omwoyo, okweraliikirira kubi. Naye tulina okweraliikirira ku bintu ebimu. Kyandibadde kibi obutakola bwe tutyo. Tulina okweraliikirira abaana baffe, abo be twagala, ekkanisa yaffe, amazima, ne bizinensi yaffe.” Kyandiraze obutaba na nneewulira ntuufu n’akatono singa tetweraliikirira bintu nga bino.” Oba, tuyinza okulowooza nti, “Weewaawo, kituufu okwesiga Mukama n’abaagalwa baffe n’ensonga zaffe. Naye tusaanidde okweraliikirira obulamu bwaffe obw’omunda, okukkiriza kwaffe, okukemebwa kwaffe, n’ebibi byaffe. Bwe tutaakole bwe tutyo, bijja kulagajjalirwa.”

Eky’okuddamu ku birowoozo ng’ebyo, n’ebirala byonna ebifaanana bwe bityo, tukisanga mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe: “Noolwekyo mbagamba nti, Temweraliikiriranga bya bulamu bwammwe, bye munaalya oba bye munaanywa, wadde ebyokwambala. Kubanga obulamu businga ebyokulya, n’omubiri gusinga ebyambalo.

Mulabire ku nnyonyi ez’omu bbanga! Tezisiga so tezikungula so tezikuŋŋaanyiza mmere mu tterekero, naye Kitammwe ali mu ggulu aziriisa. Naye mmwe temusinga nnyo ennyonyi ezo? Ani ku mmwe, bwe yeeraliikirira, ayinza okwongerayo obulamu bwe akatundu n’akamu? Naye lwaki mweraliikirira ebyokwambala? Mulabire ku malanga ag’oku ttale! Tegaliiko kye geekolera, naye ne Kabaka Sulemaani mu kitiibwa kye kyonna teyagenkana mu kwambala. Naye obanga Katonda ayambaza obulungi bw’atyo omuddo ogw’omu nsiko ogw’ekiseera obuseera, ogubaawo leero ate enkeera ne gwokebwa mu kyoto, talisingawo nnyo okubambaza? Nga mulina okukkiriza okutono! Noolwekyo temweraliikiririranga nga mugamba nti, ‘Tunaalya ki? Oba nti, Tunaanywa ki? Oba nti, Tunaayambala ki?’’ (Matayo 6:25-31) “Ebyo byonna bannamawanga bye bayaayaanira. Naye Kitammwe ali mu ggulu amanyi ng’ebyo byonna mubyetaaga.

Naye musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako.

“Noolwekyo temweraliikiriranga bya nkya. Kubanga olunaku olw’enkya lulyeraliikirira ebyalwo. Buli lunaku lulina emitawaana gyalwo egimala.” Mu Matayo 6:32-34, Mukama waffe ayolesa obulamu buno obutaliimu kweraliikirira, bw’atugamba okulabira ku nnyonyi ez’omu bbanga n’amalanga ag’oku ttale, ng’ebyokulabirako by’obulamu bw’ayagala tubeemu. Tulina, awatali kweraliikirira oba kutya, okuba ng’ennyonyi n’amalanga. Ennyonyi zisanyukira okulabirirwa kwa Katonda ne zifuna emmere. Amalanga gakula mu musana gwe. Enkazaluggya zitwogereze: “Nze ndi nkazaluggya entono, ennyonyi etali ya kitiibwa. Obulamu bwange tebulina muwendo munene, naye Mukama omwagalwa andabirira. Sirina ggwanika wadde tterekero. Sisiga so sikungula. Ampa omugabo gw’enkazaluggya, naye tampa nsigo n’emu ya kutereka. “Mmanyi nti waliwo enkazaluggya nnyingi. Abantu baziraba mu nsi yonna. Naye Kitaffe ali mu ggulu amanyi omu ku ffe bw’agwa wansi. “Newaakubadde tuli batono, tetwerabirwa. Newaakubadde tuli banafu, tetutya. Kubanga tumanyi nti Mukama omwagalwa akuuma obulamu bw’ebitonde bye yatonda. “Mbuuka waggulu w’emiti egisinga okukwatagana ne ntuula ku matabi mangi.” Sirina maapu wadde kampasi, naye sibula kkubo.”

Nfunya ebiwaawaatiro byange akawungeezi, yonna gye mba. Kitaffe bulijjo antunuulidde. Tewali kabi kalintuukako. Ndi nkazaluggya entono bwentono, ennyonyi etali ya kitiibwa. Naye mmanyi nti Kitaffe anjagala. Mmwe mulina okukkiriza okutono okusinga ffe?”
fields.body_text: Mu ssuula yange ewedde, nagezaako okugonjoola ekibuuzo ky’obanga Obulamu bw’Omukristaayo Obwawaggulu buli mu Byawandiikibwa. Engeri gye nsinga okubunnyonnyolamu bwe “bulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda.” Kale kaakano ekibuuzo ekyo nkitwala nga kigonjoddwa. Ebyawandiikibwa bisuubiza abakkiriza ba Yesu obulamu obw’okuwummula okutuukiridde. Bujja kuba buwanguzi obutakoma, obusukka obumanyirivu bw’Abakristaayo obwa bulijjo. Bitulaga Omulokozi ayinza okutulokola okuva mu maanyi g’ebibi byaffe, nga bw’atulokola okuva mu musango gwabyo. Ekiddako kye tulina okulowoozaako kye kino: obulamu buno obukwekeddwa kye ki? Bwawukana butya ku bumanyirivu obulala obw’Ekikristaayo? Kitegeeza okuleka Mukama okuddukanya ensonga zaffe n’okwetikka emigugu gyaffe, mu kifo ky’okugezaako okukola byonna ffekka. Abakristaayo abasinga bali ng’omusajja eyali atambula mu kkubo ng’akaluubirizibwa, nga yeetisse omugugu omuzito. Eggaali ne limutuukako, era omuvuzi waalyo n’amusaba mu kisa okumuyamba. N’akkiriza ekyo n’essanyu lingi. Naye bwe yamala okutuula, omugugu gwe ne gukyamunyigiriza. Yali akyagwetisse ku bibegabega bye. Omuvuzi ow’omutima omulungi n’amubuuza nti, “Lwaki tossa wansi omugugu gwo?” Omusajja n’addamu nti, “Oh! Mpulira nga kumpi kisukkiridde okukusaba okunneetikka nze, era siyinza na kulowooza ku kukuleka okwetikka n’omugugu gwange.” Abakristaayo abeekwasizza Mukama Yesu bakyetikka emigugu gyabwe. Batera okukoowa n’okuzitoowererwa mu lugendo lwabwe. Bwe njogera ku “migugu,” ntegeeza buli kintu ekitweraliikiriza, k’abe nga kya mwoyo oba kya bulamu buno. Ntegeeza, okusooka byonna, ffe ffennyini. Omugugu ogusinga obuzito gwe tulina okwetikka mu bulamu, ffe ffennyini. Ekintu ekisinga obuzibu okuddukanya, ffe ffennyini. Obulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku, enneewulira zaffe, n’obunafu bwaffe obw’enjawulo n’okwegomba kwaffe, bye bisinga okutweraliikiriza. Bitera okututwala mu buddu ne mu kizikiza. Kale, bw’oba ossa wansi emigugu gyo, ogusooka gw’olina okwegyako gwe ggwe wennyini. Olina okuwaayo eri Katonda omuntu wo ow’omunda. Kino kizingiramu okukemebwa kwo, embeera yo ey’obuzaaliranwa, n’enneewulira zo. Oluvannyuma, bireke awo gy’ali. Ye yakutonda, kale akutegeera era amanyi engeri y’okukuddukanyaamu, era olina okumwesiga okukikola. Mugambe nti, “Laba, Mukama, nneewaayo gy’oli. Ngezezzaako mu buli ngeri gye nnali nsobola okulowoozaako okwefuga n’okwefuula kye mmanyi nti nsaanidde okuba, naye bulijjo nnemeddwa. Kaakano mbikuwadde. Nkwegayiridde, nfuga ddala nze nzenna. Kola mu nze byonna by’osiima ng’okwagala kwo bwe kuli. Mbumba era onfuule ekibya ekikusanyusa. Nneerekera mu mikono gyo. Nzikiriza nti, nga bwe wasuubiza, ojja kunfuula ekibya eky’ekitiibwa kyo. “atukuziddwa, asaanira okukozesebwa mukama we, olw’omulimu omulungi.” Kaakano, olina okuwummula, ng’omwesiga ddala. Ekiddako, olina okussa wansi buli mugugu omulala. Obulamu bwo obw’omubiri, erinnya lyo, omulimu gwo ogw’Ekikristaayo, ennyumba zo, abaana bo, bizinensi yo, n’abaweereza bo. Buli kintu ekikukwatako, eky’omunda oba eky’ebweru. Abakristaayo bulijjo bakwasa Mukama emmeeme zaabwe olw’emirembe n’emirembe. Bamanyi, awatali kubuusabuusa, nti tebasobola kwekuuma. Naye ebintu by’obulamu buno babyekuumira bokka. Bagezaako okubyetikka nga balina enneewulira gye batayatula: nti kisukkiridde okusaba Mukama okubasitula bo, era tebasobola kulowooza ku kumusaba okwetikka n’emigugu gyabwe. Nnamanya omukyala Omukristaayo eyalina omugugu omuzito ennyo ogw’obulamu buno. Gwamumalako otulo n’okwagala emmere, era waaliwo akabi nti obulamu bwe bwandiwedde amaanyi olw’ogwo. Lumu, gwali gumuzitoowerera nnyo okusinga bulijjo. N’alaba akatabo akatono akayitibwa “Okukkiriza kwa Hannah” ku mmeeza okumpi naye.” Bwe yasikirizibwa omutwe gwako, n’akakwata n’atandika okusoma. Teyamanya nti kaali kagenda kukyusa ddala obumanyirivu bwe bwonna. Olugero lwali lukwata ku mukyala omwavu eyali ayise mu nnaku nnyingi. Lumu, yanyumiza omugenyi ow’ekisa ebyafaayo by’obulamu bwe. Ku nkomerero, omugenyi n’agamba nti, “O, Hannah, siraba ngeri gye wasobola okugumira ennaku ennene bw’etyo!” “Saagyetikka nze,” bwe yaddamu amangu. “Mukama ye yagyetikka ku lwange.” “Weewaawo,” omugenyi bwe yagamba. “Eyo y’engeri entuufu.” “Olina okutwala ebizibu byo eri Mukama.” “Weewaawo,” Hannah bwe yaddamu. “Naye tulina okukola n’okusingawo; tulina okubirekayo gy’ali. Abantu abasinga,” bwe yeeyongera, “batwala emigugu gyabwe gy’ali, naye ne bagikomyawo. Babeera beeraliikirivu era nga tebalina ssanyu nga bulijjo.” Naye nze ngitwala, ne ngirekera gy’ali, ne nzirayo ne ngyerabira. Era okweraliikirira bwe kukomawo, nzeeyongera okukutwala gy’ali. Nkola bwe ntyo enfunda n’enfunda, okutuusa lwe nneerabira okweraliikirira kwange ne mbeera mu kuwummula okutuukiridde.” Mukwano gwange kino kyamukwatako nnyo, n’amalirira okukigezaako. Teyasobola kukyusa mbeera ya bulamu bwe. Kale, n’agitwala eri Mukama. N’agimukwasa. Oluvannyuma, n’akkiriza nti agitutte. N’amulekera okweraliikirira kwe kwonna n’ebyamutawaanyanga. Okweraliikirira kwe kwakomangawo emirundi mingi. N’akuddizanga gy’ali. Bwe kityo, newaakubadde ng’ebintu byasigala nga bwe byali, emmeeme ye n’efuna emirembe egituukiridde. N’awulira nti azudde ekyama eky’omukisa. Okuva olwo, n’agezaako obutaddamu kwetikka migugu gye ye kennyini oba kuddukanya kintu kyonna ku bubwe. Ekyama kino kyakola eby’amagero mu nsonga ze ez’ebweru. Kyakola n’okusingawo mu ze ez’omunda, ezaali n’okusinga obuzibu okufugibwa. N’awaayo eri Mukama obulamu bwe bwonna. N’amwesiga n’ebyo byonna bye yalina. Bw’atyo n’alekera awo okweraliikirira. Obulamu bwe ne bufuuka obw’essanyu, kubanga yali wuwe. Era buno bwe bwali Obulamu bw’Omukristaayo Obwawaggulu! Kyali kyama kyangu nnyo kye yazuula. Kino kyokka. Omuntu yali asobola okugondera ekiragiro kya Katonda mu bigambo bino: “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. “(Abafiripi 4:6). Singa omuntu agondera, ekyandivuddemu, ng’ekisuubizo bwe kiri, kwe kuba nti “emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.” Waliwo ebirala bingi eby’okwogera ku bulamu buno obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda. Waliwo ebintu bingi ebikwata ku ebyo Mukama Yesu by’akolera abo abeewaayo gy’ali. Naye ensonga enkulu eri wano. Emmeeme emanyi ekyama kino erina ekisumuluzo. Kijja kusumulula ennyumba y’obugagga bwa Katonda. Nsuubira nti nkuleetedde okwegomba obulamu buno obw’omukisa. Tewandyagadde kwegyako migugu gyo? Teweegomba kukwasa buvunaanyizibwa bw’okuddukanya omuntu wo atafugika mu mikono gy’Oyo asobola okukuddukanya? Tokooye? Okuwummula kwe njogerako tekukulabikira nga kuwoomu? Ojjukira okuwummula okw’essanyu kwe wawuliranga oluvannyuma lw’olunaku olukooya, ng’ogenda okwebaka? Nga kyali kisanyusa okuddiriza buli kinywa. Okuleka omubiri okugalamira mu bweyagaze obutuukiridde. Okufuba kw’olunaku kwali kukomye okumala essaawa ntono waakiri, era abakozi baali basudde eri omulimu gw’olunaku. Tewaali kyetaago nate okuwanirira omutwe oguluma oba omugongo ogukooye. Weesiga ekitanda kyo ddala. Kyakuwanirira awatali kufuba kwonna. Wawummula. Naye kale singa wabuusabuusa amaanyi g’ekitanda kyo. Era, n’otya nti kyandimenyese ne kikusuula wansi. Wandisobodde okuwummula olwo? Buli kinywa tekyandinywezezza okukuwanirira? Obukoowu tebwandibadde bungi okusinga singa tewagenze ku kitanda n’akatono? Ekyokulabirako kino kikuyigirize kye kitegeeza okuwummulira mu Mukama. Emmeeme zammwe zigalamire ku kwagala kwe okuwoomu, ng’emibiri gyammwe bwe gigalamira ku bitanda byammwe ekiro. Muddirize buli kufuba era muteeke wansi buli mugugu. Mweyabize mu kuwummula n’obuteefu bwonna. Mwesige nti, bw’aba ng’abawaniridde, muli mirembe. Omulimu gwammwe gwokka kwe kuwummula. Ekitundu kye kwe kubawanirira, era tayinza kulemwa. Oba, mutwale ekyokulabirako ekirala, Mukama waffe kye yakakasa: eky’obulamu bw’omwana, bwe yagamba nti, “Yesu n’ayita omwana omuto n’amussa mu makkati gaabwe. N’abagamba nti, ‘Ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe mutakyuke kufaanana ng’abaana abato temugenda kuyingira mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu.” (Matayo 18:2-3) Kale, omwana omuto alina mpisa ki, era abeera atya? Abeera mu bulamu olw’okukkiriza, era empisa ye esinga obukulu kwe kubulwa okweraliikirira. Obulamu bwe kwesiga kumu okuwanvu okuva ku ntandikwa y’omwaka okutuuka ku nkomerero yaagwo. Yeesiga bazadde be, abamulabirira, n’abasomesa be. Ayinza n’okwesiga abantu abamu abatasaanira, olw’obwesige bwe obw’obuzaaliranwa. Era okwesiga kwe kuddibwamu n’omutima omugabi. Teyeetegekera kintu kyonna, naye afuna buli kintu. Tategeka bya nkya. Naye, obulamu bwe butegekebwa. Amakubo ge gamugguka nga bw’agatuukako, essaawa ku ssaawa, olunaku ku lunaku. Ayingira era afuluma mu nnyumba ya kitaawe nga talina ky’atya era mu ddembe. Anyumirwa obugagga bwayo, nga talina ky’asasudde okubufuna. Kawumpuli ayinza okutambula mu nguudo z’ekibuga kye, naye ye tafaayo. Enjala, omuliro, n’entalo biyinza okumwetooloola. Naye, mu kulabirira kwa kitaawe, awummula mu mirembe egituukiridde. Abeera mu kiseera kino, ng’akkiriza obulamu nga bwe bujja. Lumu nnakyalira ennyumba y’abagagga eyalimu omwana omu yekka gwe baali bafudde owaabwe. Yafunanga okwagala kwonna n’okulabirirwa emitima gy’abantu n’obugagga bwe byali biyinza okuwa. Bwe nnali ndaba omwana oyo ng’adduka ng’ayingira era ng’afuluma, olunaku ku lunaku, ne ndaba ekifaananyi ky’embeera yaffe ey’ekitalo ng’abaana mu nnyumba ya Kitaffe. Omwana oyo yali wa ddembe era nga talina kimuzitoowerera mu mutima, ng’alina obutafaayo obw’essanyu obw’obuto. Ne ndowooza nti, “Singa waliwo ekintu kyonna ekyandinakuwazizza abaagalwa be, kyandibadde kulaba omwana ono ng’yeeraliikirira ku bubwe.” Omutima gwa Katonda waffe ogw’okwagala teguyinza kusingawo nnyo okunakuwala olw’okweraliikirira kw’abaana be? Ne ntegeera ensonga lwaki Mukama waffe yakkaatiriza nti, “Temweraliikiriranga.” Ani asinga okulabirirwa obulungi mu buli maka? Si baana abato? Era asinga obuto ku bonna, omwana omuwere atalina ky’ayinza, si y’afuna omugabo ogusinga obunene? Omuwandiisi omu eyafa gye buvuddeko yagamba nti omwana omuwere “tafuba, so talanga; naye omuntu amuliisa, amwambaza, amwagala, era amusanyukira.” Tewali n’omu amusanyukira okusinga bw’asanyuka ye. Obulamu buno obw’okukkiriza, kale, bwe mpandiikako, buli mu kino: okuba omwana mu nnyumba ya Kitaffe. Omuntu bw’ayogera kino, aba ayogedde ekimala. Kisobola okukyusa buli bulamu obukooye era obuzitoowereddwa ne bufuuka obw’omukisa n’okuwummula. Obwesige obutaliimu kweraliikirira obw’abaana bammwe abato bubayigirize engeri y’okubeera ne Katonda. Bubasanyusa era buwamba emitima gyammwe. Mwerekere mu mikono gye. “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.” Abafiripi 4:6-7 Mwetegereze ebigambo ‘kintu na kimu’ mu kitundu ekyo waggulu. Bizingiramu buli nsonga yonna eyinza okuleeta okweraliikirira, ey’omunda n’ey’ebweru. Tutera okuwulira nga tunyigirizibwa okukkiriza nti obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe kwe kweraliikirira ku nsonga ezimu. Tujja kulowooza nti, “kituufu okulekera awo okweraliikirira kwonna. Mu nsonga ez’omwoyo, okweraliikirira kubi. Naye tulina okweraliikirira ku bintu ebimu. Kyandibadde kibi obutakola bwe tutyo. Tulina okweraliikirira abaana baffe, abo be twagala, ekkanisa yaffe, amazima, ne bizinensi yaffe.” Kyandiraze obutaba na nneewulira ntuufu n’akatono singa tetweraliikirira bintu nga bino.” Oba, tuyinza okulowooza nti, “Weewaawo, kituufu okwesiga Mukama n’abaagalwa baffe n’ensonga zaffe. Naye tusaanidde okweraliikirira obulamu bwaffe obw’omunda, okukkiriza kwaffe, okukemebwa kwaffe, n’ebibi byaffe. Bwe tutaakole bwe tutyo, bijja kulagajjalirwa.” Eky’okuddamu ku birowoozo ng’ebyo, n’ebirala byonna ebifaanana bwe bityo, tukisanga mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe: “Noolwekyo mbagamba nti, Temweraliikiriranga bya bulamu bwammwe, bye munaalya oba bye munaanywa, wadde ebyokwambala. Kubanga obulamu businga ebyokulya, n’omubiri gusinga ebyambalo. Mulabire ku nnyonyi ez’omu bbanga! Tezisiga so tezikungula so tezikuŋŋaanyiza mmere mu tterekero, naye Kitammwe ali mu ggulu aziriisa. Naye mmwe temusinga nnyo ennyonyi ezo? Ani ku mmwe, bwe yeeraliikirira, ayinza okwongerayo obulamu bwe akatundu n’akamu? Naye lwaki mweraliikirira ebyokwambala? Mulabire ku malanga ag’oku ttale! Tegaliiko kye geekolera, naye ne Kabaka Sulemaani mu kitiibwa kye kyonna teyagenkana mu kwambala. Naye obanga Katonda ayambaza obulungi bw’atyo omuddo ogw’omu nsiko ogw’ekiseera obuseera, ogubaawo leero ate enkeera ne gwokebwa mu kyoto, talisingawo nnyo okubambaza? Nga mulina okukkiriza okutono! Noolwekyo temweraliikiririranga nga mugamba nti, ‘Tunaalya ki? Oba nti, Tunaanywa ki? Oba nti, Tunaayambala ki?’’ (Matayo 6:25-31) “Ebyo byonna bannamawanga bye bayaayaanira. Naye Kitammwe ali mu ggulu amanyi ng’ebyo byonna mubyetaaga. Naye musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako. “Noolwekyo temweraliikiriranga bya nkya. Kubanga olunaku olw’enkya lulyeraliikirira ebyalwo. Buli lunaku lulina emitawaana gyalwo egimala.” Mu Matayo 6:32-34, Mukama waffe ayolesa obulamu buno obutaliimu kweraliikirira, bw’atugamba okulabira ku nnyonyi ez’omu bbanga n’amalanga ag’oku ttale, ng’ebyokulabirako by’obulamu bw’ayagala tubeemu. Tulina, awatali kweraliikirira oba kutya, okuba ng’ennyonyi n’amalanga. Ennyonyi zisanyukira okulabirirwa kwa Katonda ne zifuna emmere. Amalanga gakula mu musana gwe. Enkazaluggya zitwogereze: “Nze ndi nkazaluggya entono, ennyonyi etali ya kitiibwa. Obulamu bwange tebulina muwendo munene, naye Mukama omwagalwa andabirira. Sirina ggwanika wadde tterekero. Sisiga so sikungula. Ampa omugabo gw’enkazaluggya, naye tampa nsigo n’emu ya kutereka. “Mmanyi nti waliwo enkazaluggya nnyingi. Abantu baziraba mu nsi yonna. Naye Kitaffe ali mu ggulu amanyi omu ku ffe bw’agwa wansi. “Newaakubadde tuli batono, tetwerabirwa. Newaakubadde tuli banafu, tetutya. Kubanga tumanyi nti Mukama omwagalwa akuuma obulamu bw’ebitonde bye yatonda. “Mbuuka waggulu w’emiti egisinga okukwatagana ne ntuula ku matabi mangi.” Sirina maapu wadde kampasi, naye sibula kkubo.” Nfunya ebiwaawaatiro byange akawungeezi, yonna gye mba. Kitaffe bulijjo antunuulidde. Tewali kabi kalintuukako. Ndi nkazaluggya entono bwentono, ennyonyi etali ya kitiibwa. Naye mmanyi nti Kitaffe anjagala. Mmwe mulina okukkiriza okutono okusinga ffe?”

fields.title: Engeri y’Okuyingiramu
fields.body_html:
Ngezezzaako okugonjoola ekibuuzo oba ng’obulamu buno obw’okwesiga okujjuvu bwesigamiziddwa ku Byawandiikibwa. Era ndaze katono obulamu obwo kye buli. Ensonga eddako y’engeri y’okubutuukako n’okububeeramu ddala. Okusooka, nnyinza okugamba nti obulamu buno obw’omukisa tetulina kubutwala mu ngeri yonna ng’ekintu kye tutuukako olw’amaanyi gaffe, wabula ng’ekintu kye tuweebwa. Tetuyinza kubukolerera, tetuyinza kubulinnyira, tetuyinza kubuwangula; tewali kye tuyinza kukola okuggyako okubusaba n’okubufuna. Kirabo kya Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Era ekintu bwe kiba kirabo, ekyo kyokka ekisigalidde oyo akiweebwa kwe kukitwala n’okwebaza oyo akimuwadde. Ku kirabo tetugamba nti, “Laba kye ntuuseeko,” ne twewaana olw’obukugu bwaffe mu kukifuna. Wabula tugamba nti, “Laba omugabi ky’ampadde,” ne twewaanira okwagala n’obugabi bw’omugabi.

Era buli kintu mu bulokozi bwaffe kirabo. Okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero, Katonda ye mugabi, ffe tuli baweebwa. Ebisuubizo ebisingayo obugagga si by’abo abakola ebintu ebinene. Wabula by’abo “abaliweebwa ekisa kya Katonda n’ekirabo eky’obutuukirivu.” Okumanya obulamu buno obw’omunda, emmeeme erina okuba nga yeetegefu okuweebwa. Erina okukitegeera ddala nti bulina okuba ekirabo kya Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Tetuyinza kubufuna olw’okufuba kwaffe wadde olw’ebikolwa byaffe. Kino kijja kwanguyiza nnyo ensonga. Ekibuuzo kyokka ekisigaddewo kiri nti ani aweebwa ekirabo kino okuva eri Katonda, era akifuna atya. Nnyinza okuddamu nti akiwa emmeeme yokka eyeewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda. Olina okukifuna lwa kukkiriza.

Okwewaayo eri Katonda kye kintu ekisooka. Si mu ngeri ya mateeka, wadde okubugula oba okubusaanira. Wabula okuggyawo ebiziyiza, Katonda asobole okubuwa. Okubumba ekibya ekirungi okuva mu kitole ky’ebbumba, omubumbi ateekwa okuba n’obuyinza bwonna ku kyo. Kirina okugalamira mu ngalo ze nga tekyewakanya. Okufuula omuntu ekibya eky’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, alina okuba “atukuziddwa, asaanira okukozesebwa mukama we, olw’omulimu omulungi.” Alina okwerekera ddala gy’ali era n’asigala mu ngalo ze nga teyeewakanya. Kino kirabikirawo ku kutunula okusooka.

Lumu nnagezaako okunnyonnyola omusawo ow’eddwaliro amakulu n’obwetaavu bw’okwewaayo eri Katonda. Naye yalabika ng’atasobola kukitegeera. Ku nkomerero, ne mmugamba nti, “Ka tugambe nti, ng’olambula abalwadde, osanga omusajja akwegayirira omuwonye. Naye tayagala kukubuulira bubonero bwe bwonna wadde okukozesa eddagala ly’omuwa.

Agamba nti, ‘Neetegefu okugoberera by’ondagira mu bintu ebimu, nga bwe birabika nga birungi gye ndi. Naye mu bintu ebirala, njagala kugoberera magezi gange.’ Wandikoze ki?” bwe nnamubuuza.

“Nkole ki!” bwe yaddamu ng’anyiize, “nkole ki! Omusajja ng’oyo nandimulese mangu yeerabirire yekka. Kya lwatu,” bwe yayongerako, “tewali kye nandisobodde kumukolera. Ateekwa okugondera bye mmulagira.” “Kale abalwadde bateekwa okugondera abasawo okusobola okuwonyezebwa?” “Okugondera ddala ddala!” bwe yaddamu n’amaanyi. “Era ekyo kye kwewaayo eri Katonda,” bwe nnagenda mu maaso. “Katonda ateekwa okukwasibwa ensonga yonna, awatali kye tumukweka. By’alagira biteekwa okugonderwa ddala ddala.” “Nkirabye,” bwe yaleekaana, — “nkirabye! Era nja kukikola. Katonda ateekwa okukola nange nga bw’ayagala okuva kati.”

Abamu bayinza okulowooza nti “okwerekera” kye kigambo ekisinga obulungi. Naye kyonna kye tukozesa, tutegeeza okwewaayo kwonna eri Katonda. Tumuwa omwoyo gwaffe, emmeeme yaffe, n’omubiri gwaffe. Twagala akole naffe nga bw’asiima. Tutegeeza nti olulimi lw’emmeeme yaffe mu bintu byonna lulina okuba nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe.” Tutegeeza okulekayo okwerondera kwonna.

Tutegeeza obulamu obw’obuwulize obutayinza kwewalika. Eri emmeeme etamanyi Katonda, kino kiyinza okulabika ng’ekizibu. Naye eri abo abamumanyi, bwe bulamu obusingayo essanyu n’emirembe. Ye Kitaffe. Atwagala era amanyi ekisinga obulungi. N’olwekyo, by’ayagala kye kintu ekisingayo omukisa ekiyinza okututuukako, ne bwe tuba mu mbeera ki. Sitegeera Setaani bw’asobodde okuziba amaaso g’Ekkanisa ku mazima gano. Naye kirabika abaana ba Katonda batya by’ayagala okusinga ekintu kyonna. Ate nga by’ayagala, ebirungi era ebyagalibwa ennyo, bitegeeza birungi byokka eri emmeeme zaabwe. Bireeta okwagala okutaggwaawo, okusaasira okw’ekisa, n’emikisa emingi.

Nandyagadde okulaga buli muntu obuwoomi obutapimika obw’ebyo Katonda by’ayagala. Eggulu kifo kya ssanyu eritaliiko kkomo. Eyo by’ayagala bikolebwa mu bujjuvu. N’obulamu bwaffe bugabana ku ssanyu lino nga by’ayagala bikolebwa mu bwo.

Atwagala, atwagala ddala, era omwagazi by’ayagala bulijjo biba mukisa eri gw’ayagala. Abamu ku ffe tumanyi okwagala kye kuli.

Singa tusobola, twandiwadde emikisa abaagalwa baffe. Twandibajjuzza buli kirungi era ekisanyusa mu bulamu, singa twalina amaanyi okutuukiriza kye tubaagaliza.

Era obanga okwagala bwe kukola bwe kutyo gye tuli, kale nga kiteekwa okusingawo ennyo bwe kityo eri Katonda waffe, oyo kwagala kwennyini.

Singa tusobola okulaba, ne bwe kiba kaseera katono, obuziba bw’okwagala kwe, twandiddukidde mangu okwaniriza by’ayagala ng’eky’obugagga kyaffe ekisingayo. Twandyerekedde ddala gye biri, nga tujjudde essanyu n’okwebaza olw’enkizo ng’eyo.

Abakristaayo bangi balowooza nti Kitaffe ali mu ggulu ayagala kubafuula ba nnaku n’okubaggyako emikisa gyabwe.

Bannaffe abo abasaanidde okusaasirwa, balowooza nti bwe banywerera ku by’ayagala bo bennyini, bayinza okumulemesa okukola ekyo. Nkwatibwa ensonyi okuwandiika ebigambo bino, naye tuteekwa okwolekera ensonga eno efuula obulamu bw’abantu bikumi na bikumi obw’ennaku.

Omukyala Omukristaayo, eyalina endowooza eyo, yabuulira mukwano gwe nga bwe kyali kizibu gy’ali okugamba nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe,” era nga bwe yatyanga okukikola. Yali maama w’omwana omulenzi omuto omu yekka, eyali omusika w’obugagga bungi, era ng’omutima gwe gwonna guli ku ye. Bwe yamala okumubuulira ebimweraliikiriza, mukwano gwe n’agamba nti, “Watya singa Charley wo omuto akuddukirako enkya n’akugamba nti, ‘Maama, nsazeewo okukuleka okukola nange nga bw’oyagala okuva kati.

Nja kukugonderanga bulijjo. Njagala onkolere ekyo ky’olaba nga kye kisinga obulungi gye ndi.

Mmanyi nti onjagala, era nja kwesiga okwagala kwo.’ Wandiwulidde otya gy’ali? Wandyegambye nti, ‘Aa, kaakano nfunye omukisa okufuula Charley ow’ennaku!

Nja kumuggyako ebimusanyusa byonna, era njjuze obulamu bwe buli kizibu na buli kitali kisanyusa kye nnaasobola okufuna. Nja kumukaka okukola ebintu ebisingayo obuzibu. Oluvannyuma, nja kumuwa ebiragiro ebya buli ngeri ebitasoboka’?” “Nedda, nedda, nedda!” maama n’aleekaana ng’anyiize. “Omanyi nti saandikikoze. Nandimukwatidde ku mutima gwange ne mmunywegera nnyo. Nandijjuzza obulamu bwe ebintu ebisingayo obuwoomi n’obulungi.” “Kale ggwe olina ekisa n’okwagala okusinga Katonda?” mukwano gwe bwe yabuuza. “Aa, nedda,” bwe yaddamu. “Ndabye ensobi yange. Sijja kuddamu kutya kugamba Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu nti, ‘By’oyagala bikolebwe,’ okusinga bwe nnandyagadde Charley wange atye okukingamba.”

Okusinga obulamu obulungi, oba mikwano, oba ssente, oba ettutumu, oba eddembe, oba okukulaakulana, ebisingayo obulungi n’obuwoomi bye ebyo Katonda waffe by’ayagala, ebisaanira okwagalibwa ennyo. Byakaayakanya essaawa ez’ekizikiza n’ekitangaala eky’obwakatonda. Bimulisa omusana ogwaka ku makubo agasingayo ekizikiza. Oyo abifudde obwakabaka bwe afuga bulijjo; era tewali kiyinza kumukyamira. Enkizo ey’ekitiibwa ekuggukiddewo. Omutendera ogusooka okuyingira mu bulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda kwe kwewaayo eri Katonda okujjuvu. Sisobola kukuleka kukitwala ng’ekiragiro ekizibu era ekikakali. Olina okukikola n’essanyu, n’okusiima, n’omwoyo ogubuguma. Olina okuyingira mu kye mpita oludda olw’enkizo olw’okwewaayo eri Katonda. Nkukakasa, okuva mu bye nnayitamu eby’omukisa, nti kye kifo ekisingayo essanyu ky’olisanga.

Okukkiriza kye kiddako. Okukkiriza kwetaagisa okufuna ekirabo kyonna. Mikwano gyaffe giyinza okutuwa ekintu nga kiramba, naye tekiba kyaffe okutuusa nga tukkirizza nti bakituwadde ne tukyetwalira. Kino kya mazima nnyo ku birabo eby’omu birowoozo byokka oba eby’omwoyo. Omuntu omulala ayinza okutwagala awatali kkomo. Naye okutuusa nga tukikkirizza, okwagala okwo tekufuuka kwaffe. Ndowooza Abakristaayo abasinga bakimanyi kino ku bikwata ku kusonyiyibwa kwabwe.

Bamanyi nti okubuulira okusonyiwa kwa Yesu ku bibi kwandigenze mu maaso emirembe gyonna. Naye okusonyiyibwa okwo tekwandibadde kwabwe okutuusa nga bakwetwalidde. Baasooka kukikkiriza. Naye mu kubeera mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo, kino bakyerabira. Balowooza nti, okuva bwe baalokolebwa lwa kukkiriza, kaakano balina okubeera abalamu lwa bikolwa. Mu kifo ky’okweyongera okuweebwa, kaakano balina okutandika okukola. Kino kifuula ekigambo kyaffe nti obulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda buyingirwamu lwa kukkiriza, okulabika gye bali nga tekitegeerekeka n’akatono.

Kyokka kyalangirirwa lwatu nti, “Nga bwe mwaweebwa Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe, mutambulirenga mu ye.” Twamufuna lwa kukkiriza, era lwa kukkiriza kwokka; bwe tutyo tulina okutambulira mu ye lwa kukkiriza, era lwa kukkiriza kwokka. Okukkiriza kwaffe mu bulamu buno obukwekeddwa kwe kumu n’okukkiriza okwatuggya mu bwakabaka bw’ekizikiza ne kututwala eri Omwana wa Katonda. Kwokka kwesigama ku kintu kirala. Olwo twakkiriza nti Yesu ye Mulokozi waffe okuva mu musango gw’ekibi. Okukkiriza kwaffe ne kukifuula bwe kityo. Kaakano, tulina okukkiriza nti ye Mulokozi waffe okuva mu maanyi g’ekibi. Okukkiriza kwaffe kujja kukifuula bwe kityo. Twamwesiga olw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, ne kufuuka kwaffe. Kaakano, tulina okumwesiga olw’okutukuzibwa, era nakwo kunaaba kwaffe. Olwo twamutwala ng’Omulokozi atuwonya ebibonerezo by’ebibi byaffe mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Kaakano, tulina okumutwala ng’Omulokozi atuwonya mu kiseera kino obuddu bw’ebibi byaffe.

Olwo yali Mununuzi waffe, kaakano agenda kuba Bulamu bwaffe. Olwo yatusika okutuggya mu kinnya. Kaakano agenda kututuuza mu bifo eby’omu ggulu wamu naye. Kino nkyogera nga nsinziira ku bujulizi obw’ebyo bye tuyitamu mu bulamu n’obw’ebikolebwa mu nkola.

Mmanyi nti, mu by’enjigiriza y’eddiini ne mu mateeka, buli mukkiriza afuna buli kintu ku kukyuka kwe. Naye mu bulamu bw’ennyini, tewali kiba kikye okutuusa ng’akyetwalidde lwa kukkiriza. “Nga bwe nasuubiza Musa, buli we munaalinnyanga ekigere, mbawaddewo.” (Yoswa 1:3). “Yeebazibwe Katonda era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, atuwadde mu Kristo buli mukisa gwonna ogw’omwoyo oguva mu ggulu.” (Abaefeso 1:3). Naye okutuusa nga tubikkiriza, tebiba byaffe. “Olw’okukkiriza kwaffe,” bulijjo lye kkomo era lye tteeka.

Naye okukkiriza kuno kwe njogerako kuteekwa okuba okukkiriza okwa kaakano. Tewali kukkiriza abantu kwe bakozesa mu biseera eby’omu maaso kugasa kintu kyonna. Omuntu ayinza okukkiriza emirembe gyonna nti ebibi bye birisonyiyibwa mu kiseera ekimu eky’omu maaso, n’atafuna mirembe n’akatono. Alina okutuuka ku kukkiriza okwa kaakano, n’agamba lwa kukkiriza nti, “Ebibi byange bisonyiyiddwa kaakano,” olwo n’asobola okubeera mu bulamu obuggya. Era bwe kityo, tewali kukkiriza kunoonya kuwonyezebwa kibi mu biseera eby’omu maaso kuyinza kutuusa mmeeme mu bulamu bwe tunnyonnyola. Omulabe asanyukira nnyo okukkiriza kuno okw’omu maaso. Amanyi nti tekulina maanyi kutuuka ku kintu kyonna.

Naye akankana n’adduka omukkiriza bw’akakasa nti mwetwaze okuva mu buyinza bwe. Mu bufunze: okuyingira mu bulamu buno obw’omukisa obw’ekiwummulo n’obuwanguzi, olina okukwata emitendera ebiri. Ogusooka, weerekere ddala mu byonna.

Ogwokubiri, beera n’okukkiriza okutaliiko kubuusabuusa.

Ne bw’oba n’ebizibu ki, emitendera gino ebiri gijja kukuyamba. Bw’ogikwata era n’oginywererako, gijja kukutuusa mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo obusingako obulungi. Kino oyinza okukikakasa. Bw’onoolekayo ebirala byonna, n’ossa omwoyo ku nsonga zino ebbiri, ojja kukulaakulana mangu. Ojja kutuuka ku mwalo emmeeme yo gw’eyagala mangu okusinga bw’olowooza kaakano nti kisoboka.

Nnyinza okuddamu emitendera gino, waleme kubaawo kukyamuka? Oli mwana wa Katonda, era weegomba okumusanyusa.

Oyagala Omulokozi wo ow’omuwendo, era otamiddwa era okooye ekibi ekimunakuwaza. Weegomba omuntu okukununula okuva mu maanyi gaakyo. Byonna by’ogezezzaako biremye. Ng’oggwaamu essuubi, kaakano weebuuza oba, nga abantu bano abasanyufu bwe bagamba, Mukama asobola era ajja kukulokola. Omanyi mu mmeeme yo nti asobola. Okukulokola okuva mu balabe bo bonna kye kigendererwa kye.

Kale mwesige. Mukwase ensonga yo. Leka ebirala byonna era kkiriza nti agitwala. Ng’omanyi bw’ali n’ebyo by’agambye, kakasa nti akuwa obulokozi obujjuvu kaakano. Mu kusooka, wakkiriza nti yakuwonya omusango gw’ekibi kubanga yagamba bw’atyo. Kaakano, kkiriza nti akuwonya amaanyi g’ekibi kubanga agamba bw’atyo. Okukkiriza kwo kaakano kukwate amaanyi amaggya mu Kristo. Wamwesiga ng’Omulokozi wo eyakufiirira, kaakano mwesige ng’Omulokozi wo omulamu. Nga bwe yajja okukununula okuva mu kubonerezebwa okw’omu maaso, teyajja era okukununula okuva mu buddu obwa kaakano? Nga bwe yajja okwetikka ebibi byo ku lulwo, bw’atyo azze okubeera n’obulamu bwe mu ggwe.

Toliiko maanyi n’akatono mu mbeera zombi. Wandisobodde okwemalako ebibi byo bwe wandisobodde kaakano okwetuusaako obutuukirivu obw’omu bikolwa. Kristo, era Kristo yekka, y’ateekwa okukukolera byombi.

Omugabo gwo kwe kumukwasa ensonga eyo, oluvannyuma n’okkiriza nti agikola.

Omukyala omu, kaakano omututumufu, bwe yali mu kizikiza kinene, yali anoonya okuyingira. N’agamba mukwano gwe eyali agezaako okumuyamba nti, “Mwenna mugamba nti, ‘Weerekere ddala, era weesige.’ Naye simanyi bwe kikolebwa. Nandyagadde okikole mu ddoboozi eriwulikika, ndabe bw’okikola.” “Kale nkikole mu ddoboozi eriwulikika ku lulwo?”

“Mukama Yesu, osobola era ojja kumponya mu bweraliikirivu bwonna n’ebizibu by’obulamu bwange obw’Ekikristaayo. Wafa okunfuula ow’eddembe, si mu biseera eby’omu maaso, wabula kaakano era wano. Oli wa maanyi okusinga Setaani. Osobola okunkuuma, ne mu bunafu bwange, nneme kugwa mu mitego gye wadde okumugondera. Era, Mukama, ngenda kukwesiga onkuume. Ngezezzaako okwekuuma nga ndi munywevu, ne nnemererwa, ne ngwa nnyo. Siriiko bwe nnyinza n’akatono; kale, nja kukwesiga kaakano. Neewaayo gy’oli; sirina kye nkweka. Omubiri, emmeeme, n’omwoyo, nneeweereza gy’oli, ekitole ky’ebbumba ekitaliiko mugaso. Mbumba okufuuka kyonna okwagala kwo n’amagezi go kye bisiima. Era kaakano, ndi wuwo.

Okkiriza kye nkuwa. Amaanyi go gatutte omutima gwange omunafu era omusirusiru. Otandise okukola mu nze, ng’onjagazisa era ng’onsobozesa okukola by’osiima. Nkwesiga ddala, era nkwesiga kaakano!” Otya okukwata omutendera guno? Kirabika nga kya mangu nnyo, nga kufaanana okubuuka mu kizikiza? Tomanyi nti ebigere by’okukkiriza bulijjo “bigwa ku kirabika ng’ekifo ekyereere, naye ne bisanga olwazi wansi”? Omusajja, eyali alina okukka mu luzzi ng’akutte omuguwa, yazuula, ng’atidde nnyo, bwe yali amaze okukka wala, nti omuguwa mumpi. Yali atuuse ku nkomerero yaagwo, naye, nga bwe yateebereza, yali akyali nga ffuuti amakumi asatu okuva wansi mu luzzi. Teyamanya kya kukola. Teyalina maanyi wadde obukugu okulinnya ng’ayita ku muguwa, era okuguta kwandimubetentedde.

Emikono gye ne gitandika okuggwaamu amaanyi. N’asalawo okuguta n’ayolekagana n’ekyo ekimulindiridde. N’akkiriza okuzikirira, n’ataayo omuguwa. N’agwa! Wansi mu luzzi waali — yinci ssatu zokka! Bw’oba ng’ebigere byo birina okukwata ku “lwazi wansi,” oteekwa okuta buli ky’okutte ne weesuula mu Katonda. Kubanga tewali kkubo ddala.

Era okukikola kaakano kuyinza okukuwonya emyezi, era n’emyaka, egy’okufuba n’obukoowu. Mu bigo byonna eby’edda ebya Bungereza waabangawo ekifo ekyayitibwanga ekiddukiro eky’omunda. Kye kyali ekifo ekisingayo amaanyi n’obukuumi mu kigo. Kyakwekanga abanafu n’abatalina bwe bayinza mu biseera eby’akabi. Singa wali mukyala atiitiibwa era atalina bw’ayinza mu kigo ekizingiziddwa, wandyetantadde okwekweka omwo?

Wandityeyo okukikola? Tuteekwa okutya okwekweka mu maanyi ag’obukuumi ag’Omukuumi waffe ow’obwakatonda?

Taabongootenga so teyeebakenga. Yasuubiza okukuuma amagenda gaffe n’amadda gaffe, okuva leero n’okutuusa emirembe gyonna.
fields.body_text: Ngezezzaako okugonjoola ekibuuzo oba ng’obulamu buno obw’okwesiga okujjuvu bwesigamiziddwa ku Byawandiikibwa. Era ndaze katono obulamu obwo kye buli. Ensonga eddako y’engeri y’okubutuukako n’okububeeramu ddala. Okusooka, nnyinza okugamba nti obulamu buno obw’omukisa tetulina kubutwala mu ngeri yonna ng’ekintu kye tutuukako olw’amaanyi gaffe, wabula ng’ekintu kye tuweebwa. Tetuyinza kubukolerera, tetuyinza kubulinnyira, tetuyinza kubuwangula; tewali kye tuyinza kukola okuggyako okubusaba n’okubufuna. Kirabo kya Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Era ekintu bwe kiba kirabo, ekyo kyokka ekisigalidde oyo akiweebwa kwe kukitwala n’okwebaza oyo akimuwadde. Ku kirabo tetugamba nti, “Laba kye ntuuseeko,” ne twewaana olw’obukugu bwaffe mu kukifuna. Wabula tugamba nti, “Laba omugabi ky’ampadde,” ne twewaanira okwagala n’obugabi bw’omugabi. Era buli kintu mu bulokozi bwaffe kirabo. Okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero, Katonda ye mugabi, ffe tuli baweebwa. Ebisuubizo ebisingayo obugagga si by’abo abakola ebintu ebinene. Wabula by’abo “abaliweebwa ekisa kya Katonda n’ekirabo eky’obutuukirivu.” Okumanya obulamu buno obw’omunda, emmeeme erina okuba nga yeetegefu okuweebwa. Erina okukitegeera ddala nti bulina okuba ekirabo kya Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Tetuyinza kubufuna olw’okufuba kwaffe wadde olw’ebikolwa byaffe. Kino kijja kwanguyiza nnyo ensonga. Ekibuuzo kyokka ekisigaddewo kiri nti ani aweebwa ekirabo kino okuva eri Katonda, era akifuna atya. Nnyinza okuddamu nti akiwa emmeeme yokka eyeewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda. Olina okukifuna lwa kukkiriza. Okwewaayo eri Katonda kye kintu ekisooka. Si mu ngeri ya mateeka, wadde okubugula oba okubusaanira. Wabula okuggyawo ebiziyiza, Katonda asobole okubuwa. Okubumba ekibya ekirungi okuva mu kitole ky’ebbumba, omubumbi ateekwa okuba n’obuyinza bwonna ku kyo. Kirina okugalamira mu ngalo ze nga tekyewakanya. Okufuula omuntu ekibya eky’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, alina okuba “atukuziddwa, asaanira okukozesebwa mukama we, olw’omulimu omulungi.” Alina okwerekera ddala gy’ali era n’asigala mu ngalo ze nga teyeewakanya. Kino kirabikirawo ku kutunula okusooka. Lumu nnagezaako okunnyonnyola omusawo ow’eddwaliro amakulu n’obwetaavu bw’okwewaayo eri Katonda. Naye yalabika ng’atasobola kukitegeera. Ku nkomerero, ne mmugamba nti, “Ka tugambe nti, ng’olambula abalwadde, osanga omusajja akwegayirira omuwonye. Naye tayagala kukubuulira bubonero bwe bwonna wadde okukozesa eddagala ly’omuwa. Agamba nti, ‘Neetegefu okugoberera by’ondagira mu bintu ebimu, nga bwe birabika nga birungi gye ndi. Naye mu bintu ebirala, njagala kugoberera magezi gange.’ Wandikoze ki?” bwe nnamubuuza. “Nkole ki!” bwe yaddamu ng’anyiize, “nkole ki! Omusajja ng’oyo nandimulese mangu yeerabirire yekka. Kya lwatu,” bwe yayongerako, “tewali kye nandisobodde kumukolera. Ateekwa okugondera bye mmulagira.” “Kale abalwadde bateekwa okugondera abasawo okusobola okuwonyezebwa?” “Okugondera ddala ddala!” bwe yaddamu n’amaanyi. “Era ekyo kye kwewaayo eri Katonda,” bwe nnagenda mu maaso. “Katonda ateekwa okukwasibwa ensonga yonna, awatali kye tumukweka. By’alagira biteekwa okugonderwa ddala ddala.” “Nkirabye,” bwe yaleekaana, — “nkirabye! Era nja kukikola. Katonda ateekwa okukola nange nga bw’ayagala okuva kati.” Abamu bayinza okulowooza nti “okwerekera” kye kigambo ekisinga obulungi. Naye kyonna kye tukozesa, tutegeeza okwewaayo kwonna eri Katonda. Tumuwa omwoyo gwaffe, emmeeme yaffe, n’omubiri gwaffe. Twagala akole naffe nga bw’asiima. Tutegeeza nti olulimi lw’emmeeme yaffe mu bintu byonna lulina okuba nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe.” Tutegeeza okulekayo okwerondera kwonna. Tutegeeza obulamu obw’obuwulize obutayinza kwewalika. Eri emmeeme etamanyi Katonda, kino kiyinza okulabika ng’ekizibu. Naye eri abo abamumanyi, bwe bulamu obusingayo essanyu n’emirembe. Ye Kitaffe. Atwagala era amanyi ekisinga obulungi. N’olwekyo, by’ayagala kye kintu ekisingayo omukisa ekiyinza okututuukako, ne bwe tuba mu mbeera ki. Sitegeera Setaani bw’asobodde okuziba amaaso g’Ekkanisa ku mazima gano. Naye kirabika abaana ba Katonda batya by’ayagala okusinga ekintu kyonna. Ate nga by’ayagala, ebirungi era ebyagalibwa ennyo, bitegeeza birungi byokka eri emmeeme zaabwe. Bireeta okwagala okutaggwaawo, okusaasira okw’ekisa, n’emikisa emingi. Nandyagadde okulaga buli muntu obuwoomi obutapimika obw’ebyo Katonda by’ayagala. Eggulu kifo kya ssanyu eritaliiko kkomo. Eyo by’ayagala bikolebwa mu bujjuvu. N’obulamu bwaffe bugabana ku ssanyu lino nga by’ayagala bikolebwa mu bwo. Atwagala, atwagala ddala, era omwagazi by’ayagala bulijjo biba mukisa eri gw’ayagala. Abamu ku ffe tumanyi okwagala kye kuli. Singa tusobola, twandiwadde emikisa abaagalwa baffe. Twandibajjuzza buli kirungi era ekisanyusa mu bulamu, singa twalina amaanyi okutuukiriza kye tubaagaliza. Era obanga okwagala bwe kukola bwe kutyo gye tuli, kale nga kiteekwa okusingawo ennyo bwe kityo eri Katonda waffe, oyo kwagala kwennyini. Singa tusobola okulaba, ne bwe kiba kaseera katono, obuziba bw’okwagala kwe, twandiddukidde mangu okwaniriza by’ayagala ng’eky’obugagga kyaffe ekisingayo. Twandyerekedde ddala gye biri, nga tujjudde essanyu n’okwebaza olw’enkizo ng’eyo. Abakristaayo bangi balowooza nti Kitaffe ali mu ggulu ayagala kubafuula ba nnaku n’okubaggyako emikisa gyabwe. Bannaffe abo abasaanidde okusaasirwa, balowooza nti bwe banywerera ku by’ayagala bo bennyini, bayinza okumulemesa okukola ekyo. Nkwatibwa ensonyi okuwandiika ebigambo bino, naye tuteekwa okwolekera ensonga eno efuula obulamu bw’abantu bikumi na bikumi obw’ennaku. Omukyala Omukristaayo, eyalina endowooza eyo, yabuulira mukwano gwe nga bwe kyali kizibu gy’ali okugamba nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe,” era nga bwe yatyanga okukikola. Yali maama w’omwana omulenzi omuto omu yekka, eyali omusika w’obugagga bungi, era ng’omutima gwe gwonna guli ku ye. Bwe yamala okumubuulira ebimweraliikiriza, mukwano gwe n’agamba nti, “Watya singa Charley wo omuto akuddukirako enkya n’akugamba nti, ‘Maama, nsazeewo okukuleka okukola nange nga bw’oyagala okuva kati. Nja kukugonderanga bulijjo. Njagala onkolere ekyo ky’olaba nga kye kisinga obulungi gye ndi. Mmanyi nti onjagala, era nja kwesiga okwagala kwo.’ Wandiwulidde otya gy’ali? Wandyegambye nti, ‘Aa, kaakano nfunye omukisa okufuula Charley ow’ennaku! Nja kumuggyako ebimusanyusa byonna, era njjuze obulamu bwe buli kizibu na buli kitali kisanyusa kye nnaasobola okufuna. Nja kumukaka okukola ebintu ebisingayo obuzibu. Oluvannyuma, nja kumuwa ebiragiro ebya buli ngeri ebitasoboka’?” “Nedda, nedda, nedda!” maama n’aleekaana ng’anyiize. “Omanyi nti saandikikoze. Nandimukwatidde ku mutima gwange ne mmunywegera nnyo. Nandijjuzza obulamu bwe ebintu ebisingayo obuwoomi n’obulungi.” “Kale ggwe olina ekisa n’okwagala okusinga Katonda?” mukwano gwe bwe yabuuza. “Aa, nedda,” bwe yaddamu. “Ndabye ensobi yange. Sijja kuddamu kutya kugamba Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu nti, ‘By’oyagala bikolebwe,’ okusinga bwe nnandyagadde Charley wange atye okukingamba.” Okusinga obulamu obulungi, oba mikwano, oba ssente, oba ettutumu, oba eddembe, oba okukulaakulana, ebisingayo obulungi n’obuwoomi bye ebyo Katonda waffe by’ayagala, ebisaanira okwagalibwa ennyo. Byakaayakanya essaawa ez’ekizikiza n’ekitangaala eky’obwakatonda. Bimulisa omusana ogwaka ku makubo agasingayo ekizikiza. Oyo abifudde obwakabaka bwe afuga bulijjo; era tewali kiyinza kumukyamira. Enkizo ey’ekitiibwa ekuggukiddewo. Omutendera ogusooka okuyingira mu bulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda kwe kwewaayo eri Katonda okujjuvu. Sisobola kukuleka kukitwala ng’ekiragiro ekizibu era ekikakali. Olina okukikola n’essanyu, n’okusiima, n’omwoyo ogubuguma. Olina okuyingira mu kye mpita oludda olw’enkizo olw’okwewaayo eri Katonda. Nkukakasa, okuva mu bye nnayitamu eby’omukisa, nti kye kifo ekisingayo essanyu ky’olisanga. Okukkiriza kye kiddako. Okukkiriza kwetaagisa okufuna ekirabo kyonna. Mikwano gyaffe giyinza okutuwa ekintu nga kiramba, naye tekiba kyaffe okutuusa nga tukkirizza nti bakituwadde ne tukyetwalira. Kino kya mazima nnyo ku birabo eby’omu birowoozo byokka oba eby’omwoyo. Omuntu omulala ayinza okutwagala awatali kkomo. Naye okutuusa nga tukikkirizza, okwagala okwo tekufuuka kwaffe. Ndowooza Abakristaayo abasinga bakimanyi kino ku bikwata ku kusonyiyibwa kwabwe. Bamanyi nti okubuulira okusonyiwa kwa Yesu ku bibi kwandigenze mu maaso emirembe gyonna. Naye okusonyiyibwa okwo tekwandibadde kwabwe okutuusa nga bakwetwalidde. Baasooka kukikkiriza. Naye mu kubeera mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo, kino bakyerabira. Balowooza nti, okuva bwe baalokolebwa lwa kukkiriza, kaakano balina okubeera abalamu lwa bikolwa. Mu kifo ky’okweyongera okuweebwa, kaakano balina okutandika okukola. Kino kifuula ekigambo kyaffe nti obulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda buyingirwamu lwa kukkiriza, okulabika gye bali nga tekitegeerekeka n’akatono. Kyokka kyalangirirwa lwatu nti, “Nga bwe mwaweebwa Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe, mutambulirenga mu ye.” Twamufuna lwa kukkiriza, era lwa kukkiriza kwokka; bwe tutyo tulina okutambulira mu ye lwa kukkiriza, era lwa kukkiriza kwokka. Okukkiriza kwaffe mu bulamu buno obukwekeddwa kwe kumu n’okukkiriza okwatuggya mu bwakabaka bw’ekizikiza ne kututwala eri Omwana wa Katonda. Kwokka kwesigama ku kintu kirala. Olwo twakkiriza nti Yesu ye Mulokozi waffe okuva mu musango gw’ekibi. Okukkiriza kwaffe ne kukifuula bwe kityo. Kaakano, tulina okukkiriza nti ye Mulokozi waffe okuva mu maanyi g’ekibi. Okukkiriza kwaffe kujja kukifuula bwe kityo. Twamwesiga olw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, ne kufuuka kwaffe. Kaakano, tulina okumwesiga olw’okutukuzibwa, era nakwo kunaaba kwaffe. Olwo twamutwala ng’Omulokozi atuwonya ebibonerezo by’ebibi byaffe mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Kaakano, tulina okumutwala ng’Omulokozi atuwonya mu kiseera kino obuddu bw’ebibi byaffe. Olwo yali Mununuzi waffe, kaakano agenda kuba Bulamu bwaffe. Olwo yatusika okutuggya mu kinnya. Kaakano agenda kututuuza mu bifo eby’omu ggulu wamu naye. Kino nkyogera nga nsinziira ku bujulizi obw’ebyo bye tuyitamu mu bulamu n’obw’ebikolebwa mu nkola. Mmanyi nti, mu by’enjigiriza y’eddiini ne mu mateeka, buli mukkiriza afuna buli kintu ku kukyuka kwe. Naye mu bulamu bw’ennyini, tewali kiba kikye okutuusa ng’akyetwalidde lwa kukkiriza. “Nga bwe nasuubiza Musa, buli we munaalinnyanga ekigere, mbawaddewo.” (Yoswa 1:3). “Yeebazibwe Katonda era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, atuwadde mu Kristo buli mukisa gwonna ogw’omwoyo oguva mu ggulu.” (Abaefeso 1:3). Naye okutuusa nga tubikkiriza, tebiba byaffe. “Olw’okukkiriza kwaffe,” bulijjo lye kkomo era lye tteeka. Naye okukkiriza kuno kwe njogerako kuteekwa okuba okukkiriza okwa kaakano. Tewali kukkiriza abantu kwe bakozesa mu biseera eby’omu maaso kugasa kintu kyonna. Omuntu ayinza okukkiriza emirembe gyonna nti ebibi bye birisonyiyibwa mu kiseera ekimu eky’omu maaso, n’atafuna mirembe n’akatono. Alina okutuuka ku kukkiriza okwa kaakano, n’agamba lwa kukkiriza nti, “Ebibi byange bisonyiyiddwa kaakano,” olwo n’asobola okubeera mu bulamu obuggya. Era bwe kityo, tewali kukkiriza kunoonya kuwonyezebwa kibi mu biseera eby’omu maaso kuyinza kutuusa mmeeme mu bulamu bwe tunnyonnyola. Omulabe asanyukira nnyo okukkiriza kuno okw’omu maaso. Amanyi nti tekulina maanyi kutuuka ku kintu kyonna. Naye akankana n’adduka omukkiriza bw’akakasa nti mwetwaze okuva mu buyinza bwe. Mu bufunze: okuyingira mu bulamu buno obw’omukisa obw’ekiwummulo n’obuwanguzi, olina okukwata emitendera ebiri. Ogusooka, weerekere ddala mu byonna. Ogwokubiri, beera n’okukkiriza okutaliiko kubuusabuusa. Ne bw’oba n’ebizibu ki, emitendera gino ebiri gijja kukuyamba. Bw’ogikwata era n’oginywererako, gijja kukutuusa mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo obusingako obulungi. Kino oyinza okukikakasa. Bw’onoolekayo ebirala byonna, n’ossa omwoyo ku nsonga zino ebbiri, ojja kukulaakulana mangu. Ojja kutuuka ku mwalo emmeeme yo gw’eyagala mangu okusinga bw’olowooza kaakano nti kisoboka. Nnyinza okuddamu emitendera gino, waleme kubaawo kukyamuka? Oli mwana wa Katonda, era weegomba okumusanyusa. Oyagala Omulokozi wo ow’omuwendo, era otamiddwa era okooye ekibi ekimunakuwaza. Weegomba omuntu okukununula okuva mu maanyi gaakyo. Byonna by’ogezezzaako biremye. Ng’oggwaamu essuubi, kaakano weebuuza oba, nga abantu bano abasanyufu bwe bagamba, Mukama asobola era ajja kukulokola. Omanyi mu mmeeme yo nti asobola. Okukulokola okuva mu balabe bo bonna kye kigendererwa kye. Kale mwesige. Mukwase ensonga yo. Leka ebirala byonna era kkiriza nti agitwala. Ng’omanyi bw’ali n’ebyo by’agambye, kakasa nti akuwa obulokozi obujjuvu kaakano. Mu kusooka, wakkiriza nti yakuwonya omusango gw’ekibi kubanga yagamba bw’atyo. Kaakano, kkiriza nti akuwonya amaanyi g’ekibi kubanga agamba bw’atyo. Okukkiriza kwo kaakano kukwate amaanyi amaggya mu Kristo. Wamwesiga ng’Omulokozi wo eyakufiirira, kaakano mwesige ng’Omulokozi wo omulamu. Nga bwe yajja okukununula okuva mu kubonerezebwa okw’omu maaso, teyajja era okukununula okuva mu buddu obwa kaakano? Nga bwe yajja okwetikka ebibi byo ku lulwo, bw’atyo azze okubeera n’obulamu bwe mu ggwe. Toliiko maanyi n’akatono mu mbeera zombi. Wandisobodde okwemalako ebibi byo bwe wandisobodde kaakano okwetuusaako obutuukirivu obw’omu bikolwa. Kristo, era Kristo yekka, y’ateekwa okukukolera byombi. Omugabo gwo kwe kumukwasa ensonga eyo, oluvannyuma n’okkiriza nti agikola. Omukyala omu, kaakano omututumufu, bwe yali mu kizikiza kinene, yali anoonya okuyingira. N’agamba mukwano gwe eyali agezaako okumuyamba nti, “Mwenna mugamba nti, ‘Weerekere ddala, era weesige.’ Naye simanyi bwe kikolebwa. Nandyagadde okikole mu ddoboozi eriwulikika, ndabe bw’okikola.” “Kale nkikole mu ddoboozi eriwulikika ku lulwo?” “Mukama Yesu, osobola era ojja kumponya mu bweraliikirivu bwonna n’ebizibu by’obulamu bwange obw’Ekikristaayo. Wafa okunfuula ow’eddembe, si mu biseera eby’omu maaso, wabula kaakano era wano. Oli wa maanyi okusinga Setaani. Osobola okunkuuma, ne mu bunafu bwange, nneme kugwa mu mitego gye wadde okumugondera. Era, Mukama, ngenda kukwesiga onkuume. Ngezezzaako okwekuuma nga ndi munywevu, ne nnemererwa, ne ngwa nnyo. Siriiko bwe nnyinza n’akatono; kale, nja kukwesiga kaakano. Neewaayo gy’oli; sirina kye nkweka. Omubiri, emmeeme, n’omwoyo, nneeweereza gy’oli, ekitole ky’ebbumba ekitaliiko mugaso. Mbumba okufuuka kyonna okwagala kwo n’amagezi go kye bisiima. Era kaakano, ndi wuwo. Okkiriza kye nkuwa. Amaanyi go gatutte omutima gwange omunafu era omusirusiru. Otandise okukola mu nze, ng’onjagazisa era ng’onsobozesa okukola by’osiima. Nkwesiga ddala, era nkwesiga kaakano!” Otya okukwata omutendera guno? Kirabika nga kya mangu nnyo, nga kufaanana okubuuka mu kizikiza? Tomanyi nti ebigere by’okukkiriza bulijjo “bigwa ku kirabika ng’ekifo ekyereere, naye ne bisanga olwazi wansi”? Omusajja, eyali alina okukka mu luzzi ng’akutte omuguwa, yazuula, ng’atidde nnyo, bwe yali amaze okukka wala, nti omuguwa mumpi. Yali atuuse ku nkomerero yaagwo, naye, nga bwe yateebereza, yali akyali nga ffuuti amakumi asatu okuva wansi mu luzzi. Teyamanya kya kukola. Teyalina maanyi wadde obukugu okulinnya ng’ayita ku muguwa, era okuguta kwandimubetentedde. Emikono gye ne gitandika okuggwaamu amaanyi. N’asalawo okuguta n’ayolekagana n’ekyo ekimulindiridde. N’akkiriza okuzikirira, n’ataayo omuguwa. N’agwa! Wansi mu luzzi waali — yinci ssatu zokka! Bw’oba ng’ebigere byo birina okukwata ku “lwazi wansi,” oteekwa okuta buli ky’okutte ne weesuula mu Katonda. Kubanga tewali kkubo ddala. Era okukikola kaakano kuyinza okukuwonya emyezi, era n’emyaka, egy’okufuba n’obukoowu. Mu bigo byonna eby’edda ebya Bungereza waabangawo ekifo ekyayitibwanga ekiddukiro eky’omunda. Kye kyali ekifo ekisingayo amaanyi n’obukuumi mu kigo. Kyakwekanga abanafu n’abatalina bwe bayinza mu biseera eby’akabi. Singa wali mukyala atiitiibwa era atalina bw’ayinza mu kigo ekizingiziddwa, wandyetantadde okwekweka omwo? Wandityeyo okukikola? Tuteekwa okutya okwekweka mu maanyi ag’obukuumi ag’Omukuumi waffe ow’obwakatonda? Taabongootenga so teyeebakenga. Yasuubiza okukuuma amagenda gaffe n’amadda gaffe, okuva leero n’okutuusa emirembe gyonna.

fields.title: Ebizibu Ebikwata ku Kwewaayo
fields.body_html:
Abakristaayo bateekwa okumanya enkwe z’omulabe. Ajja kuziyiza buli ddaala emmeeme ly’etuuka mu kukula kwayo. Era okusingira ddala, akola nnyo bw’alaba omukkiriza ng’azuukusiddwa n’atandika okuyoya obutuukirivu. Abakkiriza ng’abo baagala okukwata obujjuvu bwonna obuli mu Mukama Yesu Kristo. Ekimu ku bizibu ebisooka by’abateeka mu kkubo kikwata ku kwewaayo. Oyo anoonya obutukuvu alagirwa okwewaayo eri Mukama. Agezaako okukikola. Naye amangu ago asanga ekizibu. Akikoze, nga bw’alowooza. Kyokka tawulira nga waliwo ekikyuse mu ye.

Tewali kirabika nga kikyuse nga bwe yali asuubira. Asoberwa, era mu kuggwaamu essuubi n’abuuza nti, “Nnaamanya ntya nti nneewaddeyo?”

Wano okukemebwa okusinga obunene kwe kwesigama ku kuwulira. Bulijjo kufuba okwekuba ku mwanjo, era emirundi mingi kutuuka ku kye kyagala.

Emmeeme tesobola kukkiriza nti yeewaddeyo okutuusa ng’ewulidde okwewaayo okwo. Tesobola kukkiriza nti Katonda agitutte, kubanga tekiwulira. Nga bulijjo, essa okuwulira mu kifo ekisooka n’okukkiriza mu kyokubiri. Naye etteeka lya Katonda lyangu: okukkiriza kusooka, okuwulira ne kuddako, mu bintu byonna. Tekirina kye kigasa okugezaako okulikyusa.

Okusobola okulwanyisa okukemebwa kuno okukwata ku kwewaayo, beera ku ludda lwa Katonda. Teeka okukkiriza mu maaso g’okuwulira. Weewaayo ddala eri Mukama mu bujjuvu, nga tolina ky’osigaza. Kozesa okutegeera kw’olina kaakano. Saba Omwoyo Omutukuvu akubikkulire buli kintu ekiri mu mutima gwo oba mu bulamu bwo ekikontana ne Katonda. Bw’akulaga ekintu kyonna, kiwe Mukama amangu ago, era ogambe ku kyo nti, “ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa.” Bw’atakulaga kintu kyonna, olwo oteekwa okukkiriza nti tewali kintu, era oteekwa okumaliriza nti omuwadde byonna. Olwo oteekwa okukkiriza nti akutwala. Tolindanga kuwulira nti weewaddeyo oba nti akutwadde. Oteekwa bukkiriza bwokka, n’okitwala nga bwe kiri.

Singa wali ow’okuwa mukwano gwo ettaka, ggwe wandibadde okuliwaayo, ye n’aliweebwa lwa kukkiriza. Tewali ayinza kukwasa munne ttaka mu ngalo. Okuliwaayo n’okuliweebwa nsonga ya mu birowoozo, era bwe kityo nsonga ya kukkiriza. Singa wawa mukwano gwo ettaka ku lunaku olumu, oyinza okwebuuza oba ddala waliwaddeyo, era oba yalitwala. Olwo oyinza okuwulira ng’oyagala okuddamu okuliwaayo enkeera. Bwe wandisigadde ng’okyabuusabuusa ku lunaku olwokusatu, wandiddamu nate okuliwaayo. Wandikoze bw’otyo buli lunaku okumala emyezi oba emyaka.

Mukwano gwo yandirowoozezza ki? Era ebirowoozo byo byandibadde bitya oluvannyuma lw’ebyo byonna?

Mukwano gwo yandibuusabuusizza oba ddala wali omuwa. Ggwe wandibadde otabuddwatabuddwa nnyo nga tokyamanyi oba ettaka lyo, lirye, oba lya muntu mulala. Kale, kino si kye kyennyini ky’obadde okola eri Katonda mu nsonga eno ey’okwewaayo? Omaze emyezi ng’omwewaayo buli lunaku. Naye buli lwe wamalanga, wewuunyanga oba ddala wamwewaayo, era oba yakukkiriza. Olw’okuba tewawulira nga waliwo ekikyuse, n’omaliriza, oluvannyuma lw’okubuusabuusa okungi, nti tekyakolebwa.

Omukkiriza omwagalwa, okutabulwa kuno kujja kubeerawo emirembe gyonna okuggyako ng’okukomezza n’okukkiriza. Oteekwa okutwala ensonga eno ng’ewedde. Olwo lw’oyinza okusuubira enkyukakyuka mu kuwulira. Etteeka ery’ebiweebwayo eri Mukama liraga nti buli ekimuweebwa kifuuka kitukuvu. Kyawulibwa, era tekiyinza kukozesebwa mu kigendererwa kirala. Okukikozesa bw’otyo kwandibadde kunyooma.

“Buli kintu ekiwongere ddala, gamba oba muntu oba kisolo, kinaabanga kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda. “Tewaabengawo ku bintu ebyo bitundibwa oba okununulibwa.

Abayisirayiri bwe baamalanga okuwongera Mukama ekintu, baakitwalanga nga kya Mukama.” Tewali yagezangako kukiddizaawo. Oyo eyakiwaayo ayinza okuba nga yakiwaayo nga talina mwoyo gukyagala, era nga talina bunyiikivu. Naye bwe yamalanga okukiwaayo, ensonga yali evudde mu mikono gye. Olw’etteeka lya Katonda yennyini, ekirabo kyafuukanga “kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda..””

Tekyali kigendererwa ky’oyo awaayo ekyakifuulanga ekitukuvu, wabula obutukuvu bw’oyo akiweebwa. Kiri nga bwe kyogerwa ku “ekyoto kyennyini ekifuula ekirabo ekyo okuba ekitukuvu.” Era ekiweebwayo bwe kyamalanga okuteekebwa ku kyoto, okuva mu kaseera ako kyabanga kya Mukama.

Nsobola okulowooza ku muntu eyali amaze okuwaayo ekirabo. Oluvannyuma ayinza okubuusabuusa oba yali wa mazima era mwesimbu mu kukikola. Yandiddiddeyo eri kabona, ng’aweddemu emirembe olw’obwesimbu bwe. Nkakasa nti kabona yandimusirisizza amangu ago. Yandimugambye nti, “Simanyi kigendererwa kyo mu kuwaayo ekiweebwayo kyo.”

Ekituufu kiri nti wakiwaayo ddala, era nti kya Mukama, kubanga buli kintu ekiwongere kitukuvu nnyo gy’ali. “Kaakano kikeerezi okuddizaayo ekyakolebwa.” Abayisirayiri bonna, so si kabona yekka, bandyewuunyizza nnyo omuntu eyamala okuwaayo ekirabo kye n’agezaako okukiddizaayo. Kyokka buli lunaku Abakristaayo abanyiikivu, abandikankanye olw’obunyoomi bw’Omuyudaaya oyo, bakola ekikolwa ekifaananako bwe kityo. Beewaayo eri Mukama, ate ne beddizaayo olw’obutakkiriza. Olw’okuba Katonda talabika na maaso, kizibu okuwulira nti kye tukola naye kya ddala.

Singa twali tusobola okumulaba bwe twali twewaayo, kyandiwulikise nga kya ddala. Twandimanyi nti twawaayo ekigambo kyaffe era nti tetusobola kukiddizaayo, ne bwe twandyagadde nnyo okukikola. Kyanditubaddeko obuzito bw’ekisuubizo kye twogedde eri mukwano gwaffe ow’oku nsi. Ekisuubizo ng’ekyo bulijjo kiba n’obuzito obwo eri omuntu ow’ekitiibwa.

Twetaaga okulaba nti okubeerawo kwa Katonda bulijjo kintu kikakafu. Buli kikolwa ky’emmeeme yaffe kikolebwa mu maaso ge ddala. Ekigambo kye twogera mu kusaba kiba kyogeddwa gy’ali ddala, nga bwe kyandibadde singa amaaso gaffe gaali gamulaba n’emikono gyaffe nga gimukwatako.

Olwo tetujja kuddamu kubeera na ndowooza zitategeerekeka bulungi ku nkolagana yaffe naye. Tujja kuwulira obuzito bwa buli kigambo kye twogera mu maaso ge. Mmanyi nti abamu bajja kugamba nti, “Ayi, kituufu. “Naye singa yandyogedde nange n’aŋŋamba nti yantwala bwe nneewaayo gy’ali, olwo nnandikikkirizza.”

“Nedda, ddala tewandikikkirizza. Naye bulijjo tayogera bw’atyo okutuusa ng’emmeeme esoose kulaga obwesigwa bwayo ng’ekkiriza ekyo ky’amaze okwogera. Oyo akkiriza y’alina obujulirwa, so si oyo eyabuusabuusa. Era olw’ekiragiro kye kyennyini gye tuli okwewaayo gy’ali nga ssaddaaka ennamu, yeeyama okututwala.

Siyinza kulowooza ku muntu ow’ekitiibwa asaba munne okumuwa ekintu ng’ate abuusabuusa okukitwala. Era siyinza n’akatono kulowooza ku muzadde ow’okwagala akola bw’atyo eri omwana we omwagalwa. “Mwana wange mpa omutima gwo, n’amaaso go geekalirize amakubo gange.” Engero 23:26. Kino kye kitukakasa ddala. Kitegeeza nti omutima bwe guweebwayo, mu kaseera ako kennyini gutwalibwa Oyo eyalagira guweebwe. Kale, tuteekwa okuba n’obwesige obusingirayo ddala. Bwe twewaayo eri Mukama, nga bw’alagira, olwo atutwala. Okuva mu kaseera ako tuli babe.

Waliwo ekintu ekya ddala ekikoleddwa. Tekiyinza kumenyebwa awatali kuweebuuka ku ludda lwaffe. Era tumanyi nti ye tajja kukimenya. Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 26:17-19 walaga engeri Katonda gy’akolamu: “Ku lunaku lwa leero oyatudde nga Mukama bw’ali Katonda wo, era nga naawe bw’onootambuliranga mu makubo ge, era ng’onookuumanga ebiragiro bye n’amateeka ge gonna, era ng’onoomugonderanga. Ku lunaku lwa leero Mukama alangiridde nga bw’oli owuwe, eggwanga lye ku bubwe ery’omuwendo omungi nga bwe yasuubiza, era nga ojjanga kukwatanga ebiragiro bye byonna. Alangiridde nga bw’anaakujjuzanga ettendo n’okwatiikirira n’ekitiibwa okusukkirira amawanga gonna ge yatonda, era ng’olibeera eggwanga ettukuvu eri Mukama Katonda wo, nga bwe yasuubiza.”

Tulangirira nti Mukama ye Katonda waffe. Tujja kutambulira mu makubo ge era tukuume ebiragiro bye. Ye alangirira nti tuli babe, era nti tuteekwa okukuuma ebiragiro bye byonna. Era okuva mu kaseera ako, atufuula babe. Eno ye ngeri gye yakolangamu bulijjo, era bw’atyo bw’akyakola. Kubanga “buli kintu ekiwongere ddala mu ngeri eyo kinaabanga kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda.” Kino kyeyoleka bulungi nnyo nti tekirina kye kibuusibwabuusibwako. Naye bw’oba okyabuusabuusa, ka nkulage ekigambo ekiri mu Ndagaano Empya. Kitunuulira ensonga eno mu ngeri endala, naye, nga bwe ndowooza, kigimalirawo ddala. Kiri mu 1 Yokaana 5:14-15, era kigamba nti: “Noolwekyo tulina obuvumu nti bwe tugenda gy’ali ne tumusaba ekintu kyonna, ye nga bw’asiima atuwulira. Era bwe tutegeera nti atuwulira bwe tumusaba, buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa.”

Kiri mu kwagala kwa Katonda ggwe okumwewaayo ddala? Wayinza okubaawo okuddamu kumu kwokka, kubanga yakiragira. Era tekiri mu kwagala kwe okukola mu ggwe okwagala n’okukola by’asiima? N’ekibuuzo kino kirina okuddamu kumu kwokka, kubanga yalangirira nti kye kigendererwa kye. Kale omanyi nti ebintu bino biri mu kwagala kwe. N’olwekyo, ng’osinziira ku kigambo kya Katonda, oteekwa okumanya nti akuwulira. Kaakano oteekwa okweyongerayo. Oteekwa okumanya nti olina ebyo bye wamusaba.

Nziramu nti olina — so si nti olibifuna, oba oyinza okubifuna, wabula olina kaakano, nga biri mu mikono gyo ddala. Bwe tutyo bwe “tufuna ebyasuubizibwa” olw’okukkiriza. Era bwe tutyo bwe tuyingira mu kisa ekyatuweebwa mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, kubanga “olw’okukkiriza mu Kristo tufunye ekisa kya Katonda mwe tubeera.” Mu kino mwokka mwe tumanyira nti emitima gyaffe “ginaazibwa olw’okukkiriza.”

Olwo tusobola okubeera abalamu, okuyimirira, n’okutambula olw’okukkiriza. Njagala ensonga eno ngitegeeze bulungi era mu ngeri ey’omugaso, waleme kubaawo n’omu agyongera kugibonaabonamu. Kale, ka nzireemu okwogera ebyo emmeeme yo by’eteekwa okukola okumalawo okubuusabuusa kwo ku kwewaayo.

Nsuubira nti okkiririza mu Mukama Yesu okukusonyiwa ebibi byo. Nsuubira nti omanyi kye kitegeeza okubeera mu maka ga Katonda, n’okubeera omusika wa Katonda olw’okukkiriza Kristo. Era kaakano owulira okwegomba nga kumera mu mmeeme yo, okufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi kya Mukama wo. Oteekwa okumwewaayo ddala mu bujjuvu.

Olwo lw’ayinza okukola mu ggwe byonna by’asiima mu kwagala kwe. Ogezezzaako okukola kino, naye n’otatuuka ku buwanguzi. Kaakano njagala okukuyamba. Kaakano oteekwa okuddayo gy’ali nate. Weewaayo mwenna eri by’ayagala, mu bujjuvu nga bw’osobola.

Oteekwa okumusaba akulage, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we, obujeemu bwonna obukwekeddwa. Bw’atakubikkulira kintu, kkiriza nti tewali. Okwewaayo kwo kujjuvu. Kale, tuteekwa okutwala ensonga eno ng’ewedde. Weewaddeyo ddala eri Mukama. Okuva kaakano tokyali wuwo. Towulirizanga kirowoozo kyonna ekikontana n’ekyo. Bw’oyebuuza oba weewaayo ddala, kakasa nti weewaayo. Era ensonga eyo togiwakaanyangako n’akatono.

Kigobe kirowoozo ng’ekyo kyonna awatali kulonzalonza, era n’obumalirivu obunywevu.

Wakitegeeza ddala mu kiseera ekyo, okitegeeza ne kaakano, era okikoze. Enneewulira zo ziyinza okulekaana nga ziwakanya okwewaayo kwo, naye okusalawo kwo kuteekwa okunywera. Katonda atunuulira ekigendererwa kyo, so si by’owulira ku kyo. N’olwekyo okusalawo kwo kwe kwokka kw’oteekwa okufaako. Bw’omala okwewaayo, tokibuusabuusanga era tokiddizangayo. Ekiddako, kkiriza nti Katonda atwala ekyo ky’omuwadde. Kitwale nti kikye. Si nti kiriba kikye mu biseera eby’omu maaso, wabula nti kikye kaakano; era nti atandise okukola mu ggwe okwagala n’okukola by’asiima. Era wano w’oteekwa okuwummulira. Tolina kirala kya kukola. Kaakano oli wa Mukama, ddala mu mikono gye. Yeetisse obuvunaanyizibwa obw’okukulabirira n’okukulung’amya. Era, nga ekigambo kye bwe kigamba, alikukozesa “ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo.”

Naye wano oteekwa okunyweza ennyo. Bw’obuusabuusa okwewaayo kwo, oba nti Katonda akkiriza okwewaayo okwo, okukkiriza kwo kujja kusagaasagana. Okukkiriza okusagaasagana kujja kuleeta obulamu obw’omwoyo obutali bunywevu, era ye tasobola kukola. Naye bw’oba weesiga nti akola, omulimu gwe gukukyusa. Gukufuula okufaanana Kristo okusingawo, okuva mu kitiibwa okutuuka mu kitiibwa, olw’Omwoyo we ow’amaanyi. Kale kaakano, mu kaseera kano, weewaayo ddala gy’ali? Oddamu nti, yee. Olwo, mukwano gwange omwagalwa, kitwale nti oli wuwe. Akutwadde. Akola mu ggwe okwagala n’okukola by’asiima. Era weeyongere okukitwala bw’otyo.

Kijja kukuyamba okuteeka ebirowoozo byo mu bigambo. Weegambe era gamba ne Katonda nti, “Mukama, ndi wuwo. Nkwewaayo, era nkkiriza nti ddala onzitwala.” Nneerekera gy’oli. “Kola mu nze byonna by’osiima mu kwagala kwo. Nja kugalamira bugalamizi mu mikono gyo, era nkwesige.” Kino kifuule ekikolwa ky’okusalawo kwo ekya buli lunaku.

Emirundi mingi buli lunaku, kiddangamu ng’endowooza yo ey’olubeerera mu maaso ge. Kyeyatulire. Kyatule eri Katonda wo. Kyatule eri mikwano gyo. Bulijjo langirira nti Mukama ye Katonda wo. Weeyame okutambulira mu makubo ge n’okukuuma amateeka ge.

Olwo ojja kukizuula nti akulangiridde okuba owuwe ku bubwe. Oteekwa okukuuma ebiragiro bye byonna, n’oba “eggwanga ettukuvu eri Mukama Katonda wo, nga bwe yasuubiza.”

Wano oyinza okusanga amateeka matono amangu nga gakuyamba. Nkuwabula ogakozesenga mu biseera byo eby’okusaba ebya buli lunaku. Gagezesenga emmeeme okutuusa lwe tutegeerera ddala ensonga eno.

I. Langirira lwatu okukkiriza kwo mu Kristo ng’Omulokozi wo. Era yatula nti okkiriza nti akutabaganyizza ne Katonda, nga bwe kiri mu 2 Abakkolinso 5:18-19 “Ebintu byonna biva eri Katonda eyatukomyawo gy’ali nga tuyita mu Kristo, era ne tuweebwa obuweereza obw’okutabaganya. Kubanga Katonda yali mu Kristo, ng’atabagana n’abantu, nga tababalira, bibi byabwe, n’atuteresa ffe obubaka obw’okutabaganya.”

II. Mu ngeri etebuusibwabuusibwa, yatula nti Katonda ye Kitaawo. Oli mwana we gwe yanunula era gwe yasonyiwa, nga bwe kiri mu Abaggalatiya 4:5, “okununula abo abaali bafugibwa amateeka, tulyoke tufuuke abaana.”

III. Weewaayo ddala eri Mukama, omubiri, emmeeme, n’omwoyo. Mugonderenga mu buli kintu ky’omanyi nti ky’ayagala, nga bwe kiri mu Abaruumi 12:12. “nga musanyukira mu kusuubira, nga mugumiikiriza mu kubonaabona era nga munyiikira mu kusaba.”

IV. Kkiriza, ne bwe kiba nti byonna biraga ebirala, nti Katonda atwala ekyo ky’omuwaayo. Ajja kukola mu ggwe, okuggyako ng’olemesa ekisa kye. Laba 2 Abakkolinso 6:17-18 “Noolwekyo “muve wakati mu bo, mubeeyawuleko, bw’ayogera Mukama. Temukwata ku bitali birongoofu, nange nnaabaaniriza.” Era “nnaabeeranga Kitammwe, nammwe ne mubeeranga batabani bange ne bawala bange,” bw’ayogera Mukama Ayinzabyonna.” , ne Abafiripi 2:13. “Kubanga Katonda yakolera mu mmwe, era yabaagazisa n’abasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, olw’okumusanyusa.”

V. Tokozesanga nneewulira zo okugezesa enkolagana yo ne Katonda. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, ssa omwoyo ku kusalawo kwo n’okukkiriza kwo.

Era ebiddaala bino byonna by’otwala kaakano bitwale nga biwedde, newakubadde omulabe ayinza okubifuula okulabika obulala. Abaebbulaniya 10:22-23. “tusembere awali Katonda n’omwoyo ogw’amazima ogujjudde okukkiriza nga tulina emitima egitukuzibbwa okuva mu ndowooza embi, era nga n’emibiri gyaffe ginaazibbwa n’amazzi amatukuvu.

Kale tunyweze essuubi lye twatula nga tetusagaasagana, kubanga eyasuubiza mwesigwa.”

VI. Tobuusabuusanga, era toggwangamu maanyi, mu mbeera yonna. Jjukira nti okuggwaamu amaanyi kwonna kuva eri Setaani, era gaana okukukkiriza; nga bwe kiri mu Yokaana 14:1 “Omutima gwammwe tegweraliikiriranga. Mukkiriza Katonda, era nange munzikirize.” olunyiriri 27 “Mbalekera emirembe, era mbawa emirembe gyange. Emirembe gye mbawa tegiringa egy’ensi. Noolwekyo temutyanga era temweraliikiriranga.”

VII. Kulaakulanya empisa ey’okwatula okukkiriza kwo mu bigambo ebitegeerekeka. Ddiŋŋananga emirundi mingi nti, “Ndi wa Mukama ddala.

Kaakano akola mu nze okwagala n’okukola by’asiima,” nga bwe kiri mu Abaebbulaniya 13:21 “abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe.

Amiina.
fields.body_text: Abakristaayo bateekwa okumanya enkwe z’omulabe. Ajja kuziyiza buli ddaala emmeeme ly’etuuka mu kukula kwayo. Era okusingira ddala, akola nnyo bw’alaba omukkiriza ng’azuukusiddwa n’atandika okuyoya obutuukirivu. Abakkiriza ng’abo baagala okukwata obujjuvu bwonna obuli mu Mukama Yesu Kristo. Ekimu ku bizibu ebisooka by’abateeka mu kkubo kikwata ku kwewaayo. Oyo anoonya obutukuvu alagirwa okwewaayo eri Mukama. Agezaako okukikola. Naye amangu ago asanga ekizibu. Akikoze, nga bw’alowooza. Kyokka tawulira nga waliwo ekikyuse mu ye. Tewali kirabika nga kikyuse nga bwe yali asuubira. Asoberwa, era mu kuggwaamu essuubi n’abuuza nti, “Nnaamanya ntya nti nneewaddeyo?” Wano okukemebwa okusinga obunene kwe kwesigama ku kuwulira. Bulijjo kufuba okwekuba ku mwanjo, era emirundi mingi kutuuka ku kye kyagala. Emmeeme tesobola kukkiriza nti yeewaddeyo okutuusa ng’ewulidde okwewaayo okwo. Tesobola kukkiriza nti Katonda agitutte, kubanga tekiwulira. Nga bulijjo, essa okuwulira mu kifo ekisooka n’okukkiriza mu kyokubiri. Naye etteeka lya Katonda lyangu: okukkiriza kusooka, okuwulira ne kuddako, mu bintu byonna. Tekirina kye kigasa okugezaako okulikyusa. Okusobola okulwanyisa okukemebwa kuno okukwata ku kwewaayo, beera ku ludda lwa Katonda. Teeka okukkiriza mu maaso g’okuwulira. Weewaayo ddala eri Mukama mu bujjuvu, nga tolina ky’osigaza. Kozesa okutegeera kw’olina kaakano. Saba Omwoyo Omutukuvu akubikkulire buli kintu ekiri mu mutima gwo oba mu bulamu bwo ekikontana ne Katonda. Bw’akulaga ekintu kyonna, kiwe Mukama amangu ago, era ogambe ku kyo nti, “ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa.” Bw’atakulaga kintu kyonna, olwo oteekwa okukkiriza nti tewali kintu, era oteekwa okumaliriza nti omuwadde byonna. Olwo oteekwa okukkiriza nti akutwala. Tolindanga kuwulira nti weewaddeyo oba nti akutwadde. Oteekwa bukkiriza bwokka, n’okitwala nga bwe kiri. Singa wali ow’okuwa mukwano gwo ettaka, ggwe wandibadde okuliwaayo, ye n’aliweebwa lwa kukkiriza. Tewali ayinza kukwasa munne ttaka mu ngalo. Okuliwaayo n’okuliweebwa nsonga ya mu birowoozo, era bwe kityo nsonga ya kukkiriza. Singa wawa mukwano gwo ettaka ku lunaku olumu, oyinza okwebuuza oba ddala waliwaddeyo, era oba yalitwala. Olwo oyinza okuwulira ng’oyagala okuddamu okuliwaayo enkeera. Bwe wandisigadde ng’okyabuusabuusa ku lunaku olwokusatu, wandiddamu nate okuliwaayo. Wandikoze bw’otyo buli lunaku okumala emyezi oba emyaka. Mukwano gwo yandirowoozezza ki? Era ebirowoozo byo byandibadde bitya oluvannyuma lw’ebyo byonna? Mukwano gwo yandibuusabuusizza oba ddala wali omuwa. Ggwe wandibadde otabuddwatabuddwa nnyo nga tokyamanyi oba ettaka lyo, lirye, oba lya muntu mulala. Kale, kino si kye kyennyini ky’obadde okola eri Katonda mu nsonga eno ey’okwewaayo? Omaze emyezi ng’omwewaayo buli lunaku. Naye buli lwe wamalanga, wewuunyanga oba ddala wamwewaayo, era oba yakukkiriza. Olw’okuba tewawulira nga waliwo ekikyuse, n’omaliriza, oluvannyuma lw’okubuusabuusa okungi, nti tekyakolebwa. Omukkiriza omwagalwa, okutabulwa kuno kujja kubeerawo emirembe gyonna okuggyako ng’okukomezza n’okukkiriza. Oteekwa okutwala ensonga eno ng’ewedde. Olwo lw’oyinza okusuubira enkyukakyuka mu kuwulira. Etteeka ery’ebiweebwayo eri Mukama liraga nti buli ekimuweebwa kifuuka kitukuvu. Kyawulibwa, era tekiyinza kukozesebwa mu kigendererwa kirala. Okukikozesa bw’otyo kwandibadde kunyooma. “Buli kintu ekiwongere ddala, gamba oba muntu oba kisolo, kinaabanga kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda. “Tewaabengawo ku bintu ebyo bitundibwa oba okununulibwa. Abayisirayiri bwe baamalanga okuwongera Mukama ekintu, baakitwalanga nga kya Mukama.” Tewali yagezangako kukiddizaawo. Oyo eyakiwaayo ayinza okuba nga yakiwaayo nga talina mwoyo gukyagala, era nga talina bunyiikivu. Naye bwe yamalanga okukiwaayo, ensonga yali evudde mu mikono gye. Olw’etteeka lya Katonda yennyini, ekirabo kyafuukanga “kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda..”” Tekyali kigendererwa ky’oyo awaayo ekyakifuulanga ekitukuvu, wabula obutukuvu bw’oyo akiweebwa. Kiri nga bwe kyogerwa ku “ekyoto kyennyini ekifuula ekirabo ekyo okuba ekitukuvu.” Era ekiweebwayo bwe kyamalanga okuteekebwa ku kyoto, okuva mu kaseera ako kyabanga kya Mukama. Nsobola okulowooza ku muntu eyali amaze okuwaayo ekirabo. Oluvannyuma ayinza okubuusabuusa oba yali wa mazima era mwesimbu mu kukikola. Yandiddiddeyo eri kabona, ng’aweddemu emirembe olw’obwesimbu bwe. Nkakasa nti kabona yandimusirisizza amangu ago. Yandimugambye nti, “Simanyi kigendererwa kyo mu kuwaayo ekiweebwayo kyo.” Ekituufu kiri nti wakiwaayo ddala, era nti kya Mukama, kubanga buli kintu ekiwongere kitukuvu nnyo gy’ali. “Kaakano kikeerezi okuddizaayo ekyakolebwa.” Abayisirayiri bonna, so si kabona yekka, bandyewuunyizza nnyo omuntu eyamala okuwaayo ekirabo kye n’agezaako okukiddizaayo. Kyokka buli lunaku Abakristaayo abanyiikivu, abandikankanye olw’obunyoomi bw’Omuyudaaya oyo, bakola ekikolwa ekifaananako bwe kityo. Beewaayo eri Mukama, ate ne beddizaayo olw’obutakkiriza. Olw’okuba Katonda talabika na maaso, kizibu okuwulira nti kye tukola naye kya ddala. Singa twali tusobola okumulaba bwe twali twewaayo, kyandiwulikise nga kya ddala. Twandimanyi nti twawaayo ekigambo kyaffe era nti tetusobola kukiddizaayo, ne bwe twandyagadde nnyo okukikola. Kyanditubaddeko obuzito bw’ekisuubizo kye twogedde eri mukwano gwaffe ow’oku nsi. Ekisuubizo ng’ekyo bulijjo kiba n’obuzito obwo eri omuntu ow’ekitiibwa. Twetaaga okulaba nti okubeerawo kwa Katonda bulijjo kintu kikakafu. Buli kikolwa ky’emmeeme yaffe kikolebwa mu maaso ge ddala. Ku lunaku lwa leero Mukama alangiridde nga bw’oli owuwe, eggwanga lye ku bubwe ery’omuwendo omungi nga bwe yasuubiza, era nga ojjanga kukwatanga ebiragiro bye byonna. Alangiridde nga bw’anaakujjuzanga ettendo n’okwatiikirira n’ekitiibwa okusukkirira amawanga gonna ge yatonda, era ng’olibeera eggwanga ettukuvu eri Mukama Katonda wo, nga bwe yasuubiza.” Tulangirira nti Mukama ye Katonda waffe. Tujja kutambulira mu makubo ge era tukuume ebiragiro bye. Ye alangirira nti tuli babe, era nti tuteekwa okukuuma ebiragiro bye byonna. Era okuva mu kaseera ako, atufuula babe. Eno ye ngeri gye yakolangamu bulijjo, era bw’atyo bw’akyakola. Kubanga “buli kintu ekiwongere ddala mu ngeri eyo kinaabanga kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda.” Kino kyeyoleka bulungi nnyo nti tekirina kye kibuusibwabuusibwako. Naye bw’oba okyabuusabuusa, ka nkulage ekigambo ekiri mu Ndagaano Empya. Kitunuulira ensonga eno mu ngeri endala, naye, nga bwe ndowooza, kigimalirawo ddala. Kiri mu 1 Yokaana 5:14-15, era kigamba nti: “Noolwekyo tulina obuvumu nti bwe tugenda gy’ali ne tumusaba ekintu kyonna, ye nga bw’asiima atuwulira. Era bwe tutegeera nti atuwulira bwe tumusaba, buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa.” Kiri mu kwagala kwa Katonda ggwe okumwewaayo ddala? Wayinza okubaawo okuddamu kumu kwokka, kubanga yakiragira. Era tekiri mu kwagala kwe okukola mu ggwe okwagala n’okukola by’asiima? N’ekibuuzo kino kirina okuddamu kumu kwokka, kubanga yalangirira nti kye kigendererwa kye. Kale omanyi nti ebintu bino biri mu kwagala kwe. N’olwekyo, ng’osinziira ku kigambo kya Katonda, oteekwa okumanya nti akuwulira. Kaakano oteekwa okweyongerayo. Oteekwa okumanya nti olina ebyo bye wamusaba. Nziramu nti olina — so si nti olibifuna, oba oyinza okubifuna, wabula olina kaakano, nga biri mu mikono gyo ddala. Bwe tutyo bwe “tufuna ebyasuubizibwa” olw’okukkiriza. Era bwe tutyo bwe tuyingira mu kisa ekyatuweebwa mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, kubanga “olw’okukkiriza mu Kristo tufunye ekisa kya Katonda mwe tubeera.” Mu kino mwokka mwe tumanyira nti emitima gyaffe “ginaazibwa olw’okukkiriza.” Olwo tusobola okubeera abalamu, okuyimirira, n’okutambula olw’okukkiriza. Njagala ensonga eno ngitegeeze bulungi era mu ngeri ey’omugaso, waleme kubaawo n’omu agyongera kugibonaabonamu. Kale, ka nzireemu okwogera ebyo emmeeme yo by’eteekwa okukola okumalawo okubuusabuusa kwo ku kwewaayo. Nsuubira nti okkiririza mu Mukama Yesu okukusonyiwa ebibi byo. Nsuubira nti omanyi kye kitegeeza okubeera mu maka ga Katonda, n’okubeera omusika wa Katonda olw’okukkiriza Kristo. Era kaakano owulira okwegomba nga kumera mu mmeeme yo, okufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi kya Mukama wo. Oteekwa okumwewaayo ddala mu bujjuvu. Olwo lw’ayinza okukola mu ggwe byonna by’asiima mu kwagala kwe. Ogezezzaako okukola kino, naye n’otatuuka ku buwanguzi. Kaakano njagala okukuyamba. Kaakano oteekwa okuddayo gy’ali nate. Weewaayo mwenna eri by’ayagala, mu bujjuvu nga bw’osobola. Oteekwa okumusaba akulage, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we, obujeemu bwonna obukwekeddwa. Bw’atakubikkulira kintu, kkiriza nti tewali. Okwewaayo kwo kujjuvu. Kale, tuteekwa okutwala ensonga eno ng’ewedde. Weewaddeyo ddala eri Mukama. Okuva kaakano tokyali wuwo. Towulirizanga kirowoozo kyonna ekikontana n’ekyo. Bw’oyebuuza oba weewaayo ddala, kakasa nti weewaayo. Era ensonga eyo togiwakaanyangako n’akatono. Kigobe kirowoozo ng’ekyo kyonna awatali kulonzalonza, era n’obumalirivu obunywevu. Wakitegeeza ddala mu kiseera ekyo, okitegeeza ne kaakano, era okikoze. Enneewulira zo ziyinza okulekaana nga ziwakanya okwewaayo kwo, naye okusalawo kwo kuteekwa okunywera. Katonda atunuulira ekigendererwa kyo, so si by’owulira ku kyo. N’olwekyo okusalawo kwo kwe kwokka kw’oteekwa okufaako. Bw’omala okwewaayo, tokibuusabuusanga era tokiddizangayo. Ekiddako, kkiriza nti Katonda atwala ekyo ky’omuwadde. Kitwale nti kikye. Si nti kiriba kikye mu biseera eby’omu maaso, wabula nti kikye kaakano; era nti atandise okukola mu ggwe okwagala n’okukola by’asiima. Era wano w’oteekwa okuwummulira. Tolina kirala kya kukola. Kaakano oli wa Mukama, ddala mu mikono gye. Yeetisse obuvunaanyizibwa obw’okukulabirira n’okukulung’amya. Era, nga ekigambo kye bwe kigamba, alikukozesa “ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo.” Naye wano oteekwa okunyweza ennyo. Bw’obuusabuusa okwewaayo kwo, oba nti Katonda akkiriza okwewaayo okwo, okukkiriza kwo kujja kusagaasagana. Okukkiriza okusagaasagana kujja kuleeta obulamu obw’omwoyo obutali bunywevu, era ye tasobola kukola. Naye bw’oba weesiga nti akola, omulimu gwe gukukyusa. Gukufuula okufaanana Kristo okusingawo, okuva mu kitiibwa okutuuka mu kitiibwa, olw’Omwoyo we ow’amaanyi. Kale kaakano, mu kaseera kano, weewaayo ddala gy’ali? Oddamu nti, yee. Olwo, mukwano gwange omwagalwa, kitwale nti oli wuwe. Akutwadde. Akola mu ggwe okwagala n’okukola by’asiima. Era weeyongere okukitwala bw’otyo. Kijja kukuyamba okuteeka ebirowoozo byo mu bigambo. Weegambe era gamba ne Katonda nti, “Mukama, ndi wuwo. Nkwewaayo, era nkkiriza nti ddala onzitwala.” Nneerekera gy’oli. “Kola mu nze byonna by’osiima mu kwagala kwo. Nja kugalamira bugalamizi mu mikono gyo, era nkwesige.” Kino kifuule ekikolwa ky’okusalawo kwo ekya buli lunaku. Emirundi mingi buli lunaku, kiddangamu ng’endowooza yo ey’olubeerera mu maaso ge. Kyeyatulire. Kyatule eri Katonda wo. Kyatule eri mikwano gyo. Bulijjo langirira nti Mukama ye Katonda wo. Weeyame okutambulira mu makubo ge n’okukuuma amateeka ge. Olwo ojja kukizuula nti akulangiridde okuba owuwe ku bubwe. Oteekwa okukuuma ebiragiro bye byonna, n’oba “eggwanga ettukuvu eri Mukama Katonda wo, nga bwe yasuubiza.” Wano oyinza okusanga amateeka matono amangu nga gakuyamba. Nkuwabula ogakozesenga mu biseera byo eby’okusaba ebya buli lunaku. Gagezesenga emmeeme okutuusa lwe tutegeerera ddala ensonga eno. I. Langirira lwatu okukkiriza kwo mu Kristo ng’Omulokozi wo.
