Ne empisa oba embeera zonna ezibuusibwabuusibwa bwe zityo. Tuyinza okuba nga twakweka ekibi mu mitima gyaffe. Tuyinza okuba nga twakibikkako, ne tugaana okukiraba. Naye mu kyama tukimanyi. Tuyinza okukibuusa amaaso ne tulangirira nti twesiga mu bujjuvu. Tuyinza okweyongera obunyiikivu mu mirimu gyaffe egy’eddiini. Tuyinza okulaba amazima n’obulungi obusingawo mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza. Tuyinza okulabika ng’abawangudde, eri ffe ffennyini n’eri abalala. Kyokka tuyinza okuwangulwa mu ngeri ey’obulumi. Tuyinza okwewuunya, okwebuuza, okuggwaamu essuubi, n’okusaba. Naye tewali kijja kuyamba okutuusa ekintu ekikolimire lwe kinaasimwa, ne kireetebwa mu kitangaala, ne kiteekebwa mu maaso ga Katonda. Omukkiriza abeera mu bulamu obw’omunda bw’awangulwa, ateekwa okunoonya ekikivuddeko. Si maanyi ga mulabe. Kwe kubulwa okwewaayo okukwekeddwa wansi ddala mu mutima gwe. Okulumwa omutwe si bulwadde, wabula kabonero ka bulwadde. Obulwadde buli mu kitundu ekirala eky’omubiri. Bwe kityo, mu Mukristaayo, ekibi kabonero bukabonero. Kiraga obubi obuyinza okuba nga buli mu kitundu ekirala eky’obuntu bwe. Oluusi, omuntu ayinza okukweka obubi ne mu ekyo, bw’okitunuulira amangu, ekirabika ng’ekirungi. Emabega w’okwagala ennyo amazima, wayinza okubaawo okwagala okusalira abalala emisango oba okuwagira endowooza zaffe zokka. Obwesigwa obw’Ekikristaayo obweyoleka buyinza okukweka obutabaamu kwagala kwa Kikristaayo. Wansi w’okufaayo okulabika ng’okutuufu ku nsonga zaffe, tuyinza okukweka okubulwa ennyo okwesiga Katonda. Omukulembeze waffe ow’omukisa, Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe, aliwo. Ye mu kyama atubikkulira ebintu bino. Akikola ng’ayita mu kutunyeenya okutono n’okulumwa okw’omunda mu mutima. Bwe tutyo tusigala nga tetulina kya kwekwasa. Kyangu okubuusa amaaso eddoboozi lye ery’obukkakkamu, ne twerimbalimba nti byonna biri bulungi. Kino kijja kukweka mu ffe obubi obutta, ne butuleetera okuwangulwa kwe tutasuubira. Ekyokulabirako ekirungi ennyo ekya kino kyantuukako lumu mu by’okulabirira amaka gange. Nnasengukira mu nnyumba empya. Bwe nnali ngikebera okulaba obanga etegese, ne nsanga mu kisenge eky’omu ttaka ekipipa ekiyonjo ennyo, ekyakozesebwanga omwenge gw’ebibala. Kyali kisibiddwa emitwe gyombi. Ne nfumiitiriza obanga nkiggye mu kisenge ekyo ne nkiggulawo. Kyalabika nga temuli kantu era nga kirungi. Kale ne nsalawo okukireka, kubanga kyandibadde mulimu munene okukyambusa amadaala. Saawulira mirembe ddala, naye ne nsindiikiriza okubuusabuusa kwange ebbali ne nkireka. Emirundi ebiri buli mwaka, mu biseera by’okuyonja ennyumba, nnajjukiranga ekipipa ekyo. Omutima gwange ogw’omukyala afaayo ku maka gwannuubanga. Saasobolanga kuwummula mu nnyumba eyayonjeddwa ddala nga kikyali tekiggulwawo. Kubanga nnali mmanyi ntya nti tekikweka bubi bwonna wansi w’endabika yaakyo ennungi? Wadde kyali kityo, ne nkkakkanya okubuusabuusa kwange. Nnatya obuzibu bw’okukinoonyereza. Okumala emyaka ebiri oba esatu, ekipipa ekyo ekyalabika ng’ekitaliiko kabi kyatuula mu kisenge kyange eky’omu ttaka. Olwo, mu ngeri etategeerekeka n’akatono, obuwojjolo obulya engoye ne butandika okujjula ennyumba yange. Nnakozesa buli ngeri eyasoboka okubwekuuma, era ne nfuba nnyo okubusaanyaawo, naye nga bwereere. Bwakula mu muwendo mangu nnyo era ne butiisatiisa okwonoona buli kye nnalina. Nnateebereza nti kapeti zange ze zaali zibuleeta, ne nzinaaza bulungi ddala. Nnateebereza nti waliwo ekikyamu ku ntebe n’ebintu ebirala eby’omu nnyumba, ne mbiddabiriza. Nnateebereza ebintu ebya buli ngeri ebitayinza kubaawo. Ku nkomerero, ekirowoozo ky’ekipipa ne kinzijira amangu ago. Ne nkireetesa okuva mu kisenge eky’omu ttaka, ne bamenya omutwe gwakyo. Ndowooza siyinza kusobya bwe ŋŋamba nti obuwojjolo enkumi n’enkumi bwafubutukamu. Eyasooka okubeera mu nnyumba eyo ateekwa okuba nga yalekamu ekintu ekyazaalisa obuwojjolo. Kino kye kyali ekivaako obuzibu bwange bwonna. Kaakano nzikiriza nti empisa emu, oba okwesanyusa okumu, ekintu ekimu ekirabika ng’ekitaliiko kabi era ekitono, kye kitunyeenya buli kiseera munda mu mutima. Tekyekenneenyezebwanga bulungi mu maaso ga Katonda agakebera. Ndowooza kye kiri ku kikolo ky’okulemererwa okusinga obungi mu bulamu buno obw’awaggulu. Si byonna nti byaweebwayo. Waliwo ensonda ey’ekyama esibiddwa, Mukama aleme kugiyingiramu. Era olw’ensonga eyo, tetusobola kwolekera balabe baffe, wabula ne twesanga nga tukubiddwa wansi mu maaso gaabwe. Okwewala okulemererwa, oba okuzuula ekikuleeta bwe tulemererwa, tuteekwa okukuuma okusaba kuno mu maaso gaffe: “Nkebera, Ayi Katonda, otegeere omutima gwange. Ngezesa omanye ebirowoozo byange. Olabe obanga mu nze mulimu engeri yonna enkyamu; era onkulembere mu kkubo erintuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.”” Wayinza okubaawo ekintu ekirimba ennyo mu nnaku gye tulaba olw’okulemererwa kwaffe. Tuyinza okulowooza nti tufaayo ku kitiibwa kya Katonda. Kyokka emmeeme zaffe ziyinza okuba nga zeeraliikirira olw’omuntu waffe yekka. Tetuli batukuvu nga bwe twali tulowooza. Okuzuula kino kulumya okwagala kwe twagala ffe ffennyini. Okunyiiga kwaffe kuyinza okuba ensobi esinga obunene ku kibi kyennyini ekyasooka. Ekkubo lyokka ery’obukuumi ery’okukwatamu okulemererwa kwaffe kwe kwewala okwebalira obutuukirivu oba okwesalira omusango. Wabula, tusaanidde okukuteeka mu maaso ga Mukama mu kasirise. Tusaanidde okukutunuulira mu mirembe ne mu kwagala. Abawandiisi ab’edda ab’obulamu bw’omwoyo obw’omunda bagamba nti okukyukira Katonda mu ngeri ennyangu era ey’emirembe kutuyamba okusinga okwejjusa olw’okuwaba okumuvaako. “Beera mwesigwa bwesigwa,” bwe bagamba. “Kyukira gy’ali yekka, mu kaseera kennyini k’olaba ekibi kyo. Okubeerawo kwe kujja kukusumulula okuva mu mitego egyakukwasa.” Okwetunuulira wekka kukwongera kukusuula mu bitosi, kubanga ebitosi bino byennyini si kirala wabula ggwe wennyini; so ng’okutunula obutunuzi eri Katonda kusobola okukkakkanya n’okubudaabuda omutima gwo. Ku nkomerero, ka tuleme kwerabira, ne bwe tuba nga twalemererwa kitya, nti Mukama Yesu asobola, nga bwe kyalangirirwa, okutulokola okuva mu balabe baffe. Olwo tusobole “okulokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe awatali kutya, tulyoke tuweereze mu maaso ge, mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.”(Lukka 1:74-75). Ka tusabe, buli omu ku ffe, emisana n’ekiro: “ Era omuddu wo omuwonye okukola ebibi ebigenderere, bireme kunfuga.”(Zabbuli 19:13). “ Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi.”(Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8). Tuteekwa okuba abagonvu ennyo mu mikono gye, era tumwesige. Olwo alyoke “ abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.” (Abaebbulaniya 13:21)

fields.title: Okubuusabuusa
fields.body_html:
Abakristaayo bangi nnyo baddu ba muze gw’okubuusabuusa. Tewali mutamiivu eyali asibiddwa ddala enjegere z’omuze gwe ogutta okusinga bo bwe basibiddwa enjegere ezo. Obulamu bwabwe bwonna obw’Ekikristaayo lutalo olutakoma. Eggye ly’okubuusabuusa libateega, nga lyetegese okubalumba buli lwe lifuna akaagaanya. Obulamu bwabwe bujjudde obuyinike. Okubuusabuusa kwabwe kuziyiza omugaso gwabwe era kumenya enkolagana yaabwe ne Katonda.

Emmeeme bw’eyingira mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza, ekitabo kino bwe kyogerako, emirundi mingi okubuusabuusa kugobebwa. Naye oluusi kuddamu ne kugolokoka. Kusobola okuleeta okwesittala n’okuggwaamu essuubi. Wabula tekuyinza kuzzaayo ddala mukkiriza mu ddungu eryo ery’ennaku.

Ffenna, awatali kubuusabuusa, tujjukira engeri lugero luli gye lwatusikirizanga ate ne lututiisa nga tukyali baana. Lwali lwogera ku mulamazi Christian okusibibwa mu Kigo ky’Okubuusabuusa omuwagguufu omubi ayitibwa Kuggwaamu-Essuubi. Twasanyuka nnyo bwe yawona okuva mu miryango egyo eminene n’omufuzi oyo omukambwe. Mu kiseera ekyo tetwateebereza nti naffe twali tugenda kusibibwa omuwagguufu oyo yennyini, mu kigo ekyo kyennyini. Naye ntya nti buli muntu ow’omu Kkanisa ya Kristo afunye ku ngeri eyo waakiri omulundi gumu. Bwe kiba nga tekikyali kipya mu birowoozo byammwe, mbeegayiridde muddemu musome ebyo ebyawandiikibwa. Muyinza okusangamu ebyabatuukako mwennyini — ebyali ebizibu ennyo okugumiikiriza era ebinakuwaza okujjukira.

Kya kyewuunyo nti abantu abayitibwa Abakkiriza bateekwa okwatula okubuusabuusa okw’engeri eyo. Erinnya lyabwe liraga nti ekintu kyokka ekibaawulawo kwe kukkiriza. Naye omuze guno gusaasaanidde nnyo ne kiba nti, singa Ekkanisa yali eweebwa erinnya eppya, “Ababuusabuusa” lye lyandibadde erinnya lyokka erigituukirako. Abakristaayo abasinga obungi bakkirizza okubuusabuusa kwabwe. Bakutwala ng’obulwadde obuluma obutayinza kwewalika.

Balowooza nti bateekwa okukugumiikiriza ng’ekitundu ky’okukangavvulwa obulamu kwe butuleetera. Beemulugunya ku kubuusabuusa kwabwe ng’omuntu bwe yeemulugunya ku bulumi n’obulwadde bwe. Baagala okutwalibwa nga “ensonga ey’enjawulo” ey’okugezesebwa okutali kwa bulijjo, eyeetaaga okusaasirwa ennyo n’okulabirirwa ennyo.

Kino kitera okuba bwe kityo ne ku bakkiriza. Beegomba okubeera mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza era batambudde dda amabanga mangi okugenda mu kkubo eryo. Bayinza okuba nga tebakyalina kubuusabuusa kwabwe okw’edda. Okwo kwabatulugunyanga. Beebuuzanga obanga ebibi byabwe byasonyiyibwa era obanga balituuka mu Ggulu. Naye bakyabuusabuusa. Omuze ogwo bagututte butwazi ku mutendera ogw’owaggulu. Mpozzi boogera nti, “Weewaawo, nzikiriza nti ebibi byange bisonyiyiddwa, era ndi mwana wa Katonda olw’okukkiriza mu Yesu Kristo. Sikyayinza kwetantala kukibuusabuusa nate.”

Naye olwo — era “naye olwo” ono kazingiramu okubuusabuusa buli kisuubizo Kitaffe kye yasuubiza abaana be.

Balwana n’ebisuubizo ebyo, nga bagaana okubikkiriza okutuusa lwe banaafuna obukakafu nti bya mazima obusinga ekigambo kya Katonda.

Beebuuza lwaki batambulira mu kizikiza eky’engeri eyo. Beetwala ng’abajulizi. Basinda wansi w’entalo ez’omwoyo ez’enjawulo ze bateekwa okugumiikiriza. Entalo ez’omwoyo! Zandisinze okuyitibwa erinnya erituufu singa tuziyita okujeema okw’omwoyo! Olutalo lwaffe lulina kuba lutalo lwa kukkiriza, era mu kaseera ke tubuusabuusa, olutalo lwaffe lukoma, okujeema kwaffe ne kutandika.

Njagala, bwe kiba kisoboka, okuwakanya ensonga eno yonna n’amaanyi. Kyandibadde kye kimu nga nneegatta ku kwemulugunya kw’omutamiivu. Kyandibadde kye kimu nga nsaba wamu naye afune ekisa okugumiikiriza omuze gwe ogumutta. Busirusiru bwe bumu okubudaabuda emmeeme ezo eziri mu buddu ng’okwemulugunya kwazo okw’obunafu. Siyinza kukola kirala kyonna wabula okulangirira gye ziri okununulibwa okutuukiridde Mukama Yesu Kristo kw’azitegekedde. Nziwolereza, nzeegayirira, era nziragira, n’obulamu bwange bwonna, okukukkiriza zibe ez’eddembe. Sandiwulirizza wadde akaseera akamu ensonga zaazo ez’okuggwaamu essuubi. Osaanidde okuba ow’eddembe, osobola okuba ow’eddembe, era oteekwa okuba ow’eddembe!

Onooŋŋamba nti kya buwaze abaana ba Katonda okumubuusabuusa?

Kya buwaze abaana bo okukubuusabuusa? Wandigumiikirizza okubuusabuusa kwabwe wadde essaawa emu? Wandisaasidde mutabani wo singa akugamba nti, “Taata, siyinza kukkiriza kigambo kyo, siyinza kwesiga kwagala kwo”? Wandimulabye ng’ensonga ey’enjawulo esaanira okusaasirwa? Nzijukira omulundi gumu bwe nnalaba obusungu bwa maama omu gwe nnali mmanyi, obwamusiikuuka okutuuka wansi ddala mu mutima, olw’okubuusabuusa okutonotono omu ku baana be kwe yalaga. Yali aleese abawala babiri abato ewange abandekere ng’agenda okukola emirimu gye. Omu ku bo, n’obwesige obw’essanyu obw’omwana, yeewaayo ddala eri ekisenge ky’abaana mwe bazannyira. Yasangayo ebisanyusa byonna ebyalimu. Yayimba n’azannya okutuusa maama we lwe yakomawo.

Ow’okubiri, n’obwegendereza obutali bwa mukisa obw’abantu abakulu, yatuula yekka mu nsonda. Yali yeebuuza obanga maama we anajjukira okumukomawo. Yatya nti ayinza okwerabirwa. Yalowooza nti maama we yandisanyuse okumwejjako, kubanga yali muwala atawulira. Ku nkomerero, yeesiikuula okutuusa lwe yaggwaamu ddala essuubi. Sijja kwerabira mangu ndabika ya bwenyi bwa maama oyo. Kyali ng’akomyewo, omuwala we omuto ng’akaaba n’amutegeeza ekimutawaanya. Ennaku, okwagala okwalumiziddwa, obusungu, n’ekisa, byonna byalwanagana nga buli kimu kyagala okuwangula. Naye obusungu bwe bwawangula, era mbuusabuusa obanga omuwala oyo omuto yali akangavvuddwa n’amaanyi bwe gatyo emabegako. Ekifaananyi ekyo kinzijidde mu birowoozo emirundi kikumi okuva olwo. Kinjigirizza nnyo. Kimpalirizza okugaana okubuusabuusa okwagala kwa Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu. Okubuusabuusa okwo kubadde kukonkona n’amaloboozi ku luggi lw’omutima gwange nga kwagala kuyingira.

Nkakasa nti eri bangi, okubuusabuusa kye kintu kye beejalabyamu. Okukyeggyako kyandibadde kwefiiriza okusinga obuzibu kwe bamanyi. Kintu kya kwejalabya ekireeta ebivaamu eby’ennaku, nga n’ebirala byonna eby’engeri eyo bwe bikola. Mpozzi bw’olaba ennaku gye kuleese mu bulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo, oyinza okukemebwa okugamba nti, “Ennaku! Kino si kya kwejalabya gye ndi, wabula kugezesebwa kwa ntiisa kwokka.” Naye yimirira akaseera. Gezaako okukuleka, era mangu ojja kuzuula obanga kya kwejalabya oba nedda. Okubuusabuusa kwo tekukujjira ng’ekibiina ky’emikwano? Kukusaasira mu bizibu byo era kwagala okukubudaabuda.

Si kya kwejalabya okutuula nakwo, okukusembeza, n’okuwuliriza ensonga zaakwo? Okwegatta nakwo mu kwesaasira? Tekyandibadde kwefiiriza okukukyukira ddala, n’ogaana okuwulira ekigambo kyonna kye kulina okwogera?

Bw’oba tomanyi, gezaako olabe. Tewejalabyangako mu birowoozo ebikakali ku abo abaakukola obubi? Tomanyangako ssanyu ery’okufumiitiriza ku butali kisa bwabwe? Ery’okusensulira mu ttima lyabwe? Ery’okubateebereza ebintu ebya buli ngeri ebibi era ebikuleetera obutateredde? Kyakunakuwazanga nnyo, kya lwatu. Naye bwali buyinike bwa ngeri esikiriza gy’otasobola kuleka mangu. Era bw’atyo bwe kiri n’okwejalabya mu kubuusabuusa. Ebintu bikugendedde bubi mu bulamu bwo.

Enteekateeka za Katonda gy’oli za kyama. Ebikemo byo bya njawulo. Embeera yo erabika nga si ya bulijjo. Kiki ekyandibadde eky’obuzaaliranwa okusinga okusalawo nti, olw’ensonga emu oba endala, Katonda akwabulidde? Nti takwagala era tafaayo ku bulungi bwo? Era nga kikwatira ddala nnyo okukkiriza nti oli mubi nnyo n’atakufaako, oba nti oli muzibu nnyo gy’ali n’atakusobola?

Tomunenya era tomulumiriza butali bwenkanya. Owulira nti osaanidde obutakufaako bwe n’okukugaana kwe olw’obutasaana bwo. Olukujjukujju luno lukusobozesa okwebuusabuusa ng’weefuula omwetoowaze.

Naye oba weejalabya mu birowoozo ebikakali era ebikyamu ku Mukama wo, nga bwe wakola ku mulabe ow’omuntu.

Agamba nti teyajja kulokola batuukirivu, wabula aboonoonyi. Obwonoonyi bwo n’obutasaana bwo bye bisinga okukuwa obwannannyini ku kwagala kwe n’okukulabirira kwe.

Akaliga akatono akaavu akaabula ne kabulira mu ddungu kayinza okugamba nti, “Omusumba tanjagala, tanfaako, era tanjijukira, kubanga mbuze. Ayagala era alabirira obuliga bwokka obutabula.” Era n’omuntu omulwadde ayinza okugamba nti, “Omusawo tajja kujja kundaba, wadde okumpa eddagala lyonna, kubanga ndi mulwadde. Afaayo era akyalira abalamu bokka.” Yesu agamba nti, “Abalamu tebeetaaga musawo wabula abalwadde.”(Matayo 9:12) Era nate agamba nti, “Singa omu ku mmwe abadde alina endiga kikumi, naye emu n’emubulako, taleka ziri ekyenda mu omwenda ku ttale n’agenda anoonya eri ebuze okutuusa Lw’agiraba? Bw’agiraba, agisitula ku bibegabega bye n’agitwala eka ng’ajaguza. Bw’atuuka eka ayita mikwano gye ne baliraanwa be bajje ng’agamba nti, ‘Munsanyukireko kubanga endiga yange eyabadde ebuze, erabise.’”(Lukka 15:4-6) Ebirowoozo byonna ku ye ebyawukana ku bigambo bye ye kennyini bye birowoozo ebikakali. Okubyejalabyamu kibi nnyo okusinga okwejalabya mu birowoozo ebikakali ku mukwano oba omulabe yenna ow’oku nsi. Okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo, bulijjo kibi okwejalabya mu kubuusabuusa. Okubuusabuusa kwonna kuva wa Setaani, era bulijjo si kwa mazima. Era engeri yokka ey’okukwolekagana nakwo kwe kukugaanira ddala butereevu era n’amaanyi. Kino kintuusa ku kitundu ky’ensonga eno yonna eky’ebikolwa: engeri y’okununulibwa okuva mu muze guno ogutta. Okuddamu kwange kwandibadde nti okununulibwa okuva mu gwo tekuyinza kujja mu ngeri ndala yonna wabula ng’okununulibwa okuva mu kibi ekirala kyonna. Kusangibwa mu Mukama, era mu ye yekka. Oteekwa okumukwasa okubuusabuusa kwo, nga bwe wayiga okumukwasa ebikemo byo ebirala. Oteekwa okukola kye kimu ky’okola n’obusungu bwo oba n’amalala go.

Oteekwa okukiwaayo eri Mukama.

Nzikiriza nti eddagala lyokka kwe kweyama obutaddamu kubuusabuusa, nga bw’owabula omutamiivu okweyama obutaddamu kunywa mwenge. Weesige Mukama yekka akukuume ng’onywedde.

Nga bwe kiri ku kibi ekirala kyonna, ekigo kyakwo kiri mu kwagala kw’omuntu. Oteekwa okuwaayo okwagala kwo okw’okubuusabuusa, nga bwe wandikoze ku kikemo ekirala kyonna. Katonda bulijjo yeddiza okwagala okuweereddwayo gy’ali. Bwe tugamba nti tetujja kubuusabuusa, ne tumuwa omunda waffe ddala, Omwoyo we ajja kukolera mu ffe. Tujja kukuumibwa obutabuusabuusa olw’amaanyi ge amangi. Obuzibu buli nti emmeeme emirundi mingi teyeewaayo ddala. Yeesigalizaako akaddembe akatono ak’okubuusabuusa, ng’ekitwala ng’ekyetaagisa oluusi. Tujja kugamba nti, “Sikyayagala kubuusabuusa,” oba nti, “Nsuubira nti sijja kubuusabuusa.” Naye kizibu okugamba nti, “Sijja kuddamu kubuusabuusa.”

Naye okwewaayo kwonna tekugasa okutuusa lwe kutuuka ku kugamba nti, “Sijja.” Eddembe ly’okubuusabuusa lirina okuweebwayo emirembe gyonna. Era emmeeme erina okukkiriza okubeera mu bulamu obw’okwesiga obutakoma era obutaliimu kulonda. Ndowooza emirundi mingi kyetaagisa okukomya okubuusabuusa kuno. Tulina okutuuka ku kusalawo ku nsonga eno. Nzikiriza nti kyetaagisa ku mubuusabuusa nga bwe kyetaagisa ku mutamiivu. Tekigasa kukuleka mpola mpola. Enkola y’okwekomako ddala yokka y’ekola wano. Emmeeme bw’emala okwewaayo, erina okwesigama ddala ku Mukama okugiwonya mu buli kikemo. Erina okusitula engabo y’okukkiriza mu kaseera ke nnyini olulumbo we lujjira. Erina okukwasa Mukama ekirowoozo ekisooka eky’okubuusabuusa, era erina okugamba omulabe agende akole ensonga eyo ne Mukama.

Erina okugaana okuwuliriza okubuusabuusa wadde akaseera akamu. Ne bwe kulabika nga kwa nsonga oba nga kwa buwombeefu, emmeeme erina okugamba nti, “Siyinza kwetantala kubuusabuusa; nteekwa okwesiga. Mukama mulungi, era ddala ANJAGALA. Yesu andokola; andokola kaakano.” Ebigambo ebyo ebitono ebisatu, nga biddibwamu enfunda n’enfunda, — “Yesu andokola, Yesu andokola,” — bijja kuwangula eggye ly’okubuusabuusa erisinga obunene eryali lirumbye emmeeme. Nkigezezzaako emirundi egitabalika, era sikirabangako nga kigaana. Toyimirira kukubaganya nakwo birowoozo, wadde okugezaako okukakasa nti si kwa mazima. Tokufaako n’akatono; kunyoome ddala. Kuggalire oluggi lwo mu maaso, era gaana n’amaanyi buli kigambo kye kukugamba. Leeta “Kyawandiikibwa nti” ekimu okikasuke ku kwo. Tunuulira Yesu butereevu, omugambe nti omwesiga, era nti omaliridde okumwesiga. Okubuusabuusa kuleekaane nga bwe kunaayagala, tekuyinza kukukolako kabi bw’otokuyingiza.

Kiyinza okulabika ng’oggalawo oluggi ku mikwano gyo egisinga. Omutima gwo gujja kwegomba okubuusabuusa kwo okusinga abaana ba Isirayiri bwe beegomba sefuliya z’ennyama ez’e Misiri. Naye weefiirize; weetikke omusaalaba gwo mu nsonga eno. Gaana awatali kusaasira okuwuliriza ekigambo kyonna. Eggye eddamba ery’okubuusabuusa lyannindirira okuzuukuka ne likonkona ku luggi lwange nga lyagala kuyingira. Tewali kintu kyalabika nga kya ddala oba kya mazima. N’okusinga byonna, kyalabika nga tekisoboka nti nze — omunaku era ow’ennaku — nnali nsobola okuba nga Mukama anjagala, anfaako, oba ankubako eriiso. Singa nnali nsobola okuyingiza okubuusabuusa okwo! Singa nnali nsobola okukuyita kutuule, kwewulire nga kuli waka, nga kyandibadde kya kwejalabya kinene! Naye emyaka mingi emabega, nneeyama obutabuusabuusa. Okumenya obweyamo buno kyandibadde kizibu gye ndi nga okumenya obweyamo bwange obw’obutanywa mwenge.

Saayinza kwetantala kuyingiza kubuusabuusa okusooka. Nnasitula engabo yange ey’okukkiriza mu kaseera ke nnyini lwe nnategeera ebirowoozo ebyo. Eggye eryo lyonna nnalikwasa Mukama wange alivvuunuke. Oluvannyuma ne nneeyongera okugamba nti, “Mukama anjagala. Ye Mulokozi wange ow’akaseera kano era atuukiridde; Yesu andokola, Yesu andokola kaakano!”

Obuwanguzi bwali bwa ddala. Omulabe yajja ng’amataba. Naye Mukama n’ayimusa bbendera okumulwanyisa.

Yawangulwa n’adduka. Emmeeme yange eyimba oluyimba lwa Musa n’abaana ba Isirayiri. Egamba nti: Awo Musa n’abaana ba Isirayiri ne bayimbira Mukama oluyimba luno nga bagamba nti, “Nnaayimbiranga Mukama, kubanga awangudde n’ekitiibwa kingi. Asudde mu nnyanja embalaasi n’omwebagazi waayo.” (Okuva 15:1) “Mukama ge maanyi gange era lwe luyimba lwange, era afuuse obulokozi bwange. Ye Katonda wange, nange nnaamutenderezanga, ye Katonda wa kitange, nange nnaamugulumizanga. Mukama mulwanyi; Mukama, ly’erinnya lye.”(Okuva 15:2-3). Kijja kukuyamba okulwanyisa endumbe z’ekikemo kino eky’okubuusabuusa, bw’onoolaba obulungi nti okubuusabuusa kibi. Kuba kujeemera butereevu Mukama waffe, atulagira nti, “Mbalekera emirembe, era mbawa emirembe gyange. Emirembe gye mbawa tegiringa egy’ensi. Noolwekyo temutyanga era temweraliikiriranga.” (Yokaana 14:27) Bayibuli buli wamu etulagira okwesiga, awatali kwesonyiwa kwonna. Ekiseera n’ebbanga byandimpeddeko okwogera ku kitundu kimu ku kikumi eky’ebyo. Naye tewali ayinza kusoma Zabbuli n’atakakasibwa. Omuntu eyeesiga awatali kubuusabuusa ye yekka asanyusa Katonda era gw’akkiriza. “Okujeema” kwa Isirayiri kwali nti tebeesiga; “Naye bo ne beeyongera bweyongezi okwonoona, ne bajeemera Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo nga bali mu ddungu. Ne bagezesa Katonda mu bugenderevu, nga bamusaba emmere gye baalulunkanira. Era ne boogera ku Katonda; nga bagamba nti, “Katonda asobola okutuliisiza mu ddungu? Weewaawo yakuba olwazi, amazzi ne gakulukuta ng’emigga; naye anaatuwa emmere? Anaawa abantu be ennyama?” Awo Mukama bwe yawulira ebyo n’asunguwala nnyo; omuliro gwe ne gwaka ku Yakobo, n’obusungu bwe ne bubuubuukira ku Isirayiri. Kubanga tebakkiriza Katonda, era tebeesiga maanyi ge agalokola.” (Zabbuli 78:17-22.)

Okwawukana ku ekyo, Isaaya ayogera bw’ati ku abo abeesiga: “Mukama alikuuma mirembe oyo amaliridde okumwesiga mu mutima gwe.”(Isaaya 26:3) Tewali kintu kitulumya ng’okubuusabuusibwa mukwano gwaffe. Nkakasa nti tewali kintu kinakuwaza Katonda okusinga okubuusabuusa kwaffe.

Omu ku baana bange, kati ali ne Mukama, yaŋŋamba akawungeezi akamu bwe nnali mmubikka ku kitanda, nti, “Maama, nfunye okubuusabuusa kwange okusooka.” “Owange, Ray,” ne mmugamba, “kwali kwa ngeri ki?” “Kale,” n’addamu, “Setaani yajja gye ndi n’aŋŋamba nti nneme kukkiriza Bayibuli, kubanga tekuli kigambo na kimu ekigirimu eky’amazima.” “Era wamugamba ki?”

Bwe nnamubuuza. “Owange,” n’addamu ng’ajaguza olw’obuwanguzi, “Nnamugamba bugambi nti, Setaani, nja kugikkiriza. Kiwedde!” Nnasanyuka nnyo olw’okutegeera kw’omwana ono mu by’omwoyo. Yali amanyi engeri y’okwolekagana n’okubuusabuusa. Nnamuzzaamu amaanyi, nga mmunnyonnyola nti okubuusabuusa kwonna n’okuggwaamu amaanyi kwonna biva eri omulabe. Mulimba, n’olwekyo tomuwulirizanga n’akatono.

Ekiro ekyaddako, nnali nneerabidde ddala ebyo byonna. N’olwekyo nneewuunya bwe yaŋŋamba, nga mmubikka, nti, “Maama, Setaani azzeemu nate.” “Owange, Ray omwagalwa!” ne ndeekaana nga nneeraliikirivu, “kiki ky’akugambye ku mulundi guno?” “Kale,” n’addamu, “ambuulidde bubuulizi nti ndi muwala mubi nnyo ne kiba nti Yesu tayinza kunjagala. Era nti busirusiru okulowooza nti anjagala.” “Ate kati wamugambye ki?” ne mmubuuza. “Owange!” n’addamu, “Nnamutunuulidde n’obusungu ne mmugamba nti, Setaani, ziba akamwa ko!” Awo n’ayongerako, ng’amwenya, “Tayinza kunnakuwaza n’akatono.” Tewali mmeeme yali erwanye lutalo lusinga olwo omwana ono omuto lwe yalwana, era tewali buwanguzi businga obwo bwali buwanguddwa!

Ggwe emmeeme omwagalwa ebuusabuusa, genda okole bw’otyo; era obuwanguzi obufaanana ng’obwo bunaaba bubwo. Bw’onoomala okussa wansi ekitabo kino, kwata ekkalaamu yo owandiike okumalirira kwo obutaddamu kubuusabuusa. Kifuule endagaano ya ddala wakati w’emmeeme yo ne Mukama. Waayo eddembe lyo ery’okubuusabuusa emirembe gyonna. Okwagala kwo mu nsonga eno kuteeke ku ludda lwa Mukama, era mwesige akukuume oleme kugwa. Mubuulire obunafu bwo n’okubuusabuusa kwo.

Omulabe wo akunafuyizza n’otasobola kwetaasa. Mukwase olutalo lwonna. Mugambe nti tojja kuddamu kubuusabuusa.

Olwo, amaaso go gakuume nga gatunuulidde Yesu.

Kyuka okuva ku ggwe kennyini n’okubuusabuusa kwo. Nywerera ku kukkiriza kwo, kubanga eyasuubiza mwesigwa.

Bw’onoosigala ng’olina obwesige okutuusa ku nkomerero, ojja, ku bw’oyo akwagala, okuwangula n’okukirawo mu nsonga eno.
fields.body_text: Abakristaayo bangi nnyo baddu ba muze gw’okubuusabuusa. Tewali mutamiivu eyali asibiddwa ddala enjegere z’omuze gwe ogutta okusinga bo bwe basibiddwa enjegere ezo. Obulamu bwabwe bwonna obw’Ekikristaayo lutalo olutakoma. Eggye ly’okubuusabuusa libateega, nga lyetegese okubalumba buli lwe lifuna akaagaanya. Obulamu bwabwe bujjudde obuyinike. Okubuusabuusa kwabwe kuziyiza omugaso gwabwe era kumenya enkolagana yaabwe ne Katonda. Emmeeme bw’eyingira mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza, ekitabo kino bwe kyogerako, emirundi mingi okubuusabuusa kugobebwa. Naye oluusi kuddamu ne kugolokoka. Kusobola okuleeta okwesittala n’okuggwaamu essuubi. Wabula tekuyinza kuzzaayo ddala mukkiriza mu ddungu eryo ery’ennaku. Ffenna, awatali kubuusabuusa, tujjukira engeri lugero luli gye lwatusikirizanga ate ne lututiisa nga tukyali baana. Lwali lwogera ku mulamazi Christian okusibibwa mu Kigo ky’Okubuusabuusa omuwagguufu omubi ayitibwa Kuggwaamu-Essuubi. Twasanyuka nnyo bwe yawona okuva mu miryango egyo eminene n’omufuzi oyo omukambwe. Mu kiseera ekyo tetwateebereza nti naffe twali tugenda kusibibwa omuwagguufu oyo yennyini, mu kigo ekyo kyennyini. Naye ntya nti buli muntu ow’omu Kkanisa ya Kristo afunye ku ngeri eyo waakiri omulundi gumu. Bwe kiba nga tekikyali kipya mu birowoozo byammwe, mbeegayiridde muddemu musome ebyo ebyawandiikibwa. Muyinza okusangamu ebyabatuukako mwennyini — ebyali ebizibu ennyo okugumiikiriza era ebinakuwaza okujjukira. Kya kyewuunyo nti abantu abayitibwa Abakkiriza bateekwa okwatula okubuusabuusa okw’engeri eyo. Erinnya lyabwe liraga nti ekintu kyokka ekibaawulawo kwe kukkiriza. Naye omuze guno gusaasaanidde nnyo ne kiba nti, singa Ekkanisa yali eweebwa erinnya eppya, “Ababuusabuusa” lye lyandibadde erinnya lyokka erigituukirako. Abakristaayo abasinga obungi bakkirizza okubuusabuusa kwabwe. Bakutwala ng’obulwadde obuluma obutayinza kwewalika. Balowooza nti bateekwa okukugumiikiriza ng’ekitundu ky’okukangavvulwa obulamu kwe butuleetera. Beemulugunya ku kubuusabuusa kwabwe ng’omuntu bwe yeemulugunya ku bulumi n’obulwadde bwe. Baagala okutwalibwa nga “ensonga ey’enjawulo” ey’okugezesebwa okutali kwa bulijjo, eyeetaaga okusaasirwa ennyo n’okulabirirwa ennyo. Kino kitera okuba bwe kityo ne ku bakkiriza. Beegomba okubeera mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza era batambudde dda amabanga mangi okugenda mu kkubo eryo. Bayinza okuba nga tebakyalina kubuusabuusa kwabwe okw’edda. Okwo kwabatulugunyanga. Beebuuzanga obanga ebibi byabwe byasonyiyibwa era obanga balituuka mu Ggulu. Naye bakyabuusabuusa. Omuze ogwo bagututte butwazi ku mutendera ogw’owaggulu. Mpozzi boogera nti, “Weewaawo, nzikiriza nti ebibi byange bisonyiyiddwa, era ndi mwana wa Katonda olw’okukkiriza mu Yesu Kristo. Sikyayinza kwetantala kukibuusabuusa nate.” Naye olwo — era “naye olwo” ono kazingiramu okubuusabuusa buli kisuubizo Kitaffe kye yasuubiza abaana be. Balwana n’ebisuubizo ebyo, nga bagaana okubikkiriza okutuusa lwe banaafuna obukakafu nti bya mazima obusinga ekigambo kya Katonda. Beebuuza lwaki batambulira mu kizikiza eky’engeri eyo. Beetwala ng’abajulizi. Basinda wansi w’entalo ez’omwoyo ez’enjawulo ze bateekwa okugumiikiriza. Entalo ez’omwoyo! Zandisinze okuyitibwa erinnya erituufu singa tuziyita okujeema okw’omwoyo! Olutalo lwaffe lulina kuba lutalo lwa kukkiriza, era mu kaseera ke tubuusabuusa, olutalo lwaffe lukoma, okujeema kwaffe ne kutandika. Njagala, bwe kiba kisoboka, okuwakanya ensonga eno yonna n’amaanyi. Kyandibadde kye kimu nga nneegatta ku kwemulugunya kw’omutamiivu. Kyandibadde kye kimu nga nsaba wamu naye afune ekisa okugumiikiriza omuze gwe ogumutta. Busirusiru bwe bumu okubudaabuda emmeeme ezo eziri mu buddu ng’okwemulugunya kwazo okw’obunafu. Siyinza kukola kirala kyonna wabula okulangirira gye ziri okununulibwa okutuukiridde Mukama Yesu Kristo kw’azitegekedde. Nziwolereza, nzeegayirira, era nziragira, n’obulamu bwange bwonna, okukukkiriza zibe ez’eddembe. Sandiwulirizza wadde akaseera akamu ensonga zaazo ez’okuggwaamu essuubi. Osaanidde okuba ow’eddembe, osobola okuba ow’eddembe, era oteekwa okuba ow’eddembe! Onooŋŋamba nti kya buwaze abaana ba Katonda okumubuusabuusa? Kya buwaze abaana bo okukubuusabuusa? Wandigumiikirizza okubuusabuusa kwabwe wadde essaawa emu? Wandisaasidde mutabani wo singa akugamba nti, “Taata, siyinza kukkiriza kigambo kyo, siyinza kwesiga kwagala kwo”? Wandimulabye ng’ensonga ey’enjawulo esaanira okusaasirwa? Nzijukira omulundi gumu bwe nnalaba obusungu bwa maama omu gwe nnali mmanyi, obwamusiikuuka okutuuka wansi ddala mu mutima, olw’okubuusabuusa okutonotono omu ku baana be kwe yalaga. Yali aleese abawala babiri abato ewange abandekere ng’agenda okukola emirimu gye. Omu ku bo, n’obwesige obw’essanyu obw’omwana, yeewaayo ddala eri ekisenge ky’abaana mwe bazannyira. Yasangayo ebisanyusa byonna ebyalimu. Yayimba n’azannya okutuusa maama we lwe yakomawo. Ow’okubiri, n’obwegendereza obutali bwa mukisa obw’abantu abakulu, yatuula yekka mu nsonda. Yali yeebuuza obanga maama we anajjukira okumukomawo. Yatya nti ayinza okwerabirwa. Yalowooza nti maama we yandisanyuse okumwejjako, kubanga yali muwala atawulira. Ku nkomerero, yeesiikuula okutuusa lwe yaggwaamu ddala essuubi. Sijja kwerabira mangu ndabika ya bwenyi bwa maama oyo. Kyali ng’akomyewo, omuwala we omuto ng’akaaba n’amutegeeza ekimutawaanya. Ennaku, okwagala okwalumiziddwa, obusungu, n’ekisa, byonna byalwanagana nga buli kimu kyagala okuwangula. Naye obusungu bwe bwawangula, era mbuusabuusa obanga omuwala oyo omuto yali akangavvuddwa n’amaanyi bwe gatyo emabegako. Ekifaananyi ekyo kinzijidde mu birowoozo emirundi kikumi okuva olwo. Kinjigirizza nnyo. Kimpalirizza okugaana okubuusabuusa okwagala kwa Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu. Okubuusabuusa okwo kubadde kukonkona n’amaloboozi ku luggi lw’omutima gwange nga kwagala kuyingira. Nkakasa nti eri bangi, okubuusabuusa kye kintu kye beejalabyamu. Okukyeggyako kyandibadde kwefiiriza okusinga obuzibu kwe bamanyi. Kintu kya kwejalabya ekireeta ebivaamu eby’ennaku, nga n’ebirala byonna eby’engeri eyo bwe bikola. Mpozzi bw’olaba ennaku gye kuleese mu bulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo, oyinza okukemebwa okugamba nti, “Ennaku! Kino si kya kwejalabya gye ndi, wabula kugezesebwa kwa ntiisa kwokka.” Naye yimirira akaseera. Gezaako okukuleka, era mangu ojja kuzuula obanga kya kwejalabya oba nedda. Okubuusabuusa kwo tekukujjira ng’ekibiina ky’emikwano? Kukusaasira mu bizibu byo era kwagala okukubudaabuda. Si kya kwejalabya okutuula nakwo, okukusembeza, n’okuwuliriza ensonga zaakwo? Okwegatta nakwo mu kwesaasira? Tekyandibadde kwefiiriza okukukyukira ddala, n’ogaana okuwulira ekigambo kyonna kye kulina okwogera? Bw’oba tomanyi, gezaako olabe. Tewejalabyangako mu birowoozo ebikakali ku abo abaakukola obubi? Tomanyangako ssanyu ery’okufumiitiriza ku butali kisa bwabwe? Ery’okusensulira mu ttima lyabwe? Ery’okubateebereza ebintu ebya buli ngeri ebibi era ebikuleetera obutateredde? Kyakunakuwazanga nnyo, kya lwatu. Naye bwali buyinike bwa ngeri esikiriza gy’otasobola kuleka mangu. Era bw’atyo bwe kiri n’okwejalabya mu kubuusabuusa. Ebintu bikugendedde bubi mu bulamu bwo. Enteekateeka za Katonda gy’oli za kyama. Ebikemo byo bya njawulo. Embeera yo erabika nga si ya bulijjo. Kiki ekyandibadde eky’obuzaaliranwa okusinga okusalawo nti, olw’ensonga emu oba endala, Katonda akwabulidde? Nti takwagala era tafaayo ku bulungi bwo? Era nga kikwatira ddala nnyo okukkiriza nti oli mubi nnyo n’atakufaako, oba nti oli muzibu nnyo gy’ali n’atakusobola? Tomunenya era tomulumiriza butali bwenkanya. Owulira nti osaanidde obutakufaako bwe n’okukugaana kwe olw’obutasaana bwo. Olukujjukujju luno lukusobozesa okwebuusabuusa ng’weefuula omwetoowaze. Naye oba weejalabya mu birowoozo ebikakali era ebikyamu ku Mukama wo, nga bwe wakola ku mulabe ow’omuntu. Agamba nti teyajja kulokola batuukirivu, wabula aboonoonyi. Obwonoonyi bwo n’obutasaana bwo bye bisinga okukuwa obwannannyini ku kwagala kwe n’okukulabirira kwe. Akaliga akatono akaavu akaabula ne kabulira mu ddungu kayinza okugamba nti, “Omusumba tanjagala, tanfaako, era tanjijukira, kubanga mbuze. Ayagala era alabirira obuliga bwokka obutabula.” Era n’omuntu omulwadde ayinza okugamba nti, “Omusawo tajja kujja kundaba, wadde okumpa eddagala lyonna, kubanga ndi mulwadde. Afaayo era akyalira abalamu bokka.” Yesu agamba nti, “Abalamu tebeetaaga musawo wabula abalwadde.”(Matayo 9:12) Era nate agamba nti, “Singa omu ku mmwe abadde alina endiga kikumi, naye emu n’emubulako, taleka ziri ekyenda mu omwenda ku ttale n’agenda anoonya eri ebuze okutuusa Lw’agiraba? Bw’agiraba, agisitula ku bibegabega bye n’agitwala eka ng’ajaguza. Bw’atuuka eka ayita mikwano gye ne baliraanwa be bajje ng’agamba nti, ‘Munsanyukireko kubanga endiga yange eyabadde ebuze, erabise.’”(Lukka 15:4-6) Ebirowoozo byonna ku ye ebyawukana ku bigambo bye ye kennyini bye birowoozo ebikakali. Okubyejalabyamu kibi nnyo okusinga okwejalabya mu birowoozo ebikakali ku mukwano oba omulabe yenna ow’oku nsi. Okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo, bulijjo kibi okwejalabya mu kubuusabuusa. Okubuusabuusa kwonna kuva wa Setaani, era bulijjo si kwa mazima. Era engeri yokka ey’okukwolekagana nakwo kwe kukugaanira ddala butereevu era n’amaanyi. Kino kintuusa ku kitundu ky’ensonga eno yonna eky’ebikolwa: engeri y’okununulibwa okuva mu muze guno ogutta. Okuddamu kwange kwandibadde nti okununulibwa okuva mu gwo tekuyinza kujja mu ngeri ndala yonna wabula ng’okununulibwa okuva mu kibi ekirala kyonna. Kusangibwa mu Mukama, era mu ye yekka. Oteekwa okumukwasa okubuusabuusa kwo, nga bwe wayiga okumukwasa ebikemo byo ebirala. Oteekwa okukola kye kimu ky’okola n’obusungu bwo oba n’amalala go. Oteekwa okukiwaayo eri Mukama. Nzikiriza nti eddagala lyokka kwe kweyama obutaddamu kubuusabuusa, nga bw’owabula omutamiivu okweyama obutaddamu kunywa mwenge. Weesige Mukama yekka akukuume ng’onywedde. Nga bwe kiri ku kibi ekirala kyonna, ekigo kyakwo kiri mu kwagala kw’omuntu. Oteekwa okuwaayo okwagala kwo okw’okubuusabuusa, nga bwe wandikoze ku kikemo ekirala kyonna. Katonda bulijjo yeddiza okwagala okuweereddwayo gy’ali. Bwe tugamba nti tetujja kubuusabuusa, ne tumuwa omunda waffe ddala, Omwoyo we ajja kukolera mu ffe. Tujja kukuumibwa obutabuusabuusa olw’amaanyi ge amangi. Obuzibu buli nti emmeeme emirundi mingi teyeewaayo ddala. Yeesigalizaako akaddembe akatono ak’okubuusabuusa, ng’ekitwala ng’ekyetaagisa oluusi. Tujja kugamba nti, “Sikyayagala kubuusabuusa,” oba nti, “Nsuubira nti sijja kubuusabuusa.” Naye kizibu okugamba nti, “Sijja kuddamu kubuusabuusa.” Naye okwewaayo kwonna tekugasa okutuusa lwe kutuuka ku kugamba nti, “Sijja.” Eddembe ly’okubuusabuusa lirina okuweebwayo emirembe gyonna. Era emmeeme erina okukkiriza okubeera mu bulamu obw’okwesiga obutakoma era obutaliimu kulonda. Ndowooza emirundi mingi kyetaagisa okukomya okubuusabuusa kuno. Tulina okutuuka ku kusalawo ku nsonga eno. Nzikiriza nti kyetaagisa ku mubuusabuusa nga bwe kyetaagisa ku mutamiivu. Tekigasa kukuleka mpola mpola. Enkola y’okwekomako ddala yokka y’ekola wano. Emmeeme bw’emala okwewaayo, erina okwesigama ddala ku Mukama okugiwonya mu buli kikemo. Erina okusitula engabo y’okukkiriza mu kaseera ke nnyini olulumbo we lujjira. Erina okukwasa Mukama ekirowoozo ekisooka eky’okubuusabuusa, era erina okugamba omulabe agende akole ensonga eyo ne Mukama. Erina okugaana okuwuliriza okubuusabuusa wadde akaseera akamu. Ne bwe kulabika nga kwa nsonga oba nga kwa buwombeefu, emmeeme erina okugamba nti, “Siyinza kwetantala kubuusabuusa; nteekwa okwesiga. Mukama mulungi, era ddala ANJAGALA. Yesu andokola; andokola kaakano.” Ebigambo ebyo ebitono ebisatu, nga biddibwamu enfunda n’enfunda, — “Yesu andokola, Yesu andokola,” — bijja kuwangula eggye ly’okubuusabuusa erisinga obunene eryali lirumbye emmeeme. Nkigezezzaako emirundi egitabalika, era sikirabangako nga kigaana. Toyimirira kukubaganya nakwo birowoozo, wadde okugezaako okukakasa nti si kwa mazima. Tokufaako n’akatono; kunyoome ddala. Kuggalire oluggi lwo mu maaso, era gaana n’amaanyi buli kigambo kye kukugamba. Leeta “Kyawandiikibwa nti” ekimu okikasuke ku kwo. Tunuulira Yesu butereevu, omugambe nti omwesiga, era nti omaliridde okumwesiga. Okubuusabuusa kuleekaane nga bwe kunaayagala, tekuyinza kukukolako kabi bw’otokuyingiza. Kiyinza okulabika ng’oggalawo oluggi ku mikwano gyo egisinga. Omutima gwo gujja kwegomba okubuusabuusa kwo okusinga abaana ba Isirayiri bwe beegomba sefuliya z’ennyama ez’e Misiri. Naye weefiirize; weetikke omusaalaba gwo mu nsonga eno. Gaana awatali kusaasira okuwuliriza ekigambo kyonna. Eggye eddamba ery’okubuusabuusa lyannindirira okuzuukuka ne likonkona ku luggi lwange nga lyagala kuyingira. Tewali kintu kyalabika nga kya ddala oba kya mazima. N’okusinga byonna, kyalabika nga tekisoboka nti nze — omunaku era ow’ennaku — nnali nsobola okuba nga Mukama anjagala, anfaako, oba ankubako eriiso. Singa nnali nsobola okuyingiza okubuusabuusa okwo! Singa nnali nsobola okukuyita kutuule, kwewulire nga kuli waka, nga kyandibadde kya kwejalabya kinene! Naye emyaka mingi emabega, nneeyama obutabuusabuusa. Okumenya obweyamo buno kyandibadde kizibu gye ndi nga okumenya obweyamo bwange obw’obutanywa mwenge. Saayinza kwetantala kuyingiza kubuusabuusa okusooka. Nnasitula engabo yange ey’okukkiriza mu kaseera ke nnyini lwe nnategeera ebirowoozo ebyo. Eggye eryo lyonna nnalikwasa Mukama wange alivvuunuke. Oluvannyuma ne nneeyongera okugamba nti, “Mukama anjagala. Ye Mulokozi wange ow’akaseera kano era atuukiridde; Yesu andokola, Yesu andokola kaakano!” Obuwanguzi bwali bwa ddala. Omulabe yajja ng’amataba. Naye Mukama n’ayimusa bbendera okumulwanyisa. Yawangulwa n’adduka. Emmeeme yange eyimba oluyimba lwa Musa n’abaana ba Isirayiri. Egamba nti: Awo Musa n’abaana ba Isirayiri ne bayimbira Mukama oluyimba luno nga bagamba nti, “Nnaayimbiranga Mukama, kubanga awangudde n’ekitiibwa kingi. Asudde mu nnyanja embalaasi n’omwebagazi waayo.” (Okuva 15:1) “Mukama ge maanyi gange era lwe luyimba lwange, era afuuse obulokozi bwange. Ye Katonda wange, nange nnaamutenderezanga, ye Katonda wa kitange, nange nnaamugulumizanga. Mukama mulwanyi; Mukama, ly’erinnya lye.”(Okuva 15:2-3). Kijja kukuyamba okulwanyisa endumbe z’ekikemo kino eky’okubuusabuusa, bw’onoolaba obulungi nti okubuusabuusa kibi. Kuba kujeemera butereevu Mukama waffe, atulagira nti, “Mbalekera emirembe, era mbawa emirembe gyange. Emirembe gye mbawa tegiringa egy’ensi. Noolwekyo temutyanga era temweraliikiriranga.” (Yokaana 14:27) Bayibuli buli wamu etulagira okwesiga, awatali kwesonyiwa kwonna. Ekiseera n’ebbanga byandimpeddeko okwogera ku kitundu kimu ku kikumi eky’ebyo. Naye tewali ayinza kusoma Zabbuli n’atakakasibwa. Omuntu eyeesiga awatali kubuusabuusa ye yekka asanyusa Katonda era gw’akkiriza. “Okujeema” kwa Isirayiri kwali nti tebeesiga; “Naye bo ne beeyongera bweyongezi okwonoona, ne bajeemera Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo nga bali mu ddungu. Ne bagezesa Katonda mu bugenderevu, nga bamusaba emmere gye baalulunkanira. Era ne boogera ku Katonda; nga bagamba nti, “Katonda asobola okutuliisiza mu ddungu? Weewaawo yakuba olwazi, amazzi ne gakulukuta ng’emigga; naye anaatuwa emmere? Anaawa abantu be ennyama?” Awo Mukama bwe yawulira ebyo n’asunguwala nnyo; omuliro gwe ne gwaka ku Yakobo, n’obusungu bwe ne bubuubuukira ku Isirayiri. Kubanga tebakkiriza Katonda, era tebeesiga maanyi ge agalokola.” (Zabbuli 78:17-22.) Okwawukana ku ekyo, Isaaya ayogera bw’ati ku abo abeesiga: “Mukama alikuuma mirembe oyo amaliridde okumwesiga mu mutima gwe.”(Isaaya 26:3) Tewali kintu kitulumya ng’okubuusabuusibwa mukwano gwaffe. Nkakasa nti tewali kintu kinakuwaza Katonda okusinga okubuusabuusa kwaffe. Omu ku baana bange, kati ali ne Mukama, yaŋŋamba akawungeezi akamu bwe nnali mmubikka ku kitanda, nti, “Maama, nfunye okubuusabuusa kwange okusooka.” “Owange, Ray,” ne mmugamba, “kwali kwa ngeri ki?” “Kale,” n’addamu, “Setaani yajja gye ndi n’aŋŋamba nti nneme kukkiriza Bayibuli, kubanga tekuli kigambo na kimu ekigirimu eky’amazima.” “Era wamugamba ki?” Bwe nnamubuuza. “Owange,” n’addamu ng’ajaguza olw’obuwanguzi, “Nnamugamba bugambi nti, Setaani, nja kugikkiriza. Kiwedde!” Nnasanyuka nnyo olw’okutegeera kw’omwana ono mu by’omwoyo. Yali amanyi engeri y’okwolekagana n’okubuusabuusa. Nnamuzzaamu amaanyi, nga mmunnyonnyola nti okubuusabuusa kwonna n’okuggwaamu amaanyi kwonna biva eri omulabe. Mulimba, n’olwekyo tomuwulirizanga n’akatono. Ekiro ekyaddako, nnali nneerabidde ddala ebyo byonna. N’olwekyo nneewuunya bwe yaŋŋamba, nga mmubikka, nti, “Maama, Setaani azzeemu nate.” “Owange, Ray omwagalwa!” ne ndeekaana nga nneeraliikirivu, “kiki ky’akugambye ku mulundi guno?” “Kale,” n’addamu, “ambuulidde bubuulizi nti ndi muwala mubi nnyo ne kiba nti Yesu tayinza kunjagala. Era nti busirusiru okulowooza nti anjagala.” “Ate kati wamugambye ki?” ne mmubuuza. “Owange!” n’addamu, “Nnamutunuulidde n’obusungu ne mmugamba nti, Setaani, ziba akamwa ko!” Awo n’ayongerako, ng’amwenya, “Tayinza kunnakuwaza n’akatono.” Tewali mmeeme yali erwanye lutalo lusinga olwo omwana ono omuto lwe yalwana, era tewali buwanguzi businga obwo bwali buwanguddwa! Ggwe emmeeme omwagalwa ebuusabuusa, genda okole bw’otyo; era obuwanguzi obufaanana ng’obwo bunaaba bubwo. Bw’onoomala okussa wansi ekitabo kino, kwata ekkalaamu yo owandiike okumalirira kwo obutaddamu kubuusabuusa. Kifuule endagaano ya ddala wakati w’emmeeme yo ne Mukama. Waayo eddembe lyo ery’okubuusabuusa emirembe gyonna. Okwagala kwo mu nsonga eno kuteeke ku ludda lwa Mukama, era mwesige akukuume oleme kugwa. Mubuulire obunafu bwo n’okubuusabuusa kwo. Omulabe wo akunafuyizza n’otasobola kwetaasa. Mukwase olutalo lwonna. Mugambe nti tojja kuddamu kubuusabuusa. Olwo, amaaso go gakuume nga gatunuulidde Yesu. Kyuka okuva ku ggwe kennyini n’okubuusabuusa kwo. Nywerera ku kukkiriza kwo, kubanga eyasuubiza mwesigwa. Bw’onoosigala ng’olina obwesige okutuusa ku nkomerero, ojja, ku bw’oyo akwagala, okuwangula n’okukirawo mu nsonga eno.

fields.title: Ebibala Ebirabika mu Bulamu
fields.body_html:
Bwe kiba nga byonna ebyogeddwa ku bulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda bya mazima, birina okweyoleka mu bulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku.

Abo ababunyumirwa basaanidde okuba “eggwanga ery’envuma, erinyiikirira ebikolwa ebirungi.” Mutabani wange bwe yali ku ttendekero eddene, yawandiikira mukwano gwe nti Abakristaayo bateekwa okuba abajulirwa ba Katonda. Ensi tegenda kusoma Bayibuli, naye ejja kusoma obulamu bwaffe. Okukkiriza kwayo mu ddiini yaffe kwesigamye ku bujulizi obulamu bwaffe bwe buwa. Nga ffenna bwe tumanyi, kino kye kiseera eky’ebintu ebikakafu. Abantu bye babuuza biva ku ndowooza ne bidda ku bintu ebya nnamaddala.

Eddiini yaffe bw’eba ey’okugenda mu maaso, erina okukakasibwa nti esinga okuba endowooza obulowooza. Tulina okulaga ebirowoozo by’omulembe gwaffe ebyekenneenya ennyo, amazima amakulu ag’obulamu obukyusiddwa amaanyi ga Katonda ag’ekitalo agakolera mu ffe okukola by’ayagala. “Mutulage ‘engeri z’obulamu,’ bwe bagamba bannassaayansi, era tujja kukkiriza. Ekkanisa bw’eribalaga, mu bammemba baayo bonna, obulamu obutukuvu, ekigo kyabwe ekisembayo kiriwangulwa.” Njagala, nga sinnaggalawo kitabo kyange, okwogera n’obwegendereza obw’amaanyi ku bibala by’obulamu obw’okukkiriza, ng’obwo bwe mbadde nnyonnyola.

Nzikiriza nti bibala bino byetaagisa. Nkubiriza abasomi bange okuwulira obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe obw’okutambula mu ngeri esaanira okuyitibwa kwabwe okw’ekitiibwa.

Njagala okwogera n’abamu ku mmwe nga mikwano gyange. Nkakasa nti, okuyita mu kitabo kino, okwegomba kwe tugabana kukulidde mu mitima gyammwe, nga bwe kukulidde ne mu gwange. Tusaanidde okutendanga ebirungi by’Oyo eyatuyita okutuggya mu kizikiza n’atuyingiza mu butangaavu bwe obw’ekitalo. Nga mukwano, nsobola okwogera lwatu ne mikwano gyange. Munsonyiwe bwe nnaayogera ku bintu ebimu ebikulu ennyo eby’obulamu n’empisa. Bikulu nnyo eri okukula okwa nnamaddala okw’Omukristaayo.

Omutindo gw’obulamu obutukuvu mu Bakristaayo guli wansi. Okwewaayo kwonna okwa nnamaddala mu bulamu ne mu ntambula kwewuunyisa bangi mu Kkanisa, era emirundi mingi tebakusiima. Abasinga obungi ku abo abeeyita abagoberezi ba Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo tebamufaanana. Omuntu ow’ebweru abatunuulira yandirabye okukwatagana kutono nnyo wakati wabwe naye.

Naye ffe abawulidde okuyita kwa Katonda okw’okwewaayo okujjuvu n’okwesiga, tulina okukola mu ngeri ya njawulo. Tulina okuva mu nsi ne twawukana nayo, era tetulina kugifaanana mu mpisa zaffe wadde mu bigendererwa byaffe.

Tetukyalina kugabana ku mwoyo gwayo wadde ku makubo gaayo.

Emboozi yaffe erina okuba ey’omu ggulu. Tulina okunoonya ebintu ebiri waggulu, Kristo gy’atudde ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda. Tulina okutambula mu nsi nga Kristo bwe yatambula. Tulina okubeeramu endowooza eyali mu ye.

Ng’abatambuze era abagenyi, tulina okwewala okwegomba kw’omubiri okulwana n’emmeeme. Ng’abaserikale abalungi aba Yesu Kristo, tulina okwewala ebya bulijjo eby’ensi nga bwe kisoboka. Kino kwe kusanyusa Oyo eyatulonda okuba abaserikale.

Tulina okwewala buli ngeri ya kibi. Tulina okuba ab’ekisa era abasonyiwa bannaffe. Katonda, ku lwa Kristo, yatusonyiwa. Tetulina kusibira kiruyi abatukola obubi oba abatatulaga kisa. Wabula tusaanidde okusasula ekibi n’ekirungi, n’okukyusiza ettama eddala abo abatulumya. Tulina bulijjo okutwala ekifo ekisembayo wansi mu bantu bannaffe; ne tutanoonya kitiibwa kyaffe, wabula ekitiibwa ky’abalala. Tulina okuba abakkakkamu, abawombeefu, era abagonvu; nga tetulwanirira ddembe lyaffe, wabula eddembe ly’abalala. Byonna bye tukola birina okukolebwa olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Mu bufunze, okuva Oyo eyatuyita bw’ali omutukuvu, naffe tulina okuba abatukuvu mu mpisa zaffe. Kyawandiikibwa nti, “Mubenga batukuvu, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu.”

Kale, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, kino kyonna kikwata ku bulamu obwa buli lunaku. Mazima kitegeeza obulamu obw’enjawulo ennyo ku bulamu bw’abasinga obungi ku abo abeeyita Abakristaayo. Kitegeeza nti mu mazima ddala era mu bujjuvu tukuba amabega eri okwerowoozaako, n’eri ensonga zaakwo n’ebigendererwa byakwo. Tuli eggwanga ery’enjawulo, eri Katonda n’eri ensi. Obulamu bwaffe n’ebigambo byaffe ebifaanana Kristo bijja kulaga nti tugoberera Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Tetuli ba nsi, nga ye bwe yali nga si wa nsi. Tetujja kuddamu kuwulira nti ssente zaffe zaffe, wabula za Mukama, za kukozesebwa mu buweereza bwe. Tetuyinza kukozesa maanyi gaffe okunoonya ebintu by’ensi byokka. Bwe tusooka okunoonya obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, tujja kufuna bye twetaaga.

Tujja kugaanibwa okunoonya ebifo ebya waggulu oba amagoba ag’ensi. Tetujja kukkirizibwa kufaanana nsi mu ngeri zaffe ez’okulowooza oba ez’okubeera abalamu. Tetujja kuba na kwegomba kwonna kwetaba mu by’amasanyu ebitaliimu eby’ensi. Tusaanidde okwagala ebintu eby’omu ggulu, so si eby’oku nsi. Tetujja kweweereza ffekka, wabula Mukama waffe. Tujja kutuukiriza emirimu gyaffe obulungi okusinga bwe kyali kibadde. Tujja kukola nga Ekigambo bwe kigamba nti: “Ekyo temukikola lwa kulabibwa, abantu balyoke babasiime, wabula mukolenga ng’abaddu ba Kristo nga mukola n’omutima gwammwe gwonna, nga Katonda bw’ayagala.”

Bwe tutaba na kipimo kitangaavu eky’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo, tuyinza obutategeera ddoboozi lye olw’obutamanya. Kale njagala okwogera lwatu era mu ngeri entegeerekeka. Nkirabye nti, awali okugoberera Mukama mu bwesigwa mu mmeeme eyeewaayo gy’ali, ebintu ebiwerako bigoberera, amangu oba oluvannyuma. Mpolampola, obukkakkamu n’okusirika kw’omwoyo bifuuka obulamu obwa buli lunaku. Wabaawo okukkiriza n’obuwulize okwagala kwa Katonda, nga bwe kujja mu bintu ebibaawo buli lunaku.

Era wabaawo obugonvu mu mikono gya Katonda okukola oba okubonaabona nga bw’ayagala. Ate era, wateekwa okubaawo obuwoomu ng’omuntu asunguwazibwa, emirembe wakati mu kavuyo, n’okukkiriza ebyo abalala bye baagala. Wabaawo obutafaayo ku kunyoomebwa n’obutaba na kweraliikirira. Okutya n’okweraliikirira biggwaawo. Bino byonna, n’ebirabo ebirala bingi eby’ekisa ebifaanana bwe bityo, bye bibala ebya bulijjo eby’obulamu obw’omunda obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda.

Ku bikwata ku mpisa zaabwe: bulijjo tulaba Abakristaayo ab’engeri eyo, amangu oba oluvannyuma, nga beewaayo ku mulimu ogumu ogwa Katonda n’ogw’abantu bannaabwe. Baba beetegefu okwewaayo n’okwemalira mu buweereza bwa Mukama waabwe. Tebakyafaayo nnyo ku bintu by’omu nnyumba zaabwe ne ku ngeri gye babeeramu. Eby’okwewunda byonna babifuula bya kubiri ng’ogeraageranya n’ebintu bya Katonda.

Eddoboozi liweebwayo eri Katonda, okwogera n’okuyimba ku lulwe. Ensawo y’ensimbi eteekebwa mu buyinza bwe. Ekkalaamu eweebwayo okuwandiika ku lulwe, emimwa okwogera ku lulwe, emikono n’ebigere okukola by’alagira. Buli mwaka, Abakristaayo ab’engeri eyo beeyongera obutaba ba nsi n’okulowooza ku by’omu ggulu. Beeyongera okufaanana Kristo.

Obwenyi bwabwe bulaga obulamu obulungi obw’obwakatonda obubali munda. Bonna ababatunuulira bamanya nti babeera wamu ne Katonda era babeera mu ye.

Nkakasa nti buli omu ku mmwe awulidde obubonero obumu obuva eri Katonda. Bulaga nga bukyali obulamu bwe nnyonnyola kaakano. Totandise kuwulira, munda wala mu mmeeme yo, eddoboozi lya Katonda nga likwogerako ku bintu bino? Tekikulumye era tekikunakuwazizza mu kiseera kino okuzuula nga bingi nnyo ebikyamu mu bulamu bwo? Emmeeme yo tetawaanyiziddwa kubuusabuusa ku mpisa ezimu ze wali weemalirako edda? Totandise kuwulira nga tobudaala olw’empisa ezimu? Tewandyagadde okuzikyusa? Amakubo ag’okwewaayo n’ag’okuweereza tegatandise kweggulawo mu maaso go, n’ekirowoozo eky’okwegomba nti, “Owange, singa nnyinza okugatambuliramu”?

Okwegomba kwo kwonna, okubuusabuusa kwo, n’ennaku yo, lye ddoboozi ly’Omusumba Omulungi. Likuyita okuva ku byonna ebikontana n’okwagala kwe. Owange! Ka nkwegayirire oleme kukyuka kuva ku kwegayirira kwe okw’ekisa. Tomanyi n’akatono amakubo ag’ekyama gy’ategeka okukutwala ng’ayita mu mitendera gino gyennyini. Tomanyi mikisa minene egiri ku nkomerero yaago. Singa wali ogimanyi, wandigondedde n’essanyu byonna by’akwetaagisa. Osobola okutuuka ku ntikko z’okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo. Okukikola, olina okugoberera Omukulembeze anaakutwalayo. Akulaga ekkubo lyo omutendera gumu gumu, ng’ayita mu bulamu bwo obwa buli lunaku. Akusaba kimu kyokka: okwewaayo eri obulagirizi bwe.

Bw’oba okakasiddwa mu mutima gwo ekibi kyonna, eryo lye ddoboozi lya Mukama wo. Kimuweeyo amangu ddala nga bw’alagira.

Sanyuka nti atandise okukukulembera n’okukuluŋŋamya.

Beera mugonvu ddala mu mikono gye egy’amagezi. Genda gy’akusikiriza. Kyuka okuva ku byonna by’akuleetera okwekengera. Mugondere mu bujjuvu. Ajja kukutwala mangu era mu ngeri ennyangu mu bulamu obw’ekitalo obw’okufaanana ye. Bulijja kuba bujulizi eri bonna abakwetoolodde, okusukka ku ekyo ky’olimanya.

Nnamanya omukyala omu eyeewaayo okugoberera Mukama yonna gye yamukulembera. Mu myezi esatu, yava mu kuggwaamu essuubi okw’amaanyi n’atuuka mu kwegatta okw’omukisa ne Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo.

Mu kizikiza kye, yeewaayo eri Mukama. Yamuwaayo okwagala kwe. Yayagala Mukama akolere mu ye, akole ekyo ekimusanyusa. Mukama n’atandika okwogera naye ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we mu mutima gwe. Yamulaga obukolwa obutono obw’okumuweereza. Yamuyita okuva mu makubo gonna agatali ga Kristo.

Yategeera eddoboozi lye. Yatya kimu kyokka: okumujeemera. Bw’atyo n’amugoberera, ng’agondera buli kye yamusaba, yonna gye yamukulembera. Mukama n’amukulembera mu maaso, lunaku ku lunaku. N’amufaananya n’okwagala kwe. Obulamu bwe bwafuuka bujulizi eri abo abaali bamwetoolodde. N’abamu ku abo abaawakanya era abataakkiriza baawalirizibwa okukkiriza nti kyava wa Katonda. Baasikirizibwa ne beewaayo mu ngeri y’emu.

Oluvannyuma lw’emyezi esatu gyokka egy’okugoberera kuno okw’obwesigwa, ekyo ne kituukirira. Yali atambudde mangu nnyo ne kiba nti Mukama we yasobola okubikkulira emmeeme ye eyali ewuniikiridde ebimu ku byama bye eby’okwagala ebisinga obuziba. Yatuukiriza ekisuubizo kya (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:5) “Yokaana yabatiza na mazzi, naye mmwe mujja kubatizibwa na Mwoyo Mutukuvu mu nnaku si nnyingi.” ng’amubatiza n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Olowooza yali yejjusizza okumugoberera mu bujjuvu? Oba nti waliwo ekintu ekirala okuggyako essanyu ekijjuza omutima gwe? Yeebaza olw’ekkubo eryamutuusa mu kifo kino eky’ekitalo. Egimu ku mitendera egyo gyali mizibu mu kiseera ekyo, naye tagyejjusa. Bw’oba oyagala omukisa, weewaayo ddala eri Mukama waffe ow’Obwakatonda, nga ye bwe yakola. Toziyiza kwewaayo kwonna kw’akusaba.

Ekkubo erituukiridde lizibu eri omubiri. Naye si lizibu eri okwagala. Singa wali mulwadde era nga weetaaga Katonda, wandyanguyirizza nnyo kwenkana wa? Mazima, osobola okumwesiga! Ebimu by’akusaba biyinza okuba ebintu ebitali bya mugaso munene gy’oli. Biyinza okulabika ng’ebitasaanira kufiibwako Mukama. Jjukira nti Mukama tatunuulira ebyo abantu bye batunuulira; ekitono gy’oli kiyinza okuba, mu maaso ge, ekisumuluzo ky’ekintu ekisinga obuziba. Okukubumba ng’okwagala kwe bwe kuli, ateekwa okukusanga ng’oli mugonvu. Obugonvu buno bufunibwa mangu nnyo bw’ogonda mu bintu ebitono okusinga mu binene. Okwegomba kwo okukulu okumu kwe kumugoberera mu bujjuvu; kale toyinza kumugamba bulijjo nti “Weewaawo, Mukama!” eri ebiragiro bye byonna ebiwoomu, ebitono oba ebinene, n’omwesiga okukukulembera mu kkubo erisinga obumpi okutuuka ku mukisa gwo ogusingira ddala obujjuvu?

Mukwano gwange omwagalwa, kino, era tewali kitono ku kino, kye kyali amakulu g’okwewaayo kwo, ka obe nga wali okimanyi oba nedda. Kyali kitegeeza obuwulize obutaliiko kwekwasa. Kyali kitegeeza nti okwagala kwa Katonda wo okuva olwo kwali kwa kuba okwagala kwo mu mbeera zonna ne mu biseera byonna. Kyali kitegeeza nti, okuva olwo, walekulira eddembe lyo. Weewaayo ddala wansi w’obuyinza bwa Mukama wo. Kyali kitegeeza okumugoberera buli ssaawa, yonna gy’akukulembera, awatali kirooto kya kudda nnyuma. Kaakano nkusaba otuukirize ekigambo kyo. Byonna ebirala bireke bigende. Beera mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku ng’olaga obulamu obw’obwakatonda obuli munda mu ggwe. Wegattiddwa ne Mukama wo n’enkolagana ey’ekitalo. Kale, tambula nga ye bwe yatambula. Laga ensi amaanyi ge ag’okulokola ng’omuleka akulokole ddala. Tolina kutya kukkiriza kino, kubanga ye Mulokozi wo, era amaanyi ge gasobola okukola byonna. Takusaba, mu bunafu bwo, okukikola. Akusaba bwokka okwewaayo gy’ali. Olwo, ajja kukozesa amaanyi ge okukwagaza okukikola n’okukusobozesa okukikola. Omulimu gwo kwe kwewaayo. Ogugwe kwe kukola. Talikuwa kiragiro nga takuwadde maanyi ga kukigondera.

Teweeraliikiriranga bya nkya. Esiga Mukama wo akwagala. Yasuubiza okukulembera endiga ze mu kkubo ery’emirembe era eryangu. Kwata buli mutendera ogw’okweyongerayo nga bw’agukulaga obulungi. Leeta obulamu bwo bwonna, mu buli kitundu kyabwo, gy’ali abuteeketeeke era abukulembere. Goberera n’essanyu era mangu obulagirizi obuwoomu obw’Omwoyo we mu mmeeme yo. Era, lunaku ku lunaku, ojja kumulaba. Ajja kukufaananya nnyo okwagala kwe mu bintu byonna. Ajja, nga bw’onoosobola okukigumira, okukubumba. Olwo, ojja kuba ekibya eky’ekitiibwa kye, ekitukuziddwa era ekyetegefu olw’omulimu gwonna omulungi. Ojja kuba n’essanyu ery’okuba ebbaluwa ya Kristo, emanyiddwa era esomebwa abantu bonna.

Omusana gwo gujja kwaka nnyo ne kiba nti, abantu bwe banaalaba ebikolwa byo ebirungi, bajja kugulumiza Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, so si ggwe.

Katonda yatulonda olubereberye “okufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi ky’Omwana we”. Kino kitegeeza, kya lwatu, si kufaanana mu ndabika ya mubiri, wabula kufaanana mu mpisa ne mu buzaaliranwa. Kitegeeza okufaanana mu birowoozo, mu nneewulira, mu kwegomba, mu bye twagala ne mu bye tukyawa. Kitegeeza nti tusaanidde okulowooza n’okukola nga Kristo bwe yandikoze, singa yali mu mbeera zaffe.

Omuwala omuto yabuuzibwako omulundi gumu amakulu g’okuba Omukristaayo. Yaddamu nti, “Kitegeeza okuba nga Kristo bwe yandibadde, singa yali muwala muto ng’abeera mu nnyumba yaffe.” Ekyama ky’obulamu bwa Kristo kyali kwagala kwe okutaliimu kwerowoozaako eri abalala. Bwe tuba nga tumufaanana, kino kijja kuba kyama kyaffe naffe. Yalokola abalala, naye ye kennyini teyasobola kwerokola. Ye “teyeesanyusa yekka.” Kale naffe kitugwanidde okukola bwe tutyo, “so si okwesanyusa ffekka.” Wabula tusaanidde okusanyusa muliraanwa waffe, bwe kiba kya bulungi bwe.

Omuhindu omu omulowoozi, eyakyalira gye buvuddeko Bungereza ne Amerika okusoma Obukristaayo, yagamba nti, “Abakristaayo kye beetaaga bwe Bukristaayo bwa Kristo obusingako katono, n’Obukristaayo bw’abantu obukendeezeddwako katono.” Obukristaayo bw’abantu buyigiriza okwefiiriza okwerokola ffekka. Obukristaayo bwa Kristo buyigiriza okwefiiriza okulokola abalala. Obukristaayo bw’abantu buzaala okwerowoozaako okutaliimu bibala okuli mu bingi nnyo eby’eddiini yaffe. Obukristaayo bwa Kristo buzaala obutaba na kwerowoozaako okw’omukisa. Buva mu bulamu obuyiwiddwa ku lw’abalala, nga obubwe bwe bwali. Mu bufunze, ekitabo kyaffe kiyigiriza ekintu kimu: tulina okuba Abakristaayo abafaanana Kristo. Era byonna bye tuyitamu tebiriiko kye bigasa bwe bitaleeta kivaamu kino. “Si bonna abampita nti, ‘Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe,’ be baliyingira obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, wabula abo bokka abakola ebyo Kitange ali mu ggulu by’ayagala.” (Matayo 7:21)
