Mazima kitegeeza obulamu obw’enjawulo ennyo ku bulamu bw’abasinga obungi ku abo abeeyita Abakristaayo. Kitegeeza nti mu mazima ddala era mu bujjuvu tukuba amabega eri okwerowoozaako, n’eri ensonga zaakwo n’ebigendererwa byakwo. Tuli eggwanga ery’enjawulo, eri Katonda n’eri ensi. Obulamu bwaffe n’ebigambo byaffe ebifaanana Kristo bijja kulaga nti tugoberera Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Tetuli ba nsi, nga ye bwe yali nga si wa nsi. Tetujja kuddamu kuwulira nti ssente zaffe zaffe, wabula za Mukama, za kukozesebwa mu buweereza bwe. Tetuyinza kukozesa maanyi gaffe okunoonya ebintu by’ensi byokka. Bwe tusooka okunoonya obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, tujja kufuna bye twetaaga. Tujja kugaanibwa okunoonya ebifo ebya waggulu oba amagoba ag’ensi. Tetujja kukkirizibwa kufaanana nsi mu ngeri zaffe ez’okulowooza oba ez’okubeera abalamu. Tetujja kuba na kwegomba kwonna kwetaba mu by’amasanyu ebitaliimu eby’ensi. Tusaanidde okwagala ebintu eby’omu ggulu, so si eby’oku nsi. Tetujja kweweereza ffekka, wabula Mukama waffe. Tujja kutuukiriza emirimu gyaffe obulungi okusinga bwe kyali kibadde. Tujja kukola nga Ekigambo bwe kigamba nti: “Ekyo temukikola lwa kulabibwa, abantu balyoke babasiime, wabula mukolenga ng’abaddu ba Kristo nga mukola n’omutima gwammwe gwonna, nga Katonda bw’ayagala.” Bwe tutaba na kipimo kitangaavu eky’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo, tuyinza obutategeera ddoboozi lye olw’obutamanya. Kale njagala okwogera lwatu era mu ngeri entegeerekeka. Nkirabye nti, awali okugoberera Mukama mu bwesigwa mu mmeeme eyeewaayo gy’ali, ebintu ebiwerako bigoberera, amangu oba oluvannyuma. Mpolampola, obukkakkamu n’okusirika kw’omwoyo bifuuka obulamu obwa buli lunaku. Wabaawo okukkiriza n’obuwulize okwagala kwa Katonda, nga bwe kujja mu bintu ebibaawo buli lunaku. Era wabaawo obugonvu mu mikono gya Katonda okukola oba okubonaabona nga bw’ayagala. Ate era, wateekwa okubaawo obuwoomu ng’omuntu asunguwazibwa, emirembe wakati mu kavuyo, n’okukkiriza ebyo abalala bye baagala. Wabaawo obutafaayo ku kunyoomebwa n’obutaba na kweraliikirira. Okutya n’okweraliikirira biggwaawo. Bino byonna, n’ebirabo ebirala bingi eby’ekisa ebifaanana bwe bityo, bye bibala ebya bulijjo eby’obulamu obw’omunda obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda. Ku bikwata ku mpisa zaabwe: bulijjo tulaba Abakristaayo ab’engeri eyo, amangu oba oluvannyuma, nga beewaayo ku mulimu ogumu ogwa Katonda n’ogw’abantu bannaabwe. Baba beetegefu okwewaayo n’okwemalira mu buweereza bwa Mukama waabwe. Tebakyafaayo nnyo ku bintu by’omu nnyumba zaabwe ne ku ngeri gye babeeramu. Eby’okwewunda byonna babifuula bya kubiri ng’ogeraageranya n’ebintu bya Katonda. Eddoboozi liweebwayo eri Katonda, okwogera n’okuyimba ku lulwe. Ensawo y’ensimbi eteekebwa mu buyinza bwe. Ekkalaamu eweebwayo okuwandiika ku lulwe, emimwa okwogera ku lulwe, emikono n’ebigere okukola by’alagira. Buli mwaka, Abakristaayo ab’engeri eyo beeyongera obutaba ba nsi n’okulowooza ku by’omu ggulu. Beeyongera okufaanana Kristo. Obwenyi bwabwe bulaga obulamu obulungi obw’obwakatonda obubali munda. Bonna ababatunuulira bamanya nti babeera wamu ne Katonda era babeera mu ye. Nkakasa nti buli omu ku mmwe awulidde obubonero obumu obuva eri Katonda. Bulaga nga bukyali obulamu bwe nnyonnyola kaakano. Totandise kuwulira, munda wala mu mmeeme yo, eddoboozi lya Katonda nga likwogerako ku bintu bino? Tekikulumye era tekikunakuwazizza mu kiseera kino okuzuula nga bingi nnyo ebikyamu mu bulamu bwo? Emmeeme yo tetawaanyiziddwa kubuusabuusa ku mpisa ezimu ze wali weemalirako edda? Totandise kuwulira nga tobudaala olw’empisa ezimu? Tewandyagadde okuzikyusa? Amakubo ag’okwewaayo n’ag’okuweereza tegatandise kweggulawo mu maaso go, n’ekirowoozo eky’okwegomba nti, “Owange, singa nnyinza okugatambuliramu”? Okwegomba kwo kwonna, okubuusabuusa kwo, n’ennaku yo, lye ddoboozi ly’Omusumba Omulungi. Likuyita okuva ku byonna ebikontana n’okwagala kwe. Owange! Ka nkwegayirire oleme kukyuka kuva ku kwegayirira kwe okw’ekisa. Tomanyi n’akatono amakubo ag’ekyama gy’ategeka okukutwala ng’ayita mu mitendera gino gyennyini. Tomanyi mikisa minene egiri ku nkomerero yaago. Singa wali ogimanyi, wandigondedde n’essanyu byonna by’akwetaagisa. Osobola okutuuka ku ntikko z’okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo. Okukikola, olina okugoberera Omukulembeze anaakutwalayo. Akulaga ekkubo lyo omutendera gumu gumu, ng’ayita mu bulamu bwo obwa buli lunaku. Akusaba kimu kyokka: okwewaayo eri obulagirizi bwe. Bw’oba okakasiddwa mu mutima gwo ekibi kyonna, eryo lye ddoboozi lya Mukama wo. Kimuweeyo amangu ddala nga bw’alagira. Sanyuka nti atandise okukukulembera n’okukuluŋŋamya. Beera mugonvu ddala mu mikono gye egy’amagezi. Genda gy’akusikiriza. Kyuka okuva ku byonna by’akuleetera okwekengera. Mugondere mu bujjuvu. Ajja kukutwala mangu era mu ngeri ennyangu mu bulamu obw’ekitalo obw’okufaanana ye. Bulijja kuba bujulizi eri bonna abakwetoolodde, okusukka ku ekyo ky’olimanya. Nnamanya omukyala omu eyeewaayo okugoberera Mukama yonna gye yamukulembera. Mu myezi esatu, yava mu kuggwaamu essuubi okw’amaanyi n’atuuka mu kwegatta okw’omukisa ne Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Mu kizikiza kye, yeewaayo eri Mukama. Yamuwaayo okwagala kwe. Yayagala Mukama akolere mu ye, akole ekyo ekimusanyusa. Mukama n’atandika okwogera naye ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we mu mutima gwe. Yamulaga obukolwa obutono obw’okumuweereza. Yamuyita okuva mu makubo gonna agatali ga Kristo. Yategeera eddoboozi lye. Yatya kimu kyokka: okumujeemera. Bw’atyo n’amugoberera, ng’agondera buli kye yamusaba, yonna gye yamukulembera. Mukama n’amukulembera mu maaso, lunaku ku lunaku. N’amufaananya n’okwagala kwe. Obulamu bwe bwafuuka bujulizi eri abo abaali bamwetoolodde. N’abamu ku abo abaawakanya era abataakkiriza baawalirizibwa okukkiriza nti kyava wa Katonda. Baasikirizibwa ne beewaayo mu ngeri y’emu. Oluvannyuma lw’emyezi esatu gyokka egy’okugoberera kuno okw’obwesigwa, ekyo ne kituukirira. Yali atambudde mangu nnyo ne kiba nti Mukama we yasobola okubikkulira emmeeme ye eyali ewuniikiridde ebimu ku byama bye eby’okwagala ebisinga obuziba. Yatuukiriza ekisuubizo kya (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:5) “Yokaana yabatiza na mazzi, naye mmwe mujja kubatizibwa na Mwoyo Mutukuvu mu nnaku si nnyingi.” ng’amubatiza n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Olowooza yali yejjusizza okumugoberera mu bujjuvu? Oba nti waliwo ekintu ekirala okuggyako essanyu ekijjuza omutima gwe? Yeebaza olw’ekkubo eryamutuusa mu kifo kino eky’ekitalo. Egimu ku mitendera egyo gyali mizibu mu kiseera ekyo, naye tagyejjusa. Bw’oba oyagala omukisa, weewaayo ddala eri Mukama waffe ow’Obwakatonda, nga ye bwe yakola. Toziyiza kwewaayo kwonna kw’akusaba. Ekkubo erituukiridde lizibu eri omubiri. Naye si lizibu eri okwagala. Singa wali mulwadde era nga weetaaga Katonda, wandyanguyirizza nnyo kwenkana wa? Mazima, osobola okumwesiga! Ebimu by’akusaba biyinza okuba ebintu ebitali bya mugaso munene gy’oli. Biyinza okulabika ng’ebitasaanira kufiibwako Mukama. Jjukira nti Mukama tatunuulira ebyo abantu bye batunuulira; ekitono gy’oli kiyinza okuba, mu maaso ge, ekisumuluzo ky’ekintu ekisinga obuziba. Okukubumba ng’okwagala kwe bwe kuli, ateekwa okukusanga ng’oli mugonvu. Obugonvu buno bufunibwa mangu nnyo bw’ogonda mu bintu ebitono okusinga mu binene. Okwegomba kwo okukulu okumu kwe kumugoberera mu bujjuvu; kale toyinza kumugamba bulijjo nti “Weewaawo, Mukama!” eri ebiragiro bye byonna ebiwoomu, ebitono oba ebinene, n’omwesiga okukukulembera mu kkubo erisinga obumpi okutuuka ku mukisa gwo ogusingira ddala obujjuvu? Mukwano gwange omwagalwa, kino, era tewali kitono ku kino, kye kyali amakulu g’okwewaayo kwo, ka obe nga wali okimanyi oba nedda. Kyali kitegeeza obuwulize obutaliiko kwekwasa. Kyali kitegeeza nti okwagala kwa Katonda wo okuva olwo kwali kwa kuba okwagala kwo mu mbeera zonna ne mu biseera byonna. Kyali kitegeeza nti, okuva olwo, walekulira eddembe lyo. Weewaayo ddala wansi w’obuyinza bwa Mukama wo. Kyali kitegeeza okumugoberera buli ssaawa, yonna gy’akukulembera, awatali kirooto kya kudda nnyuma. Kaakano nkusaba otuukirize ekigambo kyo. Byonna ebirala bireke bigende. Beera mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku ng’olaga obulamu obw’obwakatonda obuli munda mu ggwe. Wegattiddwa ne Mukama wo n’enkolagana ey’ekitalo. Kale, tambula nga ye bwe yatambula. Laga ensi amaanyi ge ag’okulokola ng’omuleka akulokole ddala. Tolina kutya kukkiriza kino, kubanga ye Mulokozi wo, era amaanyi ge gasobola okukola byonna. Takusaba, mu bunafu bwo, okukikola. Akusaba bwokka okwewaayo gy’ali. Olwo, ajja kukozesa amaanyi ge okukwagaza okukikola n’okukusobozesa okukikola. Omulimu gwo kwe kwewaayo. Ogugwe kwe kukola. Talikuwa kiragiro nga takuwadde maanyi ga kukigondera. Teweeraliikiriranga bya nkya. Esiga Mukama wo akwagala. Yasuubiza okukulembera endiga ze mu kkubo ery’emirembe era eryangu. Kwata buli mutendera ogw’okweyongerayo nga bw’agukulaga obulungi. Leeta obulamu bwo bwonna, mu buli kitundu kyabwo, gy’ali abuteeketeeke era abukulembere. Goberera n’essanyu era mangu obulagirizi obuwoomu obw’Omwoyo we mu mmeeme yo. Era, lunaku ku lunaku, ojja kumulaba. Ajja kukufaananya nnyo okwagala kwe mu bintu byonna. Ajja, nga bw’onoosobola okukigumira, okukubumba. Olwo, ojja kuba ekibya eky’ekitiibwa kye, ekitukuziddwa era ekyetegefu olw’omulimu gwonna omulungi. Ojja kuba n’essanyu ery’okuba ebbaluwa ya Kristo, emanyiddwa era esomebwa abantu bonna. Omusana gwo gujja kwaka nnyo ne kiba nti, abantu bwe banaalaba ebikolwa byo ebirungi, bajja kugulumiza Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, so si ggwe. Katonda yatulonda olubereberye “okufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi ky’Omwana we”. Kino kitegeeza, kya lwatu, si kufaanana mu ndabika ya mubiri, wabula kufaanana mu mpisa ne mu buzaaliranwa. Kitegeeza okufaanana mu birowoozo, mu nneewulira, mu kwegomba, mu bye twagala ne mu bye tukyawa. Kitegeeza nti tusaanidde okulowooza n’okukola nga Kristo bwe yandikoze, singa yali mu mbeera zaffe. Omuwala omuto yabuuzibwako omulundi gumu amakulu g’okuba Omukristaayo. Yaddamu nti, “Kitegeeza okuba nga Kristo bwe yandibadde, singa yali muwala muto ng’abeera mu nnyumba yaffe.” Ekyama ky’obulamu bwa Kristo kyali kwagala kwe okutaliimu kwerowoozaako eri abalala. Bwe tuba nga tumufaanana, kino kijja kuba kyama kyaffe naffe. Yalokola abalala, naye ye kennyini teyasobola kwerokola. Ye “teyeesanyusa yekka.” Kale naffe kitugwanidde okukola bwe tutyo, “so si okwesanyusa ffekka.” Wabula tusaanidde okusanyusa muliraanwa waffe, bwe kiba kya bulungi bwe. Omuhindu omu omulowoozi, eyakyalira gye buvuddeko Bungereza ne Amerika okusoma Obukristaayo, yagamba nti, “Abakristaayo kye beetaaga bwe Bukristaayo bwa Kristo obusingako katono, n’Obukristaayo bw’abantu obukendeezeddwako katono.” Obukristaayo bw’abantu buyigiriza okwefiiriza okwerokola ffekka. Obukristaayo bwa Kristo buyigiriza okwefiiriza okulokola abalala. Obukristaayo bw’abantu buzaala okwerowoozaako okutaliimu bibala okuli mu bingi nnyo eby’eddiini yaffe. Obukristaayo bwa Kristo buzaala obutaba na kwerowoozaako okw’omukisa. Buva mu bulamu obuyiwiddwa ku lw’abalala, nga obubwe bwe bwali. Mu bufunze, ekitabo kyaffe kiyigiriza ekintu kimu: tulina okuba Abakristaayo abafaanana Kristo. Era byonna bye tuyitamu tebiriiko kye bigasa bwe bitaleeta kivaamu kino. “Si bonna abampita nti, ‘Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe,’ be baliyingira obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, wabula abo bokka abakola ebyo Kitange ali mu ggulu by’ayagala.” (Matayo 7:21)

fields.title: Essanyu ery’Obuwulize
fields.body_html:
Lumu nnasoma nti: “Obuwulize obutuukiridde bwandireese essanyu erituukiridde, singa twalina obwesige obutuukiridde mu buyinza bwe tugondera.” Ekigambo ekyo kyankwatako nnyo. Kyandaga ekkubo ery’okufuna essanyu erisoboka, naye lye sirootangako n’akatono. Oluvannyuma, wadde nga nnali wa bujeemu, ekigambo ekyo kyagenda kinkomako buli kiseera. Kyansuubiza ekiwummulo n’ekkubo ery’okukula. Kyakkakkanya era ne kimatiza okwegomba kwange.

Nteekwa okugamba nti ekiwummulo ekyo nkizudde, si ng’ekirooto, wabula ng’ekintu ekiriwo ddala. Nkirabye mu Mukama Yesu, Mukama waffe. Tusobola okumwewaayo ne twetikka ekikoligo kye, ne tufuna ekiwummulo ekituukiridde. Ggwe, omwoyo omwagalwa atatya okusalawo, tomanyi ssanyu ly’ofiirwa. Mukama yeeyolese gy’oli. Akuyita okwewaayo gy’ali ddala ddala. Naye ggwe weekyusa n’olonzalonza. Oli mwetegefu okwewaayo ekitundu, era olowooza nti ddala kituufu era kigwanidde okukikola. Naye olabika ng’alowooza nti okwewaayo kwonna, awatali kwekumirako kantu, kusukkiridde okusabibwa. Kikutiisa. Olowooza nti kwetaagisa bingi nnyo, era mulimu munene nnyo. Oyagala okugonda ku kigero ekipimiddwa; naye ekirowoozo eky’okugonda ddala ddala kikuggwaamu amaanyi.

Olaba ne emyoyo emirala. Gitambulira mu kkubo eggazi okusinga eryo eriteekeddwawo ggwe, nga emitima gyagyo tegibasalira musango. Weebuuza nti, lwaki kiri bwe kityo? Kikulabikira ng’ekyewuunyisa, era oboolyawo nga kizibu, nti oteekwa okukola ebyo bo bye bateetaaga kukola. Era oteekwa okulekayo ebyo bo bye balina eddembe okukola. Ayi! Omukristaayo omwagalwa, enjawulo eno yennyini wakati wammwe kye kitiibwa kyo, wadde nga tonnakimanya. Mukama wo agamba nti, “Buli alina ebiragiro byange n’abigonderanga, oyo y’anjagala; era anjagala, ne Kitange anaamwagalanga. Era nange nnaamwagalanga, era nnaamulabikiranga.” (Yokaana 14:21) Ggwe olina ebiragiro bye; abo b’okwatirwa obuggya tebabirina. Omanyi Mukama wo by’ayagala mu bintu bingi, bo mwe bakyatambulira mu kizikiza. Ekyo si kitiibwa? Kya nnaku nti omwoyo gwo guli kumpi nnyo ne Mukama wo? Asobola okukubuulira ebintu abo abali ewala bye batamanyi. Tolaba nti kino kitegeeza omukwano ogw’okumpi era omugonvu bwe gutyo?

Enkolagana nnyingi mu bulamu zeetaagisa bwetaavu okwewaayo okutono okuva ku njuyi zombi. Tuyinza okuba n’emikwano eminene.

Naye ebiseera ebisinga obungi eby’obulamu bwaffe tubimala nga buli omu ali ku bibye, nga tugoberera ebintu eby’enjawulo. Bwe tuba wamu, tuyinza okusanyukira okubeera awamu. Tuyinza okuzuula ebintu bingi bye tulinamu ekitundu ffembi. Naye okwawukana tekutunakuwaza. Emikwano emirala egy’okumpi okusingawo tegitutaataaganya. Tetulina kwagala kumala kutuwa ddembe, wadde okwegomba, okugabana ebyama byaffe eby’omunda ennyo. Tuwulira nti okwekuuma ku kigero n’okubeera n’ebbanga wakati waffe kye kituufu. Naye waliwo enkolagana endala mu bulamu ng’ebyo byonna bikyuka. Omukwano gufuuka okwagala. Emitima ebiri gyewaayo eri gyombi, ne giba nga tegikyali ebiri wabula gumu.

Emyoyo gyegatta, era okwegatta okwo kufuula buli kintu eky’omu omu okuba eky’omulala. Ebyo bye baagobereranga nga buli omu ku lulwe n’amakubo ag’enjawulo mu bulamu tebikyasoboka. Ebintu ebyali bikkirizibwa edda kati tebikyakkirizibwa. Kiri bwe kityo olw’obunywevu bw’omukwano ogubagatta. Okwekuuma n’ebbanga ebisaanira obwemikwano obwa bulijjo bifuuka eby’okuzikiriza mu kwagala. Okwagala kuwaayo byonna, era kuteekwa okuddizibwa byonna. Omu by’ayagala bisiba munne.

Buli mutima gwegomba okumanya munne by’ayagala mu kyama. Gwagala okubuuka ku mpewo gubituukirize.

Abantu abali bwe batyo bawulira nga banyigirizibwa omugugu okwagala gwe kubateekako? Bakwatirwa obuggya emikwano egy’ekisiru era egy’akasirise gye balaba? Beejjusa okuba okumpi n’omwagalwa waabwe olw’obuvunaanyizibwa kwe kubaleetera?

Tebeenyumiririza mu buvunaanyizibwa obwo bwennyini? Era, n’essanyu eggonvu era ery’okujaguza, tebasaasira abo abaavu abali ewala abatayaŋŋanga kusembera kumpi bwe batyo? Buli kye bazuula ekipya ku birowoozo bya bannaabwe si kya ssanyu? Era waliwo ekkubo lyonna erizibu okwagala kwabwe kwe kubawaliriza okutambulirako? Ayi! Emyoyo emyagalwa, bwe muba nga kino mwakimanyaako, ne bwe kiba okumala essaawa ntono; bwe muba nga mwali mwagalako omuntu okutuuka n’okufuna essanyu mu kwefiiriza ku lulwe; bwe muba nga mwali mwegombyeko okuwaayo okwagala kwammwe eri omulala ng’ekitiibwa ekiwoomu, kale, olw’okwagala kwonna okwa Mukama wammwe ow’omu ggulu, mbeegayirira mukole bwe mutyo eri Katonda!

Akwagala n’okwagala okusinga okw’omukwano obwa bulijjo. Ng’omugole omusajja bw’asanyukira omugole we, bw’atyo naye bw’akusanyukira. Okwewaayo okujjuvu kwokka kwe kunaamumatiza. Akuwadde byonna, era akusaba byonna mu kudda. Okwekumirako n’akatono kujja kumunakuwaza okutuuka ku mutima. Teyeesaasira yekka, kale ggwe oyinza otya okwesaasira? Ku lulwo yawaayo byonna bye yalina. Ku lulwe, naawe oteekwa okukola bwe kityo. Ayi, beera mugabi mu kwewaayo kwo! Okwewaayo kwe okutaliiko kigero gy’oli, kuddiremu n’okwewaayo okutaliiko kigero gy’ali. Sanyuka era yanguwa okwesuula butereevu mu mikono gye emyagalwa, n’okumukwasa enkoba z’obufuzi. Buli ky’oli, akibe nakyo kyonna. Leka emirembe gyonna buli kintu ekyawukana ku ye. Ndeseeyo eddembe lyange ery’okwerondera. Nsanyukira okwegatta kwaffe. Kufuula okwewaayo kwange si kya kusoboka kyokka, wabula kya tteeka.

Tewegombangako kwagala muntu ali ewala? Tewali kumpi kumala okusemberera okusingawo. Towulirangako kwegomba okwaka ng’omuliro okumwewaayo? Naye nga tolina muntu gw’oyinza kuwa kwagala okwo. Engalo zo tezibaddeko bibya bya alabasita eby’omuwendo ennyo ebirimu amafuta ag’akaloosa? Tobangako kumpi kimala na mutima gwonna okugafukako. Bw’owulira eddoboozi eddungi erya Mukama wo, akuyita okujja mu kifo eky’okumpi naye. Kyetaagisa okwawukana ku birala byonna. Kijja kufuula okwewaayo kwo si kya kusoboka kyokka, wabula kya tteeka. Onoowugulibwa oba onoolonzalonza?

Onoolowooza nti kizibu nti akubikkulira by’alowooza okusinga bw’abibikkulira abalala? Tajja kukuleka kusanyukira kintu kyonna ekikwawula ku ye. Oyagala okugenda gy’atasobola kugenda naawe, oba okugoberera ebintu by’atasobola kugabanako naawe?

Nedda! Nedda, emirundi lukumi, nedda! Ojja kubuuka okusisinkana by’ayagala eby’ekisa n’essanyu ery’okwegomba. Ne by’asinga okwagala obutono bijja kufuuka gy’oli etteeka erikusiba, ery’okumenya kwalyo kwandimenye omutima gwo ddala. Ojja kusanyukira okufunda kw’ekkubo ly’akuteerawo. Ojja kusaasira n’ennaku etaliiko kkomo abo abaavu abali ewala abaafiirwa essanyu lino. Obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okwagala bujja kuba kitiibwa kyako ekisinga obuwoomi. Eddembe lyo ery’okuwaayo byonna eri Mukama wo lijja kukuwulirisa ng’asitulibwa n’ayingizibwa mu nsi ey’ekitiibwa ekitayogerekeka. Essanyu erituukiridde lijja kuva mu buwulize obutuukiridde. Olwo ojja kumanyaako katono Yesu kye yategeeza bwe yagamba nti, “Nsanyukira okukola ky’oyagala, Ayi Katonda wange, kubanga amateeka go gali mu mutima gwange.” (Zabbuli 40:8) Era olowooza nti essanyu eriri mu kino lijja kuba ku ludda lwo lwokka? Mukama talina ssanyu mu abo abeewaddeyo gy’ali bwe batyo, era abaagala okumugondera? Ayi, mikwano gyange, tetusaanira kwogera ku kino. Naye Ebyawandiikibwa bitulaga katono ku ssanyu, okumatira n’okujaguza Mukama waffe kw’alina mu ffe. Bitwala omwoyo nga bigusanyusa nnyo n’obubonero bwabyo obwewuunyisa obw’omukisa. Nti ffe tumwetaaga, kyangu okutegeera; naye nti ye atwetaaga, kirabika ng’ekitategeerekeka. Kya butonde okumwegomba. Naye nti ye atwegomba kizibu okukikkiriza. Kyokka, emirundi n’emirundi akyogera, era kiki kye tuyinza okukola okuggyako okumukkiriza?

Yatonda emitima gyaffe nga gisobola okuwulira okwagala kuno okunene. Yeewaddeyo yennyini okuba kye kwolekera. Kwa muwendo gwa nnyo nnyini gy’ali. Agamba nti, “Buli alina ebiragiro byange n’abigonderanga, oyo y’anjagala.

Era anjagala, ne Kitange anaamwagalanga. Era nange nnaamwagalanga, era nnaamulabikiranga” (Yokaana 14:21). Akonkona ku buli mutima, ng’anoonya okuba okwagala kwagwo okusinga byonna. “Onzikiriza?” bw’agamba omukkiriza, “Okuba omwagalwa wo, onoongoberera mu kubonaabona ne mu kwesulira? Onoogumiikiriza obuzibu ku lwange? Tosaba mpeera yonna okuggyako okumwenya kwange n’okutendereza kwange.

Onoowaayo ggwe kennyini n’okwewaayo okutaliiko kwekumira mu by’ayagala? Onoompa obuyinza bwonna ku ggwe ne ku byonna by’oli? Onoomatira okunsanyusa nze nzekka? Nnyinza okukola nga bwe njagala munda mu ggwe mu bintu byonna? Onooyingira mu kwegatta nange okw’okumpi ennyo bwe kutyo, okufuula okwawukana ku nsi okw’etteeka? Onoonzikiriza ng’omu yekka Mukama wo, n’olekayo abalala bonna, ne weegatta nange nzekka?” Mu ngeri lukumi, ateeka okusaba kuno okw’okuba omu naye mu maaso ga buli mukkiriza. Naye si bonna nti bamuddamu nti “Weewaawo.” Okwagala okulala n’ebintu ebirala bye baagala bibalabikira nga bya muwendo nnyo okubisuula.

Olw’ekyo tebafiirwa Ggulu. Naye bafiirwa essanyu eritayogerekeka.

Naye ggwe toli omu ku bo. Okuva ku lubereberye omwoyo gwo gukaabidde n’okwegomba n’essanyu eri byonna by’akuwa nti, “Weewaawo, Mukama; weewaawo!” Oli mwetegefu nnyo okumufukira eby’obugagga byo byonna ebisinga obulungi eby’okwagala n’okwewaayo. Obunyiikivu bwo mu kwewaayo buyinza okutabula Abakristaayo abamu abeegendereza ennyo.

Okwagala kwo kufuula okwawukana ku nsi okw’etteeka, okwagala okwa wansi kwe kutayinza na kulowooza.

Ebyo by’owaayo n’empeereza bisoboka gy’oli era biwoomerera. Tebyandisobodde kuva mu mutima ogutewaddeyo bw’atyo.

Obulamu bw’oyingiddemu bukuwa eddembe okufuka byonna by’oli awatali kwekumira ku mwagalwa wo. Empeereza, emyoyo egiri ewala gye gitamanyiiko kintu, kati gifuuka kitiibwa kyo ekisinga obuwoomi.

Mukama wo, olw’okwegatta kwo naye, akusaba bingi nnyo okusinga by’abasaba.

Ekikkirizibwa gye bali, okwagala kukufuulidde ekitakkirizibwa. Ggwe y’ayinza okutegeeza ebyama bye, era ggwe gw’asuubira okuddamu amangu buli kye kusaba okwagala kwe. Ayi, kya kitalo! Kitiibwa kya kitalo, ekitayogerekeka, ky’oyingiddemu! Tekirina nnyo kye kitegeeza abantu bwe banaakukyawanga. Bayinza okukwewala, okukuvuma, n’okusiiga erinnya lyo enziro ku lulwe! “Musanyukanga ku lunaku olwo ne mujaguza, kubanga empeera yammwe nnene mu ggulu. Bwe mugabana ku kubonaabona kwe, muligabana ne ku kitiibwa kye.” Mu ggwe alaba ku ebyo ebiva mu kubonaabona kw’obulamu bwe, n’omutima gwe ne gutereera. Okwagala kwo n’okwewaayo kwo ye mpeera ye ey’omuwendo olw’ebyo byonna by’akukoledde.

Kimuwoomera nnyo okusinga bwe kiyinza okwogerwa. Kale totya kwerekereza mu kwewaayo eri Mukama wo n’omutima gwonna, okutagumiikiriza kwekumira n’akatono. Abalala bayinza obutasiima, naye ye ajja kusiima, era ekyo kimala. Togera buwulize bwo wadde empeereza yo. Omutima gwo n’omukono gwo bibe nga biri ddembe okumuweereza, nga omutima gwe n’omukono gwe bwe byali eddembe okukuweereza. Mukkirize abe na buli ky’oli: omubiri, emmeeme, n’omwoyo, ebiseera, ebitone, eddoboozi, buli kintu. Bikkula obulamu bwo bwonna mu maaso ge alyoke abufuge. Buli lunaku mugambe nti, “Mukama, nnaategeka ntya olunaku luno ndyoke nkusanyuse? Nnaagenda wa? Nnaakola ki? Nnaakyalira ani? Nnaayogera ki?” Wa amagezi go mu buyinza bwe ogambe nti, “Mukama, ndaga engeri y’okulowoozaamu ndyoke nkusanyuse?” Muwe by’osoma, by’ogoberera, n’emikwano gyo. Olwo ogambe nti, “Mukama, mpa okutegeera okusalira ebintu bino omusango n’amagezi go.” Waleme kubaawo lunaku wadde essaawa nga tokola by’ayagala n’okutegeera, era nga tomugoberera n’omutima gwonna.

Okumuweereza kujja kwambaza obulamu bwo ekitangaala ekyetoolodde. Kujja kwakiza n’obulamu obusinga okuba obw’ekisiru ekitangaala eky’omu ggulu.

Wali onakuwaliddeko nti obuwoomi bw’obuvubuka bubula mangu nnyo mu bizibu eby’amaanyi eby’ensi? Leeta Katonda mu bulamu bwo ne mu bitundu byabwo byonna. Essanyu erisingawo lijja kujjuza omwoyo gwo okusinga ennaku ezisinga okumasamasa ez’obuvubuka bwe zaali ziyinza okumanya. Tewali kijja kuddamu kulabika nga kizibu oba ekikakanyavu. Obulamu obusinga okuba obwa wansi bujja kugulumizibwa olw’ekyo. Bwe nnali ntunuulira omukazi omwavu ng’ayoza engoye mu kibya kye, nnalowooza ku bintu ebimalamu amaanyi eby’obulamu bwe. Nneebuuza lwaki obulamu obwo buteekwa okubaawo. Awo, n’essanyu eryankwata ennyo, ne nzijukira ekitiibwa ekiyinza okubuweebwa. Ne neegamba nti, n’obulamu buno, nga bubeerwamu mu Kristo era wamu ne Kristo, nga bumugoberera buli gy’akulembera, bwandibadde bwa kitiibwa.

Buli ssaawa yaabwo yandijjudde obunyiikivu.

Kinzizaamu amaanyi okumanya nti emikisa gya Katonda egisinga obunene giri n’obulamu obusinga obwavu era obusinga obuwombeefu. “Kubanga,” Mukama waffe yennyini bw’agamba, “buli muntu,” k’abe mugagga oba mwavu, mukadde oba muto, muddu oba wa ddembe.

Buli muntu akola Katonda by’asiima ye muganda wange, ye mwannyinaze era ye mmange.

Yimirira akaseera ku bigambo bino ebyangu naye ebyewuunyisa. Muganda we, mwannyina we, ne nnyina we! Kiki kye tutandiwaddeyo okuba omu ku bano! Ayi, ka nkwegayirire, Omukristaayo omwagalwa. Jjangu olegeeko olabe nga Mukama bw’ali omulungi. Alina ebintu eby’ekitalo by’aterekedde abo “abagondera ebiragiro bye, era ne bakola ebimusanyusa.” “Bw’onoogonderanga Mukama Katonda wo n’okwatanga amateeka ge gonna ge nkuwa leero, Mukama Katonda wo alikugulumiza n’akuteeka waggulu w’amawanga gonna ag’oku nsi. Emikisa gino gyonna onoogifunanga n’obeeranga nagyo, bw’onoowuliranga eddoboozi lya Mukama Katonda wo n’omugonderanga.”

“Onooweebwanga omukisa bw’onoobeeranga mu kibuga ne bw’onoobeeranga mu kyalo. Abaana ab’omu nda yo banaaweebwanga omukisa, n’ebisimbe eby’omu ttaka lyo, n’ebisibo byo ebinaazaalibwanga, Ennyana z’ente ez’amagana go, n’obwana bw’endiga ez’ebisibo byo. Ekibbo kyo mw’onookuŋŋaanyizanga, n’olutiba lwo mw’onoogoyeranga nabyo binaabanga n’omukisa. Onoobanga n’omukisa ng’oyingira era onoobanga n’omukisa ng’ofuluma. Mukama anaakuwanga okuwangula abalabe bo abanaakulumbanga. Banajjiranga mu kkubo limu okukulumba, naye ne basaasaanira mu makubo musanvu mu maaso go nga bawanguddwa.” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 28:3-7) “Mukama anaawanga amawanika go omukisa, ne buli ky’onookwatangako engalo zo okukikola anaakiwanga omukisa. Mukama Katonda wo anaakuwanga omukisa ng’oli mu nsi gy’akuwa. Mukama agenda kukufuula eggwanga lye ettukuvu nga bwe yakusuubiza n’ekirayiro, bw’onookwatanga amateeka ga Mukama Katonda wo n’otambuliranga mu makubo ge.” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 28:8-9) “Kale nno abantu ab’omu mawanga gonna ag’ensi balitegeera nga bw’oyitibwa erinnya lya Mukama era banaakutyanga. Mukama anaakugaggawazanga nnyo mu byonna: mu zadde ery’enda yo, ne mu baana ab’ebisibo byo by’onoolundanga, ne mu bibala eby’omu ttaka lyo, ng’oli mu nsi Mukama gye yalayirira bajjajjaabo okugikuwa. Mukama alikuggulirawo eggwanika lye ery’obugagga bwe ery’eggulu, n’atonnyesanga enkuba mu ttaka lyo, mu biseera byayo, ne buli kintu kyonna ky’onookolanga anaakiwanga omukisa. Onoowolanga amawanga mangi, kyokka ggwe toogeewolengako n’akatono. Mukama anaakufuulanga mutwe so si mukira. Bw’onoogonderanga ebiragiro bya Mukama Katonda wo bye nkutegeeza leero, n’obigobereranga n’obwegendereza, onoobanga ku ntikko waggulu, so tookooberenga.” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 28:10-13) Eri Abayisirayiri, gyali gya kungulu era gya kaseera buseera. Eri ffe, gya munda era gya mwoyo. Era, gya kitiibwa nnyo okusingawo. Ka okwagala kwaffe okwewaddeyo kubuuke okugyaniriza mu bujjuvu bwagyo bwonna!

Kyandaga ekkubo ery’okufuna essanyu erisoboka, naye lye sirootangako n’akatono. Oluvannyuma, wadde nga nnali wa bujeemu, ekigambo ekyo kyagenda kinkomako buli kiseera. Kyansuubiza ekiwummulo n’ekkubo ery’okukula. Kyakkakkanya era ne kimatiza okwegomba kwange. Nteekwa okugamba nti ekiwummulo ekyo nkizudde, si ng’ekirooto, wabula ng’ekintu ekiriwo ddala. Nkirabye mu Mukama Yesu, Mukama waffe. Tusobola okumwewaayo ne twetikka ekikoligo kye, ne tufuna ekiwummulo ekituukiridde. Ggwe, omwoyo omwagalwa atatya okusalawo, tomanyi ssanyu ly’ofiirwa. Mukama yeeyolese gy’oli. Akuyita okwewaayo gy’ali ddala ddala. Naye ggwe weekyusa n’olonzalonza. Oli mwetegefu okwewaayo ekitundu, era olowooza nti ddala kituufu era kigwanidde okukikola. Naye olabika ng’alowooza nti okwewaayo kwonna, awatali kwekumirako kantu, kusukkiridde okusabibwa. Kikutiisa. Olowooza nti kwetaagisa bingi nnyo, era mulimu munene nnyo. Oyagala okugonda ku kigero ekipimiddwa; naye ekirowoozo eky’okugonda ddala ddala kikuggwaamu amaanyi. Olaba ne emyoyo emirala. Gitambulira mu kkubo eggazi okusinga eryo eriteekeddwawo ggwe, nga emitima gyagyo tegibasalira musango. Weebuuza nti, lwaki kiri bwe kityo? Kikulabikira ng’ekyewuunyisa, era oboolyawo nga kizibu, nti oteekwa okukola ebyo bo bye bateetaaga kukola. Era oteekwa okulekayo ebyo bo bye balina eddembe okukola. Ayi! Omukristaayo omwagalwa, enjawulo eno yennyini wakati wammwe kye kitiibwa kyo, wadde nga tonnakimanya. Mukama wo agamba nti, “Buli alina ebiragiro byange n’abigonderanga, oyo y’anjagala; era anjagala, ne Kitange anaamwagalanga. Era nange nnaamwagalanga, era nnaamulabikiranga.” (Yokaana 14:21) Ggwe olina ebiragiro bye; abo b’okwatirwa obuggya tebabirina. Omanyi Mukama wo by’ayagala mu bintu bingi, bo mwe bakyatambulira mu kizikiza. Ekyo si kitiibwa? Kya nnaku nti omwoyo gwo guli kumpi nnyo ne Mukama wo? Asobola okukubuulira ebintu abo abali ewala bye batamanyi. Tolaba nti kino kitegeeza omukwano ogw’okumpi era omugonvu bwe gutyo? Enkolagana nnyingi mu bulamu zeetaagisa bwetaavu okwewaayo okutono okuva ku njuyi zombi. Tuyinza okuba n’emikwano eminene. Naye ebiseera ebisinga obungi eby’obulamu bwaffe tubimala nga buli omu ali ku bibye, nga tugoberera ebintu eby’enjawulo. Bwe tuba wamu, tuyinza okusanyukira okubeera awamu. Tuyinza okuzuula ebintu bingi bye tulinamu ekitundu ffembi. Naye okwawukana tekutunakuwaza. Emikwano emirala egy’okumpi okusingawo tegitutaataaganya. Tetulina kwagala kumala kutuwa ddembe, wadde okwegomba, okugabana ebyama byaffe eby’omunda ennyo. Tuwulira nti okwekuuma ku kigero n’okubeera n’ebbanga wakati waffe kye kituufu. Naye waliwo enkolagana endala mu bulamu ng’ebyo byonna bikyuka. Omukwano gufuuka okwagala. Emitima ebiri gyewaayo eri gyombi, ne giba nga tegikyali ebiri wabula gumu. Emyoyo gyegatta, era okwegatta okwo kufuula buli kintu eky’omu omu okuba eky’omulala. Ebyo bye baagobereranga nga buli omu ku lulwe n’amakubo ag’enjawulo mu bulamu tebikyasoboka. Ebintu ebyali bikkirizibwa edda kati tebikyakkirizibwa. Kiri bwe kityo olw’obunywevu bw’omukwano ogubagatta. Okwekuuma n’ebbanga ebisaanira obwemikwano obwa bulijjo bifuuka eby’okuzikiriza mu kwagala. Okwagala kuwaayo byonna, era kuteekwa okuddizibwa byonna. Omu by’ayagala bisiba munne. Buli mutima gwegomba okumanya munne by’ayagala mu kyama. Gwagala okubuuka ku mpewo gubituukirize. Abantu abali bwe batyo bawulira nga banyigirizibwa omugugu okwagala gwe kubateekako? Bakwatirwa obuggya emikwano egy’ekisiru era egy’akasirise gye balaba? Beejjusa okuba okumpi n’omwagalwa waabwe olw’obuvunaanyizibwa kwe kubaleetera? Tebeenyumiririza mu buvunaanyizibwa obwo bwennyini? Era, n’essanyu eggonvu era ery’okujaguza, tebasaasira abo abaavu abali ewala abatayaŋŋanga kusembera kumpi bwe batyo? Buli kye bazuula ekipya ku birowoozo bya bannaabwe si kya ssanyu? Era waliwo ekkubo lyonna erizibu okwagala kwabwe kwe kubawaliriza okutambulirako? Ayi! Emyoyo emyagalwa, bwe muba nga kino mwakimanyaako, ne bwe kiba okumala essaawa ntono; bwe muba nga mwali mwagalako omuntu okutuuka n’okufuna essanyu mu kwefiiriza ku lulwe; bwe muba nga mwali mwegombyeko okuwaayo okwagala kwammwe eri omulala ng’ekitiibwa ekiwoomu, kale, olw’okwagala kwonna okwa Mukama wammwe ow’omu ggulu, mbeegayirira mukole bwe mutyo eri Katonda! Akwagala n’okwagala okusinga okw’omukwano obwa bulijjo. Ng’omugole omusajja bw’asanyukira omugole we, bw’atyo naye bw’akusanyukira. Okwewaayo okujjuvu kwokka kwe kunaamumatiza. Akuwadde byonna, era akusaba byonna mu kudda. Okwekumirako n’akatono kujja kumunakuwaza okutuuka ku mutima. Teyeesaasira yekka, kale ggwe oyinza otya okwesaasira? Ku lulwo yawaayo byonna bye yalina. Ku lulwe, naawe oteekwa okukola bwe kityo. Ayi, beera mugabi mu kwewaayo kwo! Okwewaayo kwe okutaliiko kigero gy’oli, kuddiremu n’okwewaayo okutaliiko kigero gy’ali. Sanyuka era yanguwa okwesuula butereevu mu mikono gye emyagalwa, n’okumukwasa enkoba z’obufuzi. Buli ky’oli, akibe nakyo kyonna. Leka emirembe gyonna buli kintu ekyawukana ku ye. Ndeseeyo eddembe lyange ery’okwerondera. Nsanyukira okwegatta kwaffe. Kufuula okwewaayo kwange si kya kusoboka kyokka, wabula kya tteeka. Tewegombangako kwagala muntu ali ewala? Tewali kumpi kumala okusemberera okusingawo. Towulirangako kwegomba okwaka ng’omuliro okumwewaayo? Naye nga tolina muntu gw’oyinza kuwa kwagala okwo. Engalo zo tezibaddeko bibya bya alabasita eby’omuwendo ennyo ebirimu amafuta ag’akaloosa? Tobangako kumpi kimala na mutima gwonna okugafukako. Bw’owulira eddoboozi eddungi erya Mukama wo, akuyita okujja mu kifo eky’okumpi naye. Kyetaagisa okwawukana ku birala byonna. Kijja kufuula okwewaayo kwo si kya kusoboka kyokka, wabula kya tteeka. Oyagala okugenda gy’atasobola kugenda naawe, oba okugoberera ebintu by’atasobola kugabanako naawe? Nedda! Nedda, emirundi lukumi, nedda! Nti ffe tumwetaaga, kyangu okutegeera; naye nti ye atwetaaga, kirabika ng’ekitategeerekeka. Kya butonde okumwegomba. Naye nti ye atwegomba kizibu okukikkiriza.
