Obwakabaka bwe si bwa mu nsi muno. Bwakabaka bwa mwoyo. Obuyinza bwabwo buli ku mmeeme, so si ku mibiri.

Kale, busobola okuteekebwawo nga emmeeme emaze okuwangulwa kyokka.

Bwe tulaba bwe tutyo, ebirangiriro n’obunnabbi bwonna ebyo bijjula okwagala n’omukisa. Byogera nti Katonda aliwangula abalabe be era alibafuga mu butuukirivu ne mu buyinza! Era nga liwulikika nga lijjudde essuubi ery’ekitiibwa eddoboozi ly’ekibiina ekinene Yokaana kye yawulira nga kigamba nti, “Aleruuya, kubanga Mukama Katonda waffe Ayinzabyonna y’afuga.” Okukakasa bino byonna tulina ebitundu bibiri eby’Ebyawandiikibwa ebinnyonnyola obwakabaka buno, mu (Abaruumi 14:17) “Kubanga obwakabaka bwa Katonda si kulya na kunywa, wabula butuukirivu na mirembe, na ssanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.” ne mu (1 Abakkolinso 4:20): “Kubanga obwakabaka bwa Katonda tebuli mu kwogera bwogezi, wabula mu maanyi.”

Si bintu bya kungulu, wabula bya munda. Si omuntu by’alya oba by’anywa. Si w’abeera. Si ggwanga lye wadde empisa z’eggwanga lye. Wadde ebirowoozo bye oba ebigambo bye. Naye bubonero ki obw’omunda obw’obutonde bwe?

Maanyi ki ag’omwoyo gwe? Kubanga ebyo byokka bye bikola obwakabaka buno obwa Katonda.

Si kye nkola, wabula kye ndi, kye kirisalawo oba ndi mu bwo oba nedda. Obwakabaka buno busobola okuteekebwawo nga tulina era nga tuli mu kulaba mu bulamu bwaffe obutuukirivu obw’omunda, emirembe, essanyu, n’amaanyi. Kale, tewali kufuga kwa bweru kuyinza kuleeta bibala ng’ebyo. Omulimu ogw’omunda ogw’Omwoyo wa Katonda awangula byonna gwe gwokka oguyinza.

Nnyize nnyo okuva mu lugero lwa Odysseus n’olugendo lwe, bwe yali ng’ayita ku bizinga by’abasireeni (sirens). Abasireeni bano baali basobola okusikiriza buli eyawuliranga ennyimba zaabwe. Babasendasendanga ne babbuukira mu nnyanja. Okwewala akabi kano, Odysseus yajjuza amatu g’abavuzi b’eryato lye envumbo. Yakola kino baleme kuwulira nnyimba ezitta. Oluvannyuma yeesiba ku mulongooti gw’eryato n’emiguwa egy’amafundo. Ne bayita ku kizinga nga tebalina kabi. Naye Orpheus bwe yali ateekwa okuyita ku kizinga kye kimu, yafuna obuwanguzi obusingako. Yayimba ennyimba ennungi okusinga ez’abasireeni, n’asanyusa abavuzi be n’ennyimba ezisikiriza okusingawo. Kale ne bayita ku basikiriza abo ab’akabi, si mu mirembe kyokka naye nga babanyooma. Envumbo n’emiguwa egy’amafundo byakuuma Odysseus n’abavuzi be obutabbuuka mu nnyanja kufiirayo. Naye essanyu ery’omunda lyasobozesa Orpheus n’abavuzi be okuwangula okukemebwa kwennyini. Era bwe kityo bwe kiri n’obwakabaka bwe twogerako. Tebwetaaga tteeka lya bweru kubusiba, wabula bufuga olw’obuyinza obw’obulamu bwabwo obw’omunda.

Kye kiva kyogerwa ku abo abaabuyingiramu nti, “awali ebyo tewali tteeka libiwakanya.” Kubanga bwakabaka bwa bakabaka. Oluyimba lwe tuliyimba lumu, nedda, lwe tusaanidde okuba nga tuyimba kaakano wano mu bulamu buno, lukirangirira: “era n’okuva eri Yesu Kristo omujulirwa omwesigwa. Oyo ye yasooka okuzuukira mu bafu, era y’afuga bakabaka ab’omu nsi; oyo yatwagala, era ye yatuggya mu bibi byaffe n’omusaayi gwe, n’atufuula obwakabaka bw’obwakabona bwa Katonda, Kitaawe. Ekitiibwa n’obuyinza bibeerenga eri oyo emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.” (Okubikkulirwa 1:5-6.)

Ffe abaayingira mu bwakabaka buno, oba, okusinga, ffe obwakabaka buno mwe bwateekebwawo, tutuula ku ntebe wamu ne Kabaka waffe ne tugabana ku kufuga kwe. Ensi yali ke katebe ke ak’ebigere, era efuuka ke katebe kaffe ak’ebigere naffe. Yafuga waggulu w’ebintu ebiyitawo n’ebyo ebitegeerwa obusimu bw’omubiri. Obulamu obwabeerwangamu ku mutendera ogw’awaggulu era ogusingako bwe bwamuwa obuyinza obwo.

Naffe tuyinza bwe tutyo. Ffenna tumanyi enjogera nti omuntu “ayimuka n’asukka embeera ze.” Kitegeeza nti mu muntu oyo mulimu amaanyi agakwekeddwa. Gafuga embeera ze mu kifo ky’okufugibwa zo. Kabaka waffe yasukka waggulu w’embeera ze. Ffe abafuga awamu naye, tuyinza okukola kye kimu.

Naye, nga bwe yali nga si kabaka mu ndabika ey’okungulu, wabula mu maanyi ag’omunda gokka, naffe bwe tutyo bwe tuliba. Yafuga, si lwa kuba nti yalina obugagga bwonna obw’ensi. Wabula kubanga teyalina na kimu, era nga asobola okubeera nga tabulina.

Era bwe kityo bwe kuliba okufuga kwaffe. Abantu bonna tebalituvunnamira, era n’ebintu byonna tebirigondera kwagala kwaffe.

Abantu bonna nga batuziyiza, n’ebintu byonna nga bitulwanyisa, tulibiyitamu nga tutambula mu buwanguzi bw’emmeeme obw’obwakabaka.

Tulifiirwa ebintu byonna, era olw’okufiirwa okwo tuliteebwa emirembe gyonna okuva mu buyinza bwabyo obw’okutusiba. Tulyekweka mu Kabaka by’ayagala, ekigo ekitayinza kumenyebwa. Eyo, tulifugira mu Bwakabaka obutaggwaawo.

Bino byonna bikontana n’endowooza y’omuntu ku bwakabaka. Omutima gw’omuntu gusobola okutegeera endowooza emu yokka. Y’eno: nti embeera ez’ebweru ziteekwa okugondera emmeeme etudde ku ntebe awamu ne Kristo. Mikwano giteekwa okusiima, abalabe bateekwa okusirisibwa, n’ebiziyiza biteekwa okuwangulwa. Ensonga ziteekwa okugenda obulungi, oba si ekyo tewali kufuga. Singa omuntu ye yali aluŋŋamya ensonga za Danyeri, oba ez’Abaebbulaniya abasatu mu kikoomi ky’omuliro, yandigambye nti okuwangula, bateekwa okukyusa ebirowoozo bya bakabaka. Danyeri teyandisuuliddwa mu mpuku y’empologoma, n’abaana b’Abaebbulaniya bandikuumiddwa obutayingira mu kikoomi.

Naye ekkubo lya Katonda lyali lya kitiibwa nnyo okusingawo. Yaleka Danyeri okusuulibwa mu mpologoma. Yayagala afuge ng’awangula wakati mu zo. Yaleka Saddulaaki, ne Mesaki ne Abeduneego okusuulibwa mu kikoomi ekyaka omuliro. Yayagala batambule mu kyo, so n’olusu lw’omuliro nga terubawunyako. Tatugamba kutambulira mu makubo agataliimu bisota binene na nswera. Wabula tulitambula wakati mu byo, era “tulibirinnyirira n’ebigere byaffe.”

Era nga obwakabaka buno bwa kitiibwa nnyo okusinga okufuga kwonna okw’okungulu oba okulagira kwonna! Okubeera kabaka munda, naye omuddu ebweru, buwanguzi bunene. Kye kisingayo emitima gyaffe kye giyinza okulowooza. Okubeera mu bwetaavu, mu nnaku, nga obonyaabonyezebwa. Okukubibwa amayinja, okusalibwamu, n’okuttibwa n’ekitala. Okutambulatambula ng’oyambadde amaliba g’endiga n’ag’embuzi, ne mu malungu, mu nsozi, mu mpuku ne mu bunnya. Naye, mu byonna ebyo, okubeera bakabaka mu bwakabaka obw’obutuukirivu, emirembe, n’essanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Buno bwakabaka Katonda yekka bw’ayinza okugaba, era emmeeme ezifaanana Katonda zokka ze ziyinza okubufuna.

Twalaba oba twawulira ku bakabaka abatonotono ng’abo. Emitima gyonna gikkirizza obuyinza bwabwe obwakolanga nga bo tebakimanyi. Nnasoma ku omu ku bamonaaki b’ennyumba y’abamonaaki ey’e St. Cyr. Okwewaayo kwabwe eri Katonda kwaleetera ennyumba z’abamonaaki n’abakulu baazo okubakyawa. Baagobwa mu kibiina kyabwe ng’ababi. Omu yasindikibwa ng’omusibe mu nnyumba y’abamonaaki abalabe be mwe baabeeranga. Eyo, yayisibwa mu ngeri enkambwe era ey’okumuswaza. Wadde yali ava mu lulyo olw’ekitiibwa era nga yali mukulembeze edda, yawalirizibwa okukola emirimu egya wansi ennyo. Yawalirizibwa okwetikka omugugu omuzito ku mugongo, n’alagirwa okusabiriza ng’ayambadde ku kifuba akapande akagamba nti ye mubi asinga ababi bonna. Naye, mu byonna ebyo, omwoyo gw’omutukuvu oyo gwawangula. Tewali kyamutabulira mirembe gye wadde okunyiwaza obukkakkamu bwe obufaanana obwa Kristo.

Eri abaamuyigganyanga, teyalina kirala okuggyako ebigambo eby’ekisa n’akamwenyumwenyu ak’okwagala. Ku nkomerero, olw’amaanyi amangi ag’obwakabaka bwa Katonda, yawangula emitima gyonna. Yafuuka mukwano gwabwe gwe beesiga era omuwi w’amagezi, era omufuzi omwagalwa ow’abo abaali abalabe be edda, abaasanyukanga okumuyigganya. “Balina omukisa abeetoowaze, kubanga abo balisikira ensi.” (Matayo 5:5). Olw’obuwombeefu bwe, yawangula n’afuuka kabaka. Lumu, omumenyi w’amateeka ow’akabi yaleetebwa mu nnyumba y’abamonaaki okusibibwa. Yali mukambwe nnyo nga tewali njegere zimala kumusiba, era tewali maanyi gaali gayinza kumufuga. Ku nkomerero, yatwalibwa mu kisenge ky’ow’oluganda omu ow’e St. Cyr. Ne basibirwa wamu. Wadde abamonaaki abo abatakwatibwako nnyo baakitegeera nti obuwombeefu obwo obwa Katonda bwalina amaanyi okuwangula agasinga byonna bye baali bamanyi. Omutukuvu yaaniriza omusajja oyo omukambwe ng’owooluganda omwagalwa n’amumwenyeza n’ekisa eky’omu ggulu.

Naye omumenyi w’amateeka n’amusasula n’ebivume n’effujjo. Yamenya ebintu by’omumonaaki n’ayonoona ekitanda kye, n’amusamba, n’amukuba, n’amusika enviiri, era n’amuwandira amalusu. Yeekooya ng’amukolako effujjo. Mu byonna ebyo, omumonaaki teyaziyiza kintu na kimu.

Yayogera ebigambo by’okwagala byokka. Ku nkomerero, omumenyi w’amateeka, ng’akooye olw’obusungu, n’ayimirira okussa omukka. Awo omusajja eyali akubiddwa era n’avumibwa n’amwenyeza oyo eyamuyigganya n’okwagala okungi n’okusaasira. Kyali ng’ayagala okumubudaabuda mu nnaku ye. Kino kyasukka omumenyi w’amateeka kye yali ayinza okugumira. Obukyayi, okwesasuza, n’obusungu yali ayinza okubyanukula mu ngeri y’emu. Naye teyalina byakulwanyisa ku kwagala n’obuwombeefu ng’obwo. Omutima gwe gwawangulwa. Yagwa ku bigere by’omutukuvu n’abinaaza n’amaziga ge, ng’amwegayirira amusonyiwe olw’obukambwe bwe, n’alayira okumuweereza n’obwesigwa obulamu bwe bwonna.

Era okuva mu kaseera ako, emitawaana gyonna n’omumenyi w’amateeka oyo gyaggwaawo. Yagobereranga omutukuvu buli w’agenda ng’embwa eyagala era enyiikivu, nga yeesunga okukola oba okubeera buli kye yandyagadde. Ekiseera kye eky’okusibibwa bwe kyaggwaako, enzigi ne ziggulwawo. Naye teyasobola kusendebwasendebwa kugenda, kubanga teyagumira kuleka musajja eyamulokola olw’okwagala. Obwakabaka mu bwakabaka buno obw’omu ggulu bwe bufaanana bwe butyo. Buli mmeeme esobola okukyekwatiramu yokka, awatali kwetaaga kunnyonnyola kwange.

Mu (Matayo 5:6-7), tulina Kabaka w’obwakabaka buno ng’annyonnyola engeri z’obwakabaka bwe era ng’awa amateeka eri abantu be. “Balina omukisa abalumwa enjala olw’obutuukirivu kubanga abo balikkusibwa. Balina omukisa ab’ekisa, kubanga abo balikwatirwa ekisa.” Si abagagga, oba abakulu, oba ab’amagezi, oba abayivu. Wabula abaavu mu mwoyo, abeetoowaze, ab’ekisa, abalina omutima omulongoofu, abakungubaga, n’abalumwa enjala n’ennyonta. Era n’abayigganyizibwa, abavumibwa, n’abawaayirizibwa. Bonna abali bwe batyo ba mu bwakabaka buno. Bakabaka bano bakkakkamu, bagonvu, beetoowaze, era bagabi. Bafuga n’amaanyi ago.

Omukristaayo omu yabuuza munne nti, “Nnyinza ntya okuleetera abantu okunzisaamu ekitiibwa?” “Nze nandibaleetedde okukimpa nga nkisaanidde,” bwe yamuddamu. Kino kyali kitegeeza, si nti yandibalagidde nti, “Munzisengamu ekitiibwa!” Wabula nti yandikoze, n’awangaala, n’abeera, mu ngeri nti bonna bandimussizzaamu ekitiibwa. Abantu bayinza okufuna ekitiibwa eky’okungulu nga bakozesa obukambwe. Naye, okufuga emitima gyabwe, bateekwa okugezaako amakubo amalala.

Mukama waffe yannyonnyola endowooza eno eri abo abaali baagala okugabana ku ntebe ye. Yesu kwe kubayita n’abagamba nti, “Mumanyi ng’abakulembeze b’abamawanga babazitoowereza embeera, n’abakulu baabwe babafuza lyanyi. (Matayo 20:25). “Naye tekisaanye kuba bwe kityo mu mmwe. Buli ayagala okubeera omukulu mu mmwe, abeerenga muweereza wa banne. Na buli ayagala okuba omwami mu mmwe aweerezenga banne ng’omuddu waabwe. Mube nga Omwana w’Omuntu atajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi.”

Mu ndowooza y’abantu, omuntu omu yekka y’afuga. Y’oyo asobola okubeera mukama w’abo abamwetoolodde.

Mu ndowooza ya Katonda, emmeeme eweereza y’emmeeme efuga.

Si oyo asaba ebisingawo y’afuna engule eno ey’omunda, wabula oyo alekayo ebisingawo. Bukulembeze ki obuyinza okulowoozebwa obusinga obwa Kristo mu Kubuulira okw’oku Lusozi? “Naye mbagamba nti, Temuwakananga na mubi, naye omuntu bw’akukubanga oluyi ku ttama erya ddyo omukyusizanga n’ettama eryokubiri.” Omuntu bw’ayagalanga okuwoza naawe atwale essaati yo, omulekeranga n’ekkooti yo. N’oyo akuwalirizanga okumwetikkirako omugugu gwe kilomita emu, omutwalirangako n’eyokubiri. (Matayo 5:39) Mazima emmeeme yokka etabagana ne Katonda y’eyinza okulinnya ku ntebe ey’obuyinza ng’eno! Naye eno ye nkomerero yaffe. Twatondebwa lwa kigendererwa kino. Twazaalibwa mu lulyo lwa bakabaka, era tuli basika b’obwakabaka buno obutayogerekeka; “Kale nga bwe tuli abaana, tuli basika ba Katonda, era tulisikira wamu ne Kristo, bwe tubonaabonera awamu naye, tulyoke tuweerwe wamu naye ekitiibwa.” (Abaruumi 8:17) Singa twali tusobola okutegeera kino, ne tulaba mu buli kikolwa eky’okuweereza oba eky’okwewaayo, eddaala erigenda waggulu. Lyandituleetedde eri obwakabaka bwaffe n’entebe yaffe! Kino nkitegeeza mu ngeri ey’ensonga ddala. Ntegeeza nti emirimu gyaffe egya buli lunaku egya wansi n’okwefiiriza kwaffe okutono, bwe bikolebwa obulungi, bijja kubeera amadaala agatuyimusa okutuuka ku ntebe zaffe. Bwe tunaabanga abeesigwa mu “bintu ebitono” eby’obwakabaka bwaffe obw’ensi, tulifuulibwa abafuzi ab’“ebintu ebingi” eby’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu.

Oyo aweereza n’abonaabona ku lwa Kristo alifugira wamu naye. Aliba “omwami” mu bwakabaka bwe obw’okwagala. Bwe tumanya kino, ani yandiruddewo okukyusa n’ettama eddala? Waliwo obwakabaka n’entebe eby’okuwangula.

Yusufu yali kifaananyi kya bino byonna. Mu buddu ne mu kkomera yafuga nga kabaka, mu mazima nga bwe yafuga ng’atudde ku ntebe ya Falaawo oba ng’atambulira mu ggaali lya Falaawo. (Laba Olubereberye 39:6) “Awo Omumisiri n’ateeka byonna mu mikono gya Yusufu. Yusufu n’avunaanyizibwanga byonna okuggyako emmere mukama we gye yalyanga. Kyokka Yusufu yali mulungi nnyo, mubalagavu.”

(Olubereberye 39:22-23.) “Omukuumi w’ekkomera n’ateeka abasibe bonna mu mikono gya Yusufu, era buli ekyakolebwanga nga Yusufu y’akirinako obuvunaanyizibwa. Omukuumi w’ekkomera nga tafaayo ku buli ekyalinga mu mikono gya Yusufu, kubanga Mukama yali naye, era Mukama n’amuwa omukisa mu buli kye yakolanga.” Yafuuka asinga obukulu olw’okubeera asinga obutono, omwami olw’okubeera omuweereza wa bonna.

Omusomi omwagalwa, ofuga bw’otyo, mu bwakabaka obw’engeri eno? Gw’asinga obukulu mu nsi yo entono — awaka, mu kkanisa, oba mu mikwano gyo? Kale beera asinga obutono. Beera muweereza wa buli muntu. Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, obwakabaka bwo si bwakabaka bwa Kristo, era entebe yo togigabanako naye. Okutuuka ku byama n’amaanyi g’obwakabaka buno obw’omunda si kirooto. Si buwanguzi bwa kulowooza bulowooza. Ngeri ya mazima ddala era entuufu ey’okufuga. Ejja kukusitula ofuuke waggulu w’ensi n’ebigyeraliikiriza. Ojja kugiyitamu nga totaataaganyizibwa kutenderezebwa kwayo wadde kunenya kwayo. Ojja kubeera mu kifo eky’emirembe n’obuwanguzi ensi ky’etayinza kukuwa wadde okukuggyako.

“Kubanga obwakabaka bwa Katonda tebuli mu kwogera bwogezi, wabula mu maanyi.” Bwakabaka buno si bigambo wabula kintu kya ddala ekiriwo, era abo abali mu bwo bategeera obwakabaka bwabwe ne babukakasa nga bafuga. Naye oboolyawo oyinza okugamba nti, “Nnyinza ntya okuyingira mu bwakabaka buno, obanga sinnabuyingiramu?” Mukama waffe yennyini akuddemu: Mu kiseera ekyo abayigirizwa ba Yesu ne bajja gy’ali nga bagamba nti, “Ani asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu?” (Matayo 18:1) Yesu n’ayita omwana omuto n’amussa mu makkati gaabwe. N’abagamba nti, “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe mutakyuke kufaanana ng’abaana abato temugenda kuyingira mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Noolwekyo buli eyeetoowaza ng’omwana ono omuto y’aliba asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu.” (Matayo 18:2-3) Bwakabaka bwa mitima egifaanana egy’abaana abato, era egyo gyokka gye giyinza okubuyingiramu. Okubeera “omwana omuto” kitegeeza bubeezi okubeera omwana omuto. Siyinza kukinnyonnyola bulungi okusinga bwe ntyo. Ffenna tumanyi abaana abato.

Tusanyukira obwesimbu bwabwe, okwesiga kwabwe, n’obuteeraliikirira bwabwe. Tusiima obuwulize bwabwe obutabuusabuusa eri abo ababafuga. Okubeera asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka buno obwa Katonda, omuntu ateekwa okubeera n’omutima gw’omwana ogusinga okwesiga, okuba omugonvu, n’okuwulira. Gwe mutima ogutaliimu bukuusa era ogwerabira gwokka.

“Si bonna abampita nti, ‘Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe,’ be baliyingira obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, wabula abo bokka abakola ebyo Kitange ali mu ggulu by’ayagala.” (Matayo 7:21). Wano si kwogera, wabula kukola, okutugasa. Tuteekwa okubeera omwana, oba tetuyinza kutuula ku ntebe y’omwana. Era okubeera omwana kitegeeza okukola Kitaffe by’ayagala, kubanga ekikulu ddala mu bwana obw’amazima gwe mwoyo ogw’obuwulize ogugattiddwa n’omwoyo ogw’okwesiga.

Fuuka omwana omuto. Teeka ku bbali obukulu bwo, okwekuza kwo, n’amagezi go. Lekayo amaanyi go n’okwesigama ku ggwe wennyini. Kkiriza okufa eri obulamu bwo obw’edda. Zaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Ekkubo lyokka ery’okuva mu bulamu obumu okuyingira mu bulala kwe kufa eri obumu n’okuzaalibwa obuggya mu bulala. Kale lwe lugero olw’edda, oluddiddwamu emirundi mingi ennyo era mu ngeri nnyingi ez’enjawulo, olw’okuyita mu kufa okutuuka mu bulamu. Kale, fa olyoke obeere mulamu. Fiirwa obulamu bwo obubwo olyoke ofune obulamu bwa Kristo.

Ensaanyi zisobola okuyingira mu bwakabaka bw’ekiwojjolo nga zifa eri obulamu bwazo obw’ensaanyi kyokka, olwo ne zifuuka ebiwojjolo. Mu ngeri y’emu, tusobola okuyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda nga tufa eri obwakabaka bw’okwerowoozaako kyokka, olwo ne tuzuukira mu bulamu mu Kristo. Leka byonna eby’obuzaaliranwa. Mu byo mwe muli endowooza zo, enteekateeka zo, n’ebirowoozo byo. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, kkiriza enteekateeka za Katonda, amakubo ge, n’ebirowoozo bye. Kino kikole n’obwesigwa era n’obunyiikivu. Ku nkomerero, olituula ku ntebe ye n’ofugira wamu naye mu bwakabaka obutaggwaawo. Bulimenyamenya ne bumalawo obwakabaka obulala bwonna, era bulibeerera emirembe gyonna.

Tewali kkubo ddala. Obwakabaka buno tebuyingirwamu na malala, endabika, oba obuyinza. Buyingirwamu olw’obutono, obunafu, okubeera ng’omwana, obwana obuto ennyo, n’okufa kwokka. Oyo yekka eyeetoowaza y’aligulumizibwa. Okugabana ku ntebe ya Kristo, tuteekwa okusooka okumugoberera mu kubonaabona, mu kufiirwa, ne mu kukomererwa. Obanga tugumiikiriza awamu naye, era tulifugira wamu naye.

Si mpeera etegekeddwa obutegesi olw’okubonaabona kwaffe, wabula ng’ekivaamu ekijja okugoberera mu butonde bw’ebintu bwennyini. Okufiirwa kwa Kristo kuteekwa okuleeta amagoba ga Kristo. Okufa kwe kuteekwa okuleeta okuzuukira kwe. Okumugoberera mu kuzaalibwa obuggya kujja, awatali kulemererwa, kutuusa emmeeme emugoberera ku ngule ye ne ku ntebe ye. Mu kitabo ky’okubuulira okw’abaana, nnasangamu ekyokulabirako ekirabika obulungi eky’obwakabaka buno obw’ekitiibwa: – Omulenzi omuto okuva mu emu ku nnyumba ez’okulabirira abaana mu Bungereza yali awaddeyo obulamu bwe mu kabi okulokola mukwano gwe. Nnabagereka wa Bungereza yali amuweerezza omudaali ng’ayita mu omu ku bakungu be ab’ekitiibwa. Mikwano gye ne bamusindiikiriza mu maaso okuguweebwa, kubanga yali mukwatibwa nsonyi era nga atya, era ng’agezaako okudda emabega.

Laba ssentebe ow’ekitiibwa. Yali avudde mu Kisenge ky’Abakungu (House of Lords), abakungu ab’ebitiibwa ebya waggulu mwe baali bakuŋŋaanidde, wamu n’abantu abeeyoleka ng’abannamateeka, abalamuzi, abakulembeze b’eggwanga, n’abalwanyi. N’abalangira ab’olulyo olulangira baaliyo. Naye, wadde nga naye yali mukungu, yakwatibwako nnyo. Yayogera mpola nti, “Nfunye ekitiibwa,” n’assa omudaali gw’okulokola obulamu ku kkooti y’omwana. Omutima gwe gwali gujjudde. Yasiriikirira akaseera okumira ekintu ekyali kyagala okulinnya mu mumiro gwe nga tannaba kweyongerayo.

Waliwo ‘ekitiibwa n’ettendo’ eby’abakulembeze b’eggwanga, abalwanyi, n’abannamateeka. Naye ekitiibwa ky’okulokola obulamu awatali kwerowoozaako kisinga byonna. Ekyo kye kitiibwa eky’ekitalo omulenzi ono kye yafuna.” Yali abbidde mu mugga n’agabana ku kabi k’omulenzi eyali agenda okubbira. Omukono ogwo omutono, gutunuulire wali, nga gumunywereza ku mmeeza, gwe gwali guvuddeyo nga gukutte oyo eyalokolebwa.

“Lwaki okwerabira kwennyini kulina amaanyi amangi bwe gatyo? Kyali kitya omulenzi ow’emyaka kkumi n’ebiri okuvunnamya mu maaso ge ekibiina ky’abasajja abakulu? Kiki ekyawa ekyenyi ekyo, n’engule yaakyo ey’enviiri ennyimpi ezimyufumyufu, ekitiibwa n’ettendo ebisinga okumasamasa kwa zaabu n’amayinja ag’omuwendo?

Lwaki omubiri ogwo omutono mu mpale yaagwo entono ne kkooti, nga gusiimuula amaziga gaagwo ku mukono gw’ekkooti omukalubo, gwakwata ku mitima enkumi n’enkumi? Lwaki gwagifuula, okumala akaseera, abantu abeesigwa ab’obwakabaka bwagwo?

Lwaki byonna bino byali bwe bityo? Byali bwe bityo kubanga omulenzi oyo omuto yali afaanana Kristo, mu mwoyo gwe ogw’okwewaayo awatali kwerowoozaako ku lw’abalala.” Yalina ku bulungi bwe tutondeddwa okusinza. Kye kitiibwa ekireetera bamalayika okuleekaana. Eggulu lyonna ligwa wansi ne lisinza. Boogera mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka nti, “Omwana gw’Endiga eyattibwa, asaanidde okuweebwa obuyinza, n’obugagga, n’amagezi n’amaanyi, n’ekitiibwa, n’ettendo n’okwebazibwa!” (Okubikkulirwa 5:12). Omwana gw’Endiga eyattibwa ye Kabaka asinga amaanyi abaddewo. Bonna abagabana ku mwoyo gwe bali mu bwakabaka bwe. Obwakabaka buno si kifo, wabula mbala. Kale, abo abatalina mbala eyo tebayinza kubeera mu bwo.

Buli lunaku tusaba nti, “Obwakabaka bwo bujje.” Tumanyi kye tusaba? Tutegeera enkyukakyuka gye bulireeta mu ffe singa bujja mu ffe? Tuli beetegefu okukyusibwa bwe tutyo? Obwakabaka bwa Katonda kye ki, bwe butaba bufuzi bwa Katonda? Era obufuzi bwa Katonda kye ki, bwe butaba Katonda by’ayagala? N’olwekyo, bwe tusaba nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu.” tuba tukutte ku kyama kya byonna. Ekibinja ky’abantu abatannagunjuka kiyinza okuwamba obwakabaka n’amaanyi, naye okufuga ddala obugunjufu bwabwo, bateekwa okugoberera amateeka gaabwo. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Buwa obuyinza bwabwo abo bokka abagondera amateeka gaabwo. “Buli awangula ndimukkiriza okutuula ng’anninaanye, ku ntebe yange ey’obwakabaka, nga nange bwe nawangula ne ntuula ne Kitange ku ntebe ye.” (Okubikkulirwa 3:21) “Bulijjo afuga oyo ali ku ludda lwa Katonda,” bw’ayogera omuwandiisi omu ow’edda. Era nate, “Oyo akkiriza ddala Katonda by’ayagala, abeera mu bwakabaka obutaggwaawo.”

Ofuga mu ngeri eno era mu bwakabaka obw’engeri eno? Gw’asinga obukulu olw’okubeera omuweereza wa bonna? Oli kabaka afuga embeera zo, oba embeera zo ze zikufuga?

Owangula okukemebwa kwo, oba okukemebwa kwo kukuwangula? Osobola okutuula ku ntebe ey’omunda wakati mu kuwangulwa n’okufiirwa okw’okungulu?

Osobola okuwangula ng’ogonda, n’ofuuka asinga obukulu ng’obeera asinga obutono? Bw’oba tosobola kuddamu nti yee ku bibuuzo bino byonna, olwo tosobola kuyingira mu bwakabaka bwe. “Ka kibe nti embeera yo eri etya oba abantu bakulowoozaako batya, oli mu abo Mukama waffe b’ayita ‘abasinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu.’”
fields.body_text: Abafalisaayo bwe baamubuuza obwakabaka bwa Katonda lwe bulijja, n’abaddamu nti, “Obwakabaka bwa Katonda bulijja ddi?” Yesu n’abaddamu nti, “Obwakabaka bwa Katonda tebulabika nga bujja, era abantu tebagenda kugamba nti, ‘Laba buubuno wano,’ oba nti, ‘Buubuli wali,’ kubanga obwakabaka bwa Katonda buli mu mmwe.” Ebigambo “obwakabaka bwa Katonda” ne “obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu” bitegeeza obulamu bwa Katonda mu mmeeme. Biri mu Byawandiikibwa. Bitegeeza bubeezi ekifo oba embeera Katonda mw’afugira, era by’ayagala mwe bikolerwa. Bwakabaka bwa munda, so si bwa bweru. Entebe zaabwo si za kwenyumiriza na kitiibwa kya bantu. Za kufuga ebintu ebiyitawo n’ebyo ebitegeerwa obusimu bw’omubiri. Bakabaka baabwo tebambala byambalo bya bwakabaka ebya ffulungu n’ebya linena ennungi. Wabula bambala ebyambalo eby’omunda eby’obulongoofu n’amazima. Era okufuga kwabwo tekuli mu kwolesebwa okw’okungulu, wabula mu maanyi ag’omunda. Era tebuli mu kifo kimu okusinga ekirala, wadde mu ngeri y’ebintu emu okusinga endala. Tetwetaaga kunoonyeza Kristo ku lusozi luno wadde mu Yerusaalemi. Si eyo gye tumusanga ne tuyingira mu bwakabaka bwe. Ensonga si ya kifo n’akatono, wabula ya mbeera. Mu buli kifo, mu buli linnya, ne mu buli ngeri, bonna abanoonya Katonda ne bakola ebirungi balisanga obwakabaka bwe munda mu bo. Naye kino kitegeerwa kitono nnyo. Okukwata ebigambo nga bwe biri obwabwe, ng’abaana abato, kwatuleetera okulowooza nti obwakabaka buteekwa okubeera mu kifo ekimu ekigere. Twasuubira nti obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu butegeeza eggulu okuwangula ensi mu lwatu mu kifo ekimu eky’enjawulo. Twalowooza nti okutuula ku ntebe awamu ne Kristo kwandibadde kugulumizibwa mu lwatu mu buyinza ne mu kitiibwa. Naye amakulu ag’omunda ag’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe gagenda gabikkulwa, tulaba nti ekyo kyandibadde kutuukiriza kwa kungulu era okunafu okw’amakulu amatuufu ag’obubonero buno. Era okwolesebwa kw’amakulu gaabwo ag’amazima kweyongera okukula eri “amaaso agalaba.” Ku nkomerero, tutegeera nti ebigambo bya Mukama waffe byali bya mazima okusinga bwe twali tulowoozezza. “Obwakabaka bwa Katonda bulijja ddi?” Yesu n’abaddamu nti, “Obwakabaka bwa Katonda tebulabika nga bujja, era abantu tebagenda kugamba nti, ‘Laba buubuno wano,’ oba nti, ‘Buubuli wali,’ kubanga obwakabaka bwa Katonda buli mu mmwe.” Mu Danyeri 2:44 obwakabaka bulangirirwa nti: “Mu biro ebya bakabaka abo, Katonda w’eggulu alissaawo obwakabaka obutalizikirizibwa, so tebuliweebwa bantu balala. Bulizikiriza obwakabaka obwo bwonna, ne bubumalawo, naye bwo bulibeerera emirembe gyonna.” Mu Isaaya 9:6-7 Kabaka alangirirwa: — “Kubanga omwana atuzaaliddwa ffe, omwana owoobulenzi atuweereddwa ffe, n’okufuga kunaabanga ku bibegabega bye. N’erinnya lye aliyitibwa nti, Wa kitalo, Omuwi w’amagezi, Katonda Ayinzabyonna, Kitaffe ow’Emirembe Gyonna, Omulangira w’Emirembe. Okufuga kwe n’emirembe biryeyongeranga obutakoma. Alifugira ku ntebe ya Dawudi ne ku bwakabaka bwe, n’okubuwanirira n’obwenkanya n’obutuukirivu okuva leero okutuusa emirembe gyonna. Obumalirivu bwa Mukama Katonda ow’Eggye bulikituukiriza ekyo.” Obwakabaka buno bulina obuyinza okuzikiriza obulala bwonna. Etteeka ligamba nti eby’omunda bye biteekwa okufuga eby’ebweru. Bwe wabaawo emirembe munda, tewali kujagalala kuyinza kukwata ku mmeeme. Naye emirembe egy’ebweru tegisobola kukkakkanya kibuyaga ow’omunda. Omutima omusanyufu guyinza okutambula wakati mu nnyanja y’emitawaana nga tegufaayo. Naye ennaku ey’omunda tesobola kufuna ssanyu wadde mu mbeera esingayo obulungi. Omuntu ow’omunda ye azimba oba azikiriza essanyu lye, so si by’alina. Omuntu omu yagamba Diogenes nti, “Kabaka akuggyeeko ekitiibwa.” “Yee,” Diogenes n’addamu ng’ajaguza, “naye nze ekitiibwa sikiggiddwako!” Tewali kikolwa kya bakabaka oba ba Kayisaali kiyinza kuggyako kitiibwa mmeeme ekuuma ekitiibwa kyayo; tewali mufuzi mukambwe ayinza kufuula muddu omuntu ow’eddembe munda. Kale, okubeera n’obwakabaka buno obwa Katonda munda kitegeeza nti amaanyi gonna amalala agaagala okuwangula oba okufuula omuntu omuddu gamenyeddwa. Emmeeme efuga ng’ewangudde ku go gonna. Abantu ne dayimooni bayinza okugezaako okufuula omuntu omuddu. Naye tebalina maanyi mu maaso g’obuyinza bw’obwakabaka buno obw’omunda. Emisono, empisa z’abantu, oba okutya abantu tebikyafuga mmeeme eyasitulibwa n’etuuzibwa ku ntebe mu bwakabaka buno obw’omunda. So n’okwagala okwewummulira tekukyagifuga. Abakristaayo bakankana ne bavunnamira abafuzi abakambwe bangi. Tewali kibi wadde okukemebwa okuyinza okuwangula, tewali nnaku eyinza okubetenta, tewali kuggwaamu maanyi kuyinza kuziyiza. Omusajja oba omukazi ne bw’aba nga yasibibwa mu njegere ez’obukambwe ennyo ez’emize egy’ekibi, obwakabaka buno bulimuteeka mu ddembe. Embeera ziyinza okufuula abantu bakabaka mu nsi ey’ebweru. Naye mu bulamu obukusike, abantu bafuuka bakabaka abafuga embeera. Era emmeeme eyali omuddu w’ebintu lukumi, kati yeesanga nga tekyabyesigamako n’akatono. Kubanga Kabaka mu bwakabaka buno ye oyo atasobola kukosebwa wadde okutabulwa ekintu kyonna. Ye wuuyo akola embeera. Okuva okufuga bwe kuli ku bibegabega bye, tetuyinza kubuusabuusa nti alifuga n’obwenkanya obutuukiridde. Abantu be tebaliiko kye baliburwa. Ebigambo “n’okufuga kunaabanga ku bibegabega bye” bye birimu ekyama ky’obwakabaka buno obw’ekitalo. Ku bibegabega bye, so si ku byaffe. Okulabirira kukwe. Emigugu gigye. Obuvunaanyizibwa bubwe. Obukuumi bubwe. Okuteekateeka, okugaba, okufuga n’okuluŋŋamya byonna biri mu mikono gye. Tewali ayinza kubuusabuusa nti atuukiriza bulungi ddala buli kyetaagisa mu bwakabaka bwe. Kale, abo abali mu bwakabaka bwe tebalina kweraliikirira, migugu, wadde mitawaana. Era olw’okununulibwa kuno bafuuka bakabaka. Okufuga tekuli ku bibegabega byabwe, era tebalina nsonga kukuyingiramu. Kabaka waabwe yeetisse obuvunaanyizibwa bwonna. Bw’alaba abantu be nga basanyufu era nga bagaggawala, amatira okwetikka obuzito bwonna n’okulabirira kwonna okw’obwakabaka. Emirundi mingi twogera ku mirimu gya bakabaka ab’omu nsi. Tubasaasira olw’emigugu gy’obwakabaka. Tutegeera, ne ku mutendera gw’ensi, nti okuba kabaka kitegeeza, oba kyandibadde kitegeeza, okwetikka emigugu gy’omuntu wa wansi ddala mu bantu be. Ne kaakano, nga bwe mpandiika, emitima mingi giruma ku lwa Czar omuggya. Yeetisse omugugu omuzito ogw’Obwakabaka bwa Russia obugazi ennyo. Okuva mu buli mutima gw’omuntu tuyinza okuyiga emirimu gy’obwakabaka. Kale kino kye kitegeeza okubeera mu bwakabaka Katonda mw’ali Kabaka. Yalangirira nti ebintu byonna birirongoosebwa mu nsala entuufu ne mu bwenkanya, emirembe gyonna. Mazima tewali kulabirira wadde okweraliikirira kuyinza kuyingira wano, singa omutima gumanya bumanya obwakabaka bwagwo ne Kabaka waagwo! Mu Yokaana 18:36, Kabaka waffe atubuulira enkola y’obwakabaka bwe: Yesu n’addamu nti, “Obwakabaka bwange si bwa mu nsi muno. Singa bubadde bwa mu nsi eno abaweereza bange bandirwanye ne siweebwayo mu Bayudaaya. Naye obwakabaka bwange si bwa mu nsi muno.” Bakabaka n’obwakabaka eby’omu nsi bifuna obukulu nga biyita mu ntalo. Obwakabaka bwa Katonda buwangula olw’amaanyi ag’omunda. Bakabaka ab’omu nsi bawangula abalabe; Katonda awangula obulabe. Obuwanguzi bwe buteekwa okusooka okubeera obw’omunda nga tebunnaba kubeera bwa bweru. Tafuula bantu baddu ng’abakaka, wabula abawangula. Ffe ffennyini, ku mutendera gwaffe ogw’ensi, tumanyi etteeka lino. Tetutwala nga kya muwendo buwanguzi ku munnaffe obutuuka ku mubiri bwokka ne butawangula mutima. Tewali maama wa mazima afaayo ku buwulize obw’okungulu bwokka; tewali kimumatiza okuggyako okwewaayo okw’omunda. Omutima bwe gutawangulwa mu makkati gaagwo, obuwanguzi bulabika nga tebulina mugaso. Kale eri Katonda, tekisingawo nnyo? Tugambibwa nti: Naye Mukama n’agamba Samwiri nti, “Totunuulira nfaanana ye wadde obuwanvu bwe, kubanga si gwe nnonze. Mukama tatunuulira ebyo abantu bye batunuulira. Abantu batunuulira bya kungulu naye Mukama atunuulira bya mu mutima.” (1 Samwiri 16:7) Twogera ku “kuwangula emitima.” Tetutegeeza kukaka muntu kwewaayo. Tutegeeza nti emitima egyo giwangulwa ne giweebwayo eri omulala nga gyagala. Era mu ngeri eno yokka, so si mu ndala, Katonda mw’awangulira. Kale okusoma nti “obwakabaka bwe bufuga ensi yonna” kitegeeza nti emitima gyonna giwangulwa okumuweereza nga gyewaayo n’essanyu era nga gyagala. Kubanga nziramu nate, okufuga kwe kuteekwa okusooka okubeera okw’omunda nga tekunnaba kubeera kwa bweru. Era mazima, tekuba kufuga n’akatono, okuggyako nga kuli munda. Bwe tulowooza akaseera katono, tujja kulaba nti kino kiteekwa okuba bwe kityo. Tekisoboka kulowooza Katonda ng’afuga mu bwakabaka abantu be mwe batafugibwa okusukka ebikolwa byabwe eby’okungulu. Obwakabaka bwe si bwa mu nsi muno. Bwakabaka bwa mwoyo. Obuyinza bwabwo buli ku mmeeme, so si ku mibiri. Kale, busobola okuteekebwawo nga emmeeme emaze okuwangulwa kyokka. Bwe tulaba bwe tutyo, ebirangiriro n’obunnabbi bwonna ebyo bijjula okwagala n’omukisa. Byogera nti Katonda aliwangula abalabe be era alibafuga mu butuukirivu ne mu buyinza! Era nga liwulikika nga lijjudde essuubi ery’ekitiibwa eddoboozi ly’ekibiina ekinene Yokaana kye yawulira nga kigamba nti, “Aleruuya, kubanga Mukama Katonda waffe Ayinzabyonna y’afuga.” Okukakasa bino byonna tulina ebitundu bibiri eby’Ebyawandiikibwa ebinnyonnyola obwakabaka buno, mu (Abaruumi 14:17) “Kubanga obwakabaka bwa Katonda si kulya na kunywa, wabula butuukirivu na mirembe, na ssanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.” ne mu (1 Abakkolinso 4:20): “Kubanga obwakabaka bwa Katonda tebuli mu kwogera bwogezi, wabula mu maanyi.” Si bintu bya kungulu, wabula bya munda. Si omuntu by’alya oba by’anywa. Si w’abeera. Si ggwanga lye wadde empisa z’eggwanga lye. Wadde ebirowoozo bye oba ebigambo bye. Naye bubonero ki obw’omunda obw’obutonde bwe? Maanyi ki ag’omwoyo gwe? Kubanga ebyo byokka bye bikola obwakabaka buno obwa Katonda. Si kye nkola, wabula kye ndi, kye kirisalawo oba ndi mu bwo oba nedda. Obwakabaka buno busobola okuteekebwawo nga tulina era nga tuli mu kulaba mu bulamu bwaffe obutuukirivu obw’omunda, emirembe, essanyu, n’amaanyi. Kale, tewali kufuga kwa bweru kuyinza kuleeta bibala ng’ebyo. Omulimu ogw’omunda ogw’Omwoyo wa Katonda awangula byonna gwe gwokka oguyinza. Nnyize nnyo okuva mu lugero lwa Odysseus n’olugendo lwe, bwe yali ng’ayita ku bizinga by’abasireeni (sirens). Abasireeni bano baali basobola okusikiriza buli eyawuliranga ennyimba zaabwe. Babasendasendanga ne babbuukira mu nnyanja. Okwewala akabi kano, Odysseus yajjuza amatu g’abavuzi b’eryato lye envumbo. Yakola kino baleme kuwulira nnyimba ezitta. Oluvannyuma yeesiba ku mulongooti gw’eryato n’emiguwa egy’amafundo. Ne bayita ku kizinga nga tebalina kabi. Naye Orpheus bwe yali ateekwa okuyita ku kizinga kye kimu, yafuna obuwanguzi obusingako. Yayimba ennyimba ennungi okusinga ez’abasireeni, n’asanyusa abavuzi be n’ennyimba ezisikiriza okusingawo. Kale ne bayita ku basikiriza abo ab’akabi, si mu mirembe kyokka naye nga babanyooma. Envumbo n’emiguwa egy’amafundo byakuuma Odysseus n’abavuzi be obutabbuuka mu nnyanja kufiirayo. Naye essanyu ery’omunda lyasobozesa Orpheus n’abavuzi be okuwangula okukemebwa kwennyini. Era bwe kityo bwe kiri n’obwakabaka bwe twogerako. Tebwetaaga tteeka lya bweru kubusiba, wabula bufuga olw’obuyinza obw’obulamu bwabwo obw’omunda. Kye kiva kyogerwa ku abo abaabuyingiramu nti, “awali ebyo tewali tteeka libiwakanya.” Kubanga bwakabaka bwa bakabaka. Oluyimba lwe tuliyimba lumu, nedda, lwe tusaanidde okuba nga tuyimba kaakano wano mu bulamu buno, lukirangirira: “era n’okuva eri Yesu Kristo omujulirwa omwesigwa. Oyo ye yasooka okuzuukira mu bafu, era y’afuga bakabaka ab’omu nsi; oyo yatwagala, era ye yatuggya mu bibi byaffe n’omusaayi gwe, n’atufuula obwakabaka bw’obwakabona bwa Katonda, Kitaawe. Ekitiibwa n’obuyinza bibeerenga eri oyo emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.” (Okubikkulirwa 1:5-6.) Ffe abaayingira mu bwakabaka buno, oba, okusinga, ffe obwakabaka buno mwe bwateekebwawo, tutuula ku ntebe wamu ne Kabaka waffe ne tugabana ku kufuga kwe. Ensi yali ke katebe ke ak’ebigere, era efuuka ke katebe kaffe ak’ebigere naffe. Yafuga waggulu w’ebintu ebiyitawo n’ebyo ebitegeerwa obusimu bw’omubiri. Obulamu obwabeerwangamu ku mutendera ogw’awaggulu era ogusingako bwe bwamuwa obuyinza obwo. Naffe tuyinza bwe tutyo. Ffenna tumanyi enjogera nti omuntu “ayimuka n’asukka embeera ze.” Kitegeeza nti mu muntu oyo mulimu amaanyi agakwekeddwa. Gafuga embeera ze mu kifo ky’okufugibwa zo. Kabaka waffe yasukka waggulu w’embeera ze. Ffe abafuga awamu naye, tuyinza okukola kye kimu. Naye, nga bwe yali nga si kabaka mu ndabika ey’okungulu, wabula mu maanyi ag’omunda gokka, naffe bwe tutyo bwe tuliba. Yafuga, si lwa kuba nti yalina obugagga bwonna obw’ensi. Wabula kubanga teyalina na kimu, era nga asobola okubeera nga tabulina. Era bwe kityo bwe kuliba okufuga kwaffe. Abantu bonna tebalituvunnamira, era n’ebintu byonna tebirigondera kwagala kwaffe. Abantu bonna nga batuziyiza, n’ebintu byonna nga bitulwanyisa, tulibiyitamu nga tutambula mu buwanguzi bw’emmeeme obw’obwakabaka. Tulifiirwa ebintu byonna, era olw’okufiirwa okwo tuliteebwa emirembe gyonna okuva mu buyinza bwabyo obw’okutusiba. Tulyekweka mu Kabaka by’ayagala, ekigo ekitayinza kumenyebwa. Eyo, tulifugira mu Bwakabaka obutaggwaawo. Bino byonna bikontana n’endowooza y’omuntu ku bwakabaka. Omutima gw’omuntu gusobola okutegeera endowooza emu yokka. Y’eno: nti embeera ez’ebweru ziteekwa okugondera emmeeme etudde ku ntebe awamu ne Kristo. Mikwano giteekwa okusiima, abalabe bateekwa okusirisibwa, n’ebiziyiza biteekwa okuwangulwa. Ensonga ziteekwa okugenda obulungi, oba si ekyo tewali kufuga. Singa omuntu ye yali aluŋŋamya ensonga za Danyeri, oba ez’Abaebbulaniya abasatu mu kikoomi ky’omuliro, yandigambye nti okuwangula, bateekwa okukyusa ebirowoozo bya bakabaka. Danyeri teyandisuuliddwa mu mpuku y’empologoma, n’abaana b’Abaebbulaniya bandikuumiddwa obutayingira mu kikoomi. Naye ekkubo lya Katonda lyali lya kitiibwa nnyo okusingawo. Yaleka Danyeri okusuulibwa mu mpologoma. Yayagala afuge ng’awangula wakati mu zo. Yaleka Saddulaaki, ne Mesaki ne Abeduneego okusuulibwa mu kikoomi ekyaka omuliro. Yayagala batambule mu kyo, so n’olusu lw’omuliro nga terubawunyako. Tatugamba kutambulira mu makubo agataliimu bisota binene na nswera. Wabula tulitambula wakati mu byo, era “tulibirinnyirira n’ebigere byaffe.” Era nga obwakabaka buno bwa kitiibwa nnyo okusinga okufuga kwonna okw’okungulu oba okulagira kwonna! Okubeera kabaka munda, naye omuddu ebweru, buwanguzi bunene. Kye kisingayo emitima gyaffe kye giyinza okulowooza. Okubeera mu bwetaavu, mu nnaku, nga obonyaabonyezebwa. Okukubibwa amayinja, okusalibwamu, n’okuttibwa n’ekitala. Okutambulatambula ng’oyambadde amaliba g’endiga n’ag’embuzi, ne mu malungu, mu nsozi, mu mpuku ne mu bunnya. Naye, mu byonna ebyo, okubeera bakabaka mu bwakabaka obw’obutuukirivu, emirembe, n’essanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Buno bwakabaka Katonda yekka bw’ayinza okugaba, era emmeeme ezifaanana Katonda zokka ze ziyinza okubufuna. Twalaba oba twawulira ku bakabaka abatonotono ng’abo. Emitima gyonna gikkirizza obuyinza bwabwe obwakolanga nga bo tebakimanyi. Nnasoma ku omu ku bamonaaki b’ennyumba y’abamonaaki ey’e St. Cyr. Okwewaayo kwabwe eri Katonda kwaleetera ennyumba z’abamonaaki n’abakulu baazo okubakyawa. Baagobwa mu kibiina kyabwe ng’ababi. Omu yasindikibwa ng’omusibe mu nnyumba y’abamonaaki abalabe be mwe baabeeranga. Eyo, yayisibwa mu ngeri enkambwe era ey’okumuswaza. Wadde yali ava mu lulyo olw’ekitiibwa era nga yali mukulembeze edda, yawalirizibwa okukola emirimu egya wansi ennyo. Yawalirizibwa okwetikka omugugu omuzito ku mugongo, n’alagirwa okusabiriza ng’ayambadde ku kifuba akapande akagamba nti ye mubi asinga ababi bonna. Naye, mu byonna ebyo, omwoyo gw’omutukuvu oyo gwawangula. Tewali kyamutabulira mirembe gye wadde okunyiwaza obukkakkamu bwe obufaanana obwa Kristo. Eri abaamuyigganyanga, teyalina kirala okuggyako ebigambo eby’ekisa n’akamwenyumwenyu ak’okwagala. Ku nkomerero, olw’amaanyi amangi ag’obwakabaka bwa Katonda, yawangula emitima gyonna. Yafuuka mukwano gwabwe gwe beesiga era omuwi w’amagezi, era omufuzi omwagalwa ow’abo abaali abalabe be edda, abaasanyukanga okumuyigganya. “Balina omukisa abeetoowaze, kubanga abo balisikira ensi.” (Matayo 5:5). Olw’obuwombeefu bwe, yawangula n’afuuka kabaka. Lumu, omumenyi w’amateeka ow’akabi yaleetebwa mu nnyumba y’abamonaaki okusibibwa. Yali mukambwe nnyo nga tewali njegere zimala kumusiba, era tewali maanyi gaali gayinza kumufuga. Ku nkomerero, yatwalibwa mu kisenge ky’ow’oluganda omu ow’e St. Cyr. Ne basibirwa wamu. Wadde abamonaaki abo abatakwatibwako nnyo baakitegeera nti obuwombeefu obwo obwa Katonda bwalina amaanyi okuwangula agasinga byonna bye baali bamanyi. Omutukuvu yaaniriza omusajja oyo omukambwe ng’owooluganda omwagalwa n’amumwenyeza n’ekisa eky’omu ggulu. Naye omumenyi w’amateeka n’amusasula n’ebivume n’effujjo. Yamenya ebintu by’omumonaaki n’ayonoona ekitanda kye, n’amusamba, n’amukuba, n’amusika enviiri, era n’amuwandira amalusu. Yeekooya ng’amukolako effujjo. Mu byonna ebyo, omumonaaki teyaziyiza kintu na kimu. Yayogera ebigambo by’okwagala byokka. Ku nkomerero, omumenyi w’amateeka, ng’akooye olw’obusungu, n’ayimirira okussa omukka. Awo omusajja eyali akubiddwa era n’avumibwa n’amwenyeza oyo eyamuyigganya n’okwagala okungi n’okusaasira. Kyali ng’ayagala okumubudaabuda mu nnaku ye. Kino kyasukka omumenyi w’amateeka kye yali ayinza okugumira. Obukyayi, okwesasuza, n’obusungu yali ayinza okubyanukula mu ngeri y’emu. Naye teyalina byakulwanyisa ku kwagala n’obuwombeefu ng’obwo. Omutima gwe gwawangulwa. Yagwa ku bigere by’omutukuvu n’abinaaza n’amaziga ge, ng’amwegayirira amusonyiwe olw’obukambwe bwe, n’alayira okumuweereza n’obwesigwa obulamu bwe bwonna. Era okuva mu kaseera ako, emitawaana gyonna n’omumenyi w’amateeka oyo gyaggwaawo. Yagobereranga omutukuvu buli w’agenda ng’embwa eyagala era enyiikivu, nga yeesunga okukola oba okubeera buli kye yandyagadde. Ekiseera kye eky’okusibibwa bwe kyaggwaako, enzigi ne ziggulwawo. Naye teyasobola kusendebwasendebwa kugenda, kubanga teyagumira kuleka musajja eyamulokola olw’okwagala. Obwakabaka mu bwakabaka buno obw’omu ggulu bwe bufaanana bwe butyo. Buli mmeeme esobola okukyekwatiramu yokka, awatali kwetaaga kunnyonnyola kwange. Mu (Matayo 5:6-7), tulina Kabaka w’obwakabaka buno ng’annyonnyola engeri z’obwakabaka bwe era ng’awa amateeka eri abantu be. “Balina omukisa abalumwa enjala olw’obutuukirivu kubanga abo balikkusibwa. Balina omukisa ab’ekisa, kubanga abo balikwatirwa ekisa.” Si abagagga, oba abakulu, oba ab’amagezi, oba abayivu. Wabula abaavu mu mwoyo, abeetoowaze, ab’ekisa, abalina omutima omulongoofu, abakungubaga, n’abalumwa enjala n’ennyonta. Era n’abayigganyizibwa, abavumibwa, n’abawaayirizibwa. Bonna abali bwe batyo ba mu bwakabaka buno. Bakabaka bano bakkakkamu, bagonvu, beetoowaze, era bagabi. Bafuga n’amaanyi ago. Omukristaayo omu yabuuza munne nti, “Nnyinza ntya okuleetera abantu okunzisaamu ekitiibwa?” “Nze nandibaleetedde okukimpa nga nkisaanidde,” bwe yamuddamu. Kino kyali kitegeeza, si nti yandibalagidde nti, “Munzisengamu ekitiibwa!” Wabula nti yandikoze, n’awangaala, n’abeera, mu ngeri nti bonna bandimussizzaamu ekitiibwa. Abantu bayinza okufuna ekitiibwa eky’okungulu nga bakozesa obukambwe. Naye, okufuga emitima gyabwe, bateekwa okugezaako amakubo amalala. Mukama waffe yannyonnyola endowooza eno eri abo abaali baagala okugabana ku ntebe ye. Yesu kwe kubayita n’abagamba nti, “Mumanyi ng’abakulembeze b’abamawanga babazitoowereza embeera, n’abakulu baabwe babafuza lyanyi. (Matayo 20:25). “Naye tekisaanye kuba bwe kityo mu mmwe. Buli ayagala okubeera omukulu mu mmwe, abeerenga muweereza wa banne. Na buli ayagala okuba omwami mu mmwe aweerezenga banne ng’omuddu waabwe. Mube nga Omwana w’Omuntu atajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi.” Mu ndowooza y’abantu, omuntu omu yekka y’afuga. Y’oyo asobola okubeera mukama w’abo abamwetoolodde. Mu ndowooza ya Katonda, emmeeme eweereza y’emmeeme efuga. Si oyo asaba ebisingawo y’afuna engule eno ey’omunda, wabula oyo alekayo ebisingawo. Bukulembeze ki obuyinza okulowoozebwa obusinga obwa Kristo mu Kubuulira okw’oku Lusozi? “Naye mbagamba nti, Temuwakananga na mubi, naye omuntu bw’akukubanga oluyi ku ttama erya ddyo omukyusizanga n’ettama eryokubiri.” Omuntu bw’ayagalanga okuwoza naawe atwale essaati yo, omulekeranga n’ekkooti yo. N’oyo akuwalirizanga okumwetikkirako omugugu gwe kilomita emu, omutwalirangako n’eyokubiri. (Matayo 5:39) Mazima emmeeme yokka etabagana ne Katonda y’eyinza okulinnya ku ntebe ey’obuyinza ng’eno! Naye eno ye nkomerero yaffe. Twatondebwa lwa kigendererwa kino. Twazaalibwa mu lulyo lwa bakabaka, era tuli basika b’obwakabaka buno obutayogerekeka; “Kale nga bwe tuli abaana, tuli basika ba Katonda, era tulisikira wamu ne Kristo, bwe tubonaabonera awamu naye, tulyoke tuweerwe wamu naye ekitiibwa.” (Abaruumi 8:17) Singa twali tusobola okutegeera kino, ne tulaba mu buli kikolwa eky’okuweereza oba eky’okwewaayo, eddaala erigenda waggulu. Lyandituleetedde eri obwakabaka bwaffe n’entebe yaffe! Kino nkitegeeza mu ngeri ey’ensonga ddala. Ntegeeza nti emirimu gyaffe egya buli lunaku egya wansi n’okwefiiriza kwaffe okutono, bwe bikolebwa obulungi, bijja kubeera amadaala agatuyimusa okutuuka ku ntebe zaffe. Bwe tunaabanga abeesigwa mu “bintu ebitono” eby’obwakabaka bwaffe obw’ensi, tulifuulibwa abafuzi ab’“ebintu ebingi” eby’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Oyo aweereza n’abonaabona ku lwa Kristo alifugira wamu naye. Aliba “omwami” mu bwakabaka bwe obw’okwagala. Bwe tumanya kino, ani yandiruddewo okukyusa n’ettama eddala? Waliwo obwakabaka n’entebe eby’okuwangula. Yusufu yali kifaananyi kya bino byonna. Mu buddu ne mu kkomera yafuga nga kabaka, mu mazima nga bwe yafuga ng’atudde ku ntebe ya Falaawo oba ng’atambulira mu ggaali lya Falaawo. (Laba Olubereberye 39:6) “Awo Omumisiri n’ateeka byonna mu mikono gya Yusufu. Yusufu n’avunaanyizibwanga byonna okuggyako emmere mukama we gye yalyanga. Kyokka Yusufu yali mulungi nnyo, mubalagavu.” (Olubereberye 39:22-23.) “Omukuumi w’ekkomera n’ateeka abasibe bonna mu mikono gya Yusufu, era buli ekyakolebwanga nga Yusufu y’akirinako obuvunaanyizibwa. Omukuumi w’ekkomera nga tafaayo ku buli ekyalinga mu mikono gya Yusufu, kubanga Mukama yali naye, era Mukama n’amuwa omukisa mu buli kye yakolanga.” Yafuuka asinga obukulu olw’okubeera asinga obutono, omwami olw’okubeera omuweereza wa bonna. Omusomi omwagalwa, ofuga bw’otyo, mu bwakabaka obw’engeri eno? Gw’asinga obukulu mu nsi yo entono — awaka, mu kkanisa, oba mu mikwano gyo? Kale beera asinga obutono. Beera muweereza wa buli muntu. Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, obwakabaka bwo si bwakabaka bwa Kristo, era entebe yo togigabanako naye. Okutuuka ku byama n’amaanyi g’obwakabaka buno obw’omunda si kirooto. Si buwanguzi bwa kulowooza bulowooza. Ngeri ya mazima ddala era entuufu ey’okufuga. Ejja kukusitula ofuuke waggulu w’ensi n’ebigyeraliikiriza. Ojja kugiyitamu nga totaataaganyizibwa kutenderezebwa kwayo wadde kunenya kwayo. Ojja kubeera mu kifo eky’emirembe n’obuwanguzi ensi ky’etayinza kukuwa wadde okukuggyako. “Kubanga obwakabaka bwa Katonda tebuli mu kwogera bwogezi, wabula mu maanyi.” Bwakabaka buno si bigambo wabula kintu kya ddala ekiriwo, era abo abali mu bwo bategeera obwakabaka bwabwe ne babukakasa nga bafuga. Naye oboolyawo oyinza okugamba nti, “Nnyinza ntya okuyingira mu bwakabaka buno, obanga sinnabuyingiramu?” Mukama waffe yennyini akuddemu: Mu kiseera ekyo abayigirizwa ba Yesu ne bajja gy’ali nga bagamba nti, “Ani asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu?” (Matayo 18:1) Yesu n’ayita omwana omuto n’amussa mu makkati gaabwe. N’abagamba nti, “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe mutakyuke kufaanana ng’abaana abato temugenda kuyingira mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Noolwekyo buli eyeetoowaza ng’omwana ono omuto y’aliba asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu.” (Matayo 18:2-3) Bwakabaka bwa mitima egifaanana egy’abaana abato, era egyo gyokka gye giyinza okubuyingiramu. Okubeera “omwana omuto” kitegeeza bubeezi okubeera omwana omuto. Siyinza kukinnyonnyola bulungi okusinga bwe ntyo. Ffenna tumanyi abaana abato. Tusanyukira obwesimbu bwabwe, okwesiga kwabwe, n’obuteeraliikirira bwabwe. Tusiima obuwulize bwabwe obutabuusabuusa eri abo ababafuga. Okubeera asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka buno obwa Katonda, omuntu ateekwa okubeera n’omutima gw’omwana ogusinga okwesiga, okuba omugonvu, n’okuwulira. Gwe mutima ogutaliimu bukuusa era ogwerabira gwokka. “Si bonna abampita nti, ‘Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe,’ be baliyingira obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, wabula abo bokka abakola ebyo Kitange ali mu ggulu by’ayagala.” (Matayo 7:21). Wano si kwogera, wabula kukola, okutugasa. Tuteekwa okubeera omwana, oba tetuyinza kutuula ku ntebe y’omwana. Era okubeera omwana kitegeeza okukola Kitaffe by’ayagala, kubanga ekikulu ddala mu bwana obw’amazima gwe mwoyo ogw’obuwulize ogugattiddwa n’omwoyo ogw’okwesiga. Fuuka omwana omuto. Teeka ku bbali obukulu bwo, okwekuza kwo, n’amagezi go. Lekayo amaanyi go n’okwesigama ku ggwe wennyini. Kkiriza okufa eri obulamu bwo obw’edda. Zaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Ekkubo lyokka ery’okuva mu bulamu obumu okuyingira mu bulala kwe kufa eri obumu n’okuzaalibwa obuggya mu bulala. Kale lwe lugero olw’edda, oluddiddwamu emirundi mingi ennyo era mu ngeri nnyingi ez’enjawulo, olw’okuyita mu kufa okutuuka mu bulamu. Kale, fa olyoke obeere mulamu. Fiirwa obulamu bwo obubwo olyoke ofune obulamu bwa Kristo. Ensaanyi zisobola okuyingira mu bwakabaka bw’ekiwojjolo nga zifa eri obulamu bwazo obw’ensaanyi kyokka, olwo ne zifuuka ebiwojjolo. Mu ngeri y’emu, tusobola okuyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda nga tufa eri obwakabaka bw’okwerowoozaako kyokka, olwo ne tuzuukira mu bulamu mu Kristo. Leka byonna eby’obuzaaliranwa. Mu byo mwe muli endowooza zo, enteekateeka zo, n’ebirowoozo byo. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, kkiriza enteekateeka za Katonda, amakubo ge, n’ebirowoozo bye. Kino kikole n’obwesigwa era n’obunyiikivu. Ku nkomerero, olituula ku ntebe ye n’ofugira wamu naye mu bwakabaka obutaggwaawo. Bulimenyamenya ne bumalawo obwakabaka obulala bwonna, era bulibeerera emirembe gyonna. Tewali kkubo ddala. Obwakabaka buno tebuyingirwamu na malala, endabika, oba obuyinza. Buyingirwamu olw’obutono, obunafu, okubeera ng’omwana, obwana obuto ennyo, n’okufa kwokka. Oyo yekka eyeetoowaza y’aligulumizibwa. Okugabana ku ntebe ya Kristo, tuteekwa okusooka okumugoberera mu kubonaabona, mu kufiirwa, ne mu kukomererwa. Obanga tugumiikiriza awamu naye, era tulifugira wamu naye. Si mpeera etegekeddwa obutegesi olw’okubonaabona kwaffe, wabula ng’ekivaamu ekijja okugoberera mu butonde bw’ebintu bwennyini. Okufiirwa kwa Kristo kuteekwa okuleeta amagoba ga Kristo. Okufa kwe kuteekwa okuleeta okuzuukira kwe. Okumugoberera mu kuzaalibwa obuggya kujja, awatali kulemererwa, kutuusa emmeeme emugoberera ku ngule ye ne ku ntebe ye. Mu kitabo ky’okubuulira okw’abaana, nnasangamu ekyokulabirako ekirabika obulungi eky’obwakabaka buno obw’ekitiibwa: – Omulenzi omuto okuva mu emu ku nnyumba ez’okulabirira abaana mu Bungereza yali awaddeyo obulamu bwe mu kabi okulokola mukwano gwe. Nnabagereka wa Bungereza yali amuweerezza omudaali ng’ayita mu omu ku bakungu be ab’ekitiibwa. Mikwano gye ne bamusindiikiriza mu maaso okuguweebwa, kubanga yali mukwatibwa nsonyi era nga atya, era ng’agezaako okudda emabega. Laba ssentebe ow’ekitiibwa. Yali avudde mu Kisenge ky’Abakungu (House of Lords), abakungu ab’ebitiibwa ebya waggulu mwe baali bakuŋŋaanidde, wamu n’abantu abeeyoleka ng’abannamateeka, abalamuzi, abakulembeze b’eggwanga, n’abalwanyi. N’abalangira ab’olulyo olulangira baaliyo. Naye, wadde nga naye yali mukungu, yakwatibwako nnyo. Yayogera mpola nti, “Nfunye ekitiibwa,” n’assa omudaali gw’okulokola obulamu ku kkooti y’omwana. Omutima gwe gwali gujjudde. Yasiriikirira akaseera okumira ekintu ekyali kyagala okulinnya mu mumiro gwe nga tannaba kweyongerayo. Waliwo ‘ekitiibwa n’ettendo’ eby’abakulembeze b’eggwanga, abalwanyi, n’abannamateeka. Naye ekitiibwa ky’okulokola obulamu awatali kwerowoozaako kisinga byonna. Ekyo kye kitiibwa eky’ekitalo omulenzi ono kye yafuna.” Yali abbidde mu mugga n’agabana ku kabi k’omulenzi eyali agenda okubbira. Omukono ogwo omutono, gutunuulire wali, nga gumunywereza ku mmeeza, gwe gwali guvuddeyo nga gukutte oyo eyalokolebwa. “Lwaki okwerabira kwennyini kulina amaanyi amangi bwe gatyo? Kyali kitya omulenzi ow’emyaka kkumi n’ebiri okuvunnamya mu maaso ge ekibiina ky’abasajja abakulu? Kiki ekyawa ekyenyi ekyo, n’engule yaakyo ey’enviiri ennyimpi ezimyufumyufu, ekitiibwa n’ettendo ebisinga okumasamasa kwa zaabu n’amayinja ag’omuwendo? Lwaki omubiri ogwo omutono mu mpale yaagwo entono ne kkooti, nga gusiimuula amaziga gaagwo ku mukono gw’ekkooti omukalubo, gwakwata ku mitima enkumi n’enkumi? Lwaki gwagifuula, okumala akaseera, abantu abeesigwa ab’obwakabaka bwagwo? Lwaki byonna bino byali bwe bityo? Byali bwe bityo kubanga omulenzi oyo omuto yali afaanana Kristo, mu mwoyo gwe ogw’okwewaayo awatali kwerowoozaako ku lw’abalala.” Yalina ku bulungi bwe tutondeddwa okusinza. Kye kitiibwa ekireetera bamalayika okuleekaana. Eggulu lyonna ligwa wansi ne lisinza. Boogera mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka nti, “Omwana gw’Endiga eyattibwa, asaanidde okuweebwa obuyinza, n’obugagga, n’amagezi n’amaanyi, n’ekitiibwa, n’ettendo n’okwebazibwa!” (Okubikkulirwa 5:12). Omwana gw’Endiga eyattibwa ye Kabaka asinga amaanyi abaddewo. Bonna abagabana ku mwoyo gwe bali mu bwakabaka bwe. Obwakabaka buno si kifo, wabula mbala. Kale, abo abatalina mbala eyo tebayinza kubeera mu bwo. Buli lunaku tusaba nti, “Obwakabaka bwo bujje.” Tumanyi kye tusaba? Tutegeera enkyukakyuka gye bulireeta mu ffe singa bujja mu ffe? Tuli beetegefu okukyusibwa bwe tutyo? Obwakabaka bwa Katonda kye ki, bwe butaba bufuzi bwa Katonda? Era obufuzi bwa Katonda kye ki, bwe butaba Katonda by’ayagala? N’olwekyo, bwe tusaba nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu.” tuba tukutte ku kyama kya byonna. Ekibinja ky’abantu abatannagunjuka kiyinza okuwamba obwakabaka n’amaanyi, naye okufuga ddala obugunjufu bwabwo, bateekwa okugoberera amateeka gaabwo. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Buwa obuyinza bwabwo abo bokka abagondera amateeka gaabwo. “Buli awangula ndimukkiriza okutuula ng’anninaanye, ku ntebe yange ey’obwakabaka, nga nange bwe nawangula ne ntuula ne Kitange ku ntebe ye.” (Okubikkulirwa 3:21) “Bulijjo afuga oyo ali ku ludda lwa Katonda,” bw’ayogera omuwandiisi omu ow’edda. Era nate, “Oyo akkiriza ddala Katonda by’ayagala, abeera mu bwakabaka obutaggwaawo.” Ofuga mu ngeri eno era mu bwakabaka obw’engeri eno? Gw’asinga obukulu olw’okubeera omuweereza wa bonna? Oli kabaka afuga embeera zo, oba embeera zo ze zikufuga? Owangula okukemebwa kwo, oba okukemebwa kwo kukuwangula? Osobola okutuula ku ntebe ey’omunda wakati mu kuwangulwa n’okufiirwa okw’okungulu? Osobola okuwangula ng’ogonda, n’ofuuka asinga obukulu ng’obeera asinga obutono? Bw’oba tosobola kuddamu nti yee ku bibuuzo bino byonna, olwo tosobola kuyingira mu bwakabaka bwe. “Ka kibe nti embeera yo eri etya oba abantu bakulowoozaako batya, oli mu abo Mukama waffe b’ayita ‘abasinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu.’”

fields.title: Amagaali ga Katonda
fields.body_html:
“Mukama ava ku lusozi Sinaayi nga yeetooloddwa amagaali enkumi n’enkumi n’ajja mu kifo kye ekitukuvu. (Zabbuli 68:17.)

Amagaali gakozesebwa okutambuza abantu n’okugenda mu maaso. Amagaali ag’ensi gatuusa abagalimu gye balaga, nga gawangula buli kiziyiza. Amagaali ga Katonda gasitula emyoyo. Tewali bigambo biyinza kunnyonnyola bifo bya kitiibwa emmeeme etambulira mu magaali ga Katonda gy’eriituuka. Era olunyiriri lwaffe lutubuulira nti gali “enkumi n’enkumi.” Gatwetoolodde ku buli ludda nga gatulindiridde; naye ffe, eky’ennaku, bulijjo tetugalaba. Amagaali ag’ensi galabika bulijjo, naye amagaali ga Katonda tegalabika.

“Amangwago n’asindika embalaasi, n’amagaali, n’eggye ery’amaanyi, ne bajja mu kiro ne bazingiza ekibuga.

Omuweereza ow’omusajja wa Katonda bwe yazuukuka ku makya n’afuluma ebweru, laba, eggye eririna embalaasi, n’amagaali nga lyetoolodde ekibuga. Omuweereza n’ayogerera waggulu nti, “Ayi mukama wange tunaakola tutya?”

Nnabbi n’addamu nti, “Totya kubanga abali naffe bangi okusinga abali nabo.” Awo Erisa n’asaba ng’agamba nti, “Ayi Mukama, zibula amaaso ge asobole okulaba.” Amangwago Mukama n’azibula amaaso ag’omuweereza, laba ng’ensozi zijjudde embalaasi n’amagaali ag’omuliro nga geetoolodde Erisa.” (2 Bassekabaka 6:14-17) Kuno kwe kusaba kwe twetaaga okwesabira ffe bennyini n’okusabiragana: “Ayi Mukama, zibula amaaso gaffe tulabe.” Kubanga ensi etwetoolodde ku buli ludda ejjudde embalaasi n’amagaali ga Katonda, nga galindiridde okututwala mu bifo eby’obuwanguzi obw’ekitiibwa. Naye tegafaanana ng’amagaali. Wabula gafaanana ng’abalabe, okubonaabona, ebigezo, okuwangulwa, okutategeerwa, okuggwaamu essuubi, n’obutali kisa. Gafaanana ng’ebigaali ebinene eby’ennaku ebirindiridde okutubetenta. Naye ddala magaali ga buwanguzi. Gasobola okututwala ku ntikko z’obuwanguzi emyoyo gyaffe ze gyegomba.

Bwe tuba twagala okutambulira “mu bifo by’ensi ebya waggulu,” tuteekwa okulinnya mu magaali agasobola okututwalayo; era “amagaali ga Katonda” gokka ge gasobola okututwala mu lugendo olw’ebugulumivu bwe lutyo. (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 32:12-13) “Mukama Katonda yekka ye yamukulemberanga; so tewabangawo katonda mulala. Yamuteeka ku ntikko z’ensozi ez’ensi eyo, n’amuliisanga ku bibala by’omu nnimiro. Yamukulizanga ku mubisi gw’enjuki ogw’omu njatika z’enjazi n’amafuta agaavanga mu mayinja amagumu.”

“awo olifuna essanyu eriva eri Mukama era olitambulira mu bifo by’ensi ebya waggulu era ndikuwa obusika bwa kitaawo Yakobo” Akamwa ka Mukama ke kakyogedde. (Isaaya 58:14).

Buli kintu ekibaawo mu bulamu bwaffe tuyinza okukifuula oba ekigaali kya Juggernaut ekitubetenta, oba eggaali lye twebagalamu okutuuka ku ntikko z’obuwanguzi. Byonna bisinziira ku ngeri gye tubitwalamu: oba nga tugalamira wansi w’ebigezo byaffe ne tubireka okutuyitako ne bitubetenta, oba nga tubirinnyamu nga bwe tulinnya mu ggaali, ne tubireka okututwala nga tuwangula, nga tweyongerayo mu maaso era waggulu.

“Awo bwe baali batambula nga bwe banyumya bokka na bokka, ne walabika eggaali ey’omuliro n’embalaasi ez’omuliro ne zibaawula, era mu kiseera kye kimu Eriya n’atwalibwa mu ggulu mu mbuyaga ey’amaanyi. Awo Erisa bwe yalaba ekyo, n’ayogerera waggulu nti, “Kitange, Kitange, amagaali n’abeebagala embalaasi aba Isirayiri!” Erisa n’ataddamu kumulaba nate. N’addira engoye ze yali ayambadde, n’aziyuzaayuza.” (2 Bassekabaka 2:11-12). Buli lwe tulinnya mu magaali ga Katonda, ekyo kyennyini ekyatuuka ku Eriya kitutuukako mu mwoyo. Tujja kusitulibwa. Si mu ggulu eriri waggulu waffe nga Eriya bwe yasitulibwa, wabula mu ggulu eriri munda mu ffe, era okusitulibwa okwo, bwe tukirowoozako obulungi, kumpi kwa kitiibwa okusinga okukwe. Tujja kusitulibwa okuva mu bulamu obwa wansi obw’ensi obw’okwekulukuunya mu nfuufu, nga buli kimu kiruma era nga buli kimu kya nnaku, okutwalibwa waggulu “mu bifo eby’omu ggulu, okumpi ne Kristo Yesu,” gye tunaatambulira nga tuwangula byonna ebiri wansi.

“Katonda yatuzuukiriza wamu ne Kristo okuva mu kufa ne tufuna obulamu, era atutuuzizza mu bifo eby’omu ggulu, okumpi ne Kristo Yesu.” (Abaefeso 2:6). Ebifo bino “eby’omu ggulu” biri munda, si bweru, era n’ekkubo eribituukako nalyo liri munda.

Naye eggaali erisitula emmeeme ku kkubo lino emirundi mingi liba kufiirwa okumu okw’ebweru, oba ekigezo, oba okuggwaamu essuubi; okukangavvulwa okumu okutafaanana mu biro ebya kaakano nga kwa ssanyu, wabula kwa bulumi; naye oluvannyuma ne kuleeta ebibala eby’emirembe eri abo abayigirizibwa, era ekivaamu bwe butuukirivu.

“Mwerabidde ebigambo ebizzaamu amaanyi byayogera nammwe ng’abaana be? Agamba nti, “Mwana wange, tonyoomanga kukangavvulwa kwa Mukama, so toggwangamu maanyi ng’akunenyezza. Kubanga Mukama gw’ayagala amukangavvula, Era abonereza buli gw’ayita omwana we.” Noolwekyo mugumiikirize okukangavvulwa, kubanga Katonda abakangavvula ng’abaana be. Mwana ki kitaawe gw’atakangavvula? Naye singa temukangavvulwa, nga bwe kitugwanira ffenna, muba temuli baana be ddala. Kale, nga bwe mussaamu ekitiibwa bakitaffe ab’omubiri, newaakubadde nga batukangavvula, nga batuyigiriza, kitaawe w’emyoyo talisinga nnyo okutukangavvula ne tuba abalamu? Bakitaffe ab’omubiri baatugunjulira ennaku si nnyingi, naye ye atugunjula tugasibwe tulyoke tusobole okugabanira awamu naye mu butukuvu bwe. Okukangavvulwa kwonna mu biro ebya kaakano tekufaanana nga kwa ssanyu, kuba kwa bulumi, naye oluvannyuma kuleeta ebibala eby’emirembe eri abo abayigirizibwa, era ekivaamu bwe butuukirivu.” (Abaebbulaniya 12:5-11).

Okunenya kuno, ne bwe kuba kwa bulumi kutya mu kiseera kino, mukutunuulire ng’amagaali ga Katonda agaweerezeddwa okutwala emyoyo gyammwe mu “bifo ebya waggulu” eby’okukula n’okuyimusibwa mu mwoyo, era mujja kukizuula nti, bwe kituuka ku nkomerero, munda “mwaliire bulungi n’okwagala.”

“Kabaka Sulemaani yeekolera ekigaali eky’emiti egy’omu Lebanooni. Empagi zaakyo yazisiigako ffeeza, ne wansi waakyo nga wa zaabu, n’entebe yaamu ng’eriko olugoye lwa ffulungu; ne munda nga mwaliire bulungi n’okwagala, okw’abawala ba Yerusaalemi.” (Oluyimba 3:9-10). Eggaali lyo ggwe ku bubwo liyinza okulabika nga teririna bulungi n’akatono. Liyinza okuba muganda wo oba mukwano gwo ow’empisa enkakanyavu; liyinza okuba nga liva mu bukyayi bw’abantu, oba mu bukambwe, oba mu kulagajjalirwa; naye buli ggaali Katonda ly’asindika liteekwa okuba nga munda mwaliire n’okwagala, kubanga Katonda kwagala, era okwagala kwa Katonda kye kintu ekisinga obuwoomi, obugonvu n’okusaasira omuntu ky’ayinza okwesigamako, ekyali kizuuliddwa emmeeme yonna wonna wonna. Mazima ddala okwagala kwe kwe kusindika eggaali.

“Ayi Mukama, wanyiigira emigga? Obusungu bwo bwali ku bugga obutono? Wanyiigira ennyanja bwe weebagala embalaasi zo, n’olinnya ku magaali go ag’obuwanguzi? Wasowolayo akasaale ko, wategeka okulasa obusaale; ensi n’ogyawulayawulamu n’emigga. Ensozi zaakulaba, ne zeenyogootola; Amataba ne gayitawo mbiro, obuziba bw’ennyanja ne buwuluguma, ne busitula amayengo gaayo waggulu. Enjuba n’omwezi ne biyimirira butengerera mu bifo byabyo, olw’okumyansa kw’obusaale bwo nga buwenyuka, n’olw’okumyansa kw’effumu lyo eritemagana. Watambula okuyita mu nsi ng’ojjudde ekiruyi, wasambirirasambirira amawanga mu busungu bwo. Wavaayo oleetere abantu bo obulokozi, olokole gwe wafukako amafuta. (Kaabakuuku 3:8-13) Wano nnabbi atubuulira nti obusungu bwa Katonda eri ebiziyiza ebyali bizingizza ekkubo ly’abantu be bwe bwamuleeta okubadduukirira, ng’alinnye ku “magaali ge ag’obulokozi.” Buli kintu kifuuka “eggaali ery’obulokozi” Katonda bw’akyebagala. “Ebire” ebiddugaza eggulu lyaffe era ebirabika ng’ebiziyiza okwaka kw’enjuba ey’obutuukirivu, mu mazima, singa twali tumanyi, ge magaali ge, ge tuyinza okulinnyamu wamu naye, ne “tweebagala nga tuwangula” waggulu w’ekizikiza kyonna.

“Weesibe ekitala kyo, Ayi ggwe ow’amaanyi, yambala ekitiibwa kyo n’obukulu bwo! Weebagale embalaasi yo mu kitiibwa kyo eky’obuwanguzi, ng’olwanirira amazima, obuwombeefu, n’obutuukirivu. Omukono gwo ogwa ddyo gukole ebyewuunyisa.” (Zabbuli 45:3-4). “Yeebagala kerubi n’abuuka, n’aseeyeeyeza ku biwaawaatiro by’empewo.” (Zabbuli 18:10). “Tewali afaanana nga Katonda wa Yesuluuni eyeebagala waggulu ku ggulu ng’ajja okukuyamba ne ku bire mu kitiibwa kye.” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 33:26). Omuwandiisi omu ow’omu biro ebitali bya wala yagamba nti tetuyinza, ne bwe tufuba ennyo n’amaanyi gaffe gonna, okusaanyaawo ebire, naye tusobola okulinnya waggulu ennyo ne tubisukka ne tutuuka mu bbanga ettangaavu eriri waggulu; era oyo eyeebagala wamu ne Katonda yeebagala ku ggulu, waggulu nnyo w’ebire byonna ebiva mu nsi.

“Muyimbire Katonda mmwe obwakabaka obw’ensi zonna. Mutendereze Mukama. Oyo eyeebagala eggulu erya waggulu ery’edda, eddoboozi lye ery’amaanyi liwuluguma okuva mu ggulu. Mulangirire obuyinza bwa Katonda, ekitiibwa kye kibuutikidde Isirayiri; obuyinza bwe buli mu bire.” (Zabbuli 68:32-34). Kino kiyinza okuwulikika ng’ekirooto obulooto, naye ddala kya mugaso nnyo bwe tutandika okukikolera mu bulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku.

Nnamanya omukyala eyalina omuweereza omukozi eyali alwawo ennyo mu by’akola. Yali mulungi mu buli ngeri era wa mugaso nnyo. Naye okulwawo kwe kwanyiizanga mukama we omukazi, eyali omwangu mu buzaaliranwa bwe.

Omukyala oyo yanyiigiranga omuwala oyo emirundi amakumi abiri buli lunaku. Era emirundi amakumi abiri yejjusanga n’agezaako okufuga obusungu bwe. Naye byali bya bwereere. Obulamu bwe bwafuuka bwa nnaku olw’olutalo olwo. Lumu n’ajjukira nti abadde amaze ebbanga ddene ng’asaba obugumiikiriza. Oboolyawo omuweereza ono alwawo ye yali eggaali lyennyini Mukama lye yali amuweerezza okutwala emmeeme ye mu bugumiikiriza. Amangu ago n’akikkiriza bwe kityo, era okuva olwo n’akozesa okulwawo kw’omuweereza we ng’eggaali ly’emmeeme ye. Ekyavaamu bwe bwali obuwanguzi obw’obugumiikiriza obutaasobola kutabulwa kulwawo kwa muntu yenna.

Mu lumu ku nkuŋŋaana zaffe, nnamanya mwannyinaffe eyalina okwebaka mu kisenge kimu n’abalala babiri olw’abantu abangi. Yali ayagala kwebaka, naye bo baali baagala kunyumya. Ekiro ekisooka, yatabulwa. Yagalamira awo ng’awulira obunyiikaavu n’obutali mirembe, okumala ebbanga ddene ng’abalala baasirise dda. Yandisobodde okwebaka. Naye olunaku olwaddako, n’awulira ku magaali ga Katonda. Ekiro ekyo, n’asalawo okutwala bannyinaffe abo abanyumya ng’amagaali ge.

Baali ba kumuyamba okuyiga obuwoomerevu n’obugumiikiriza. Yagalamira awo ng’alina emirembe era ng’akkakkamu. Naye ekiro ne kiwanvuwa nnyo, era bonna bandibadde beebase dda. Awo n’ayogera mpola nti, “Baganda bange, ngalamidde wano nga nneebagadde eggaali.” Kino ne kireeta akasiriikiriro akajjuvu. Eggaali lye lyali limutuusizza ku buwanguzi, munda ne ebweru.

Singa tusalawo okwebagala amagaali ga Katonda, so si gaffe ffe, twandifunye ekintu kye kimu.

“Zibasanze abo abaserengeta e Misiri okuyambibwa, abeesiga embalaasi, abeesiga amagaali gaabwe amangi, abeesiga amaanyi amangi ag’abeebagala embalaasi ne batatunuulira Omutukuvu wa Isirayiri wadde okunoonya obuyambi bwa Mukama. Kyokka Mukama mugezi era asobola okuleeta akabi; tajjulula bigambo bye. Aligolokokera ku nnyumba y’abatali batuukirivu, ne ku abo abayamba abakozi b’ebibi. Naye Abamisiri bantu buntu si Katonda n’embalaasi zaabwe mibiri bubiri. Katonda bw’agolola omukono gwe oyo ayamba, alyesittala, n’oyo ayambibwa aligwa era bombi balizikiririra wamu. (Isaaya 31:1-3) “Abamu beesiga amagaali, n’abalala beesiga embalaasi, naye ffe twesiga erinnya lya Mukama Katonda waffe. Batalantuka ne bagwa wansi ne balemerawo, naye ffe tugolokoka ne tuyimirira nga tuli banywevu.” (Zabbuli 20:7-8). Okukemebwa kwaffe okw’olutentezi kwe kwesiga “amagaali ga Misiri.” Tusobola okugalaba. Ga ddala era galabika nga manywevu. Naye amagaali ga Katonda tegalabika era tegakwatibwako. Kizibu okukkiriza nti galiwo. Amaaso gaffe tegazibuddwa kugalaba.

“Ojereze Mukama ng’oyita mu babaka bo. Era ogambye nti, “Nninye ku ntikko z’ensozi n’amagaali gange amangi, ku ntikko ezisingirayo ddala obuwanvu eza Lebanooni. Ntemye emivule egisingirayo ddala obuwanvu n’emiberosi gyayo egisingirayo ddala obulungi. Ntuuse ne mu bifo ebisingirayo ddala okuba ebikusike ne mu bibira ebisingirayo ddala okuba ebirungi.” Tugezaako okutuuka mu bifo ebya waggulu nga tukozesa “amagaali gaffe amangi.” Tusooka kwesigama ku kintu kimu, ate oluvannyuma ku kirala. Kino tukikola okulongoosa omwoyo gwaffe n’okufuna obuwanguzi obw’omwoyo. “Tuserengeta e Misiri okuyambibwa.” (2 Bassekabaka 19:23).

Era emirundi mingi Katonda kimwetaagisa okuzikiriza amagaali gaffe gonna, alyoke atutuuse ku kulinnya mu ge.

“Ku lunaku olwo,” bw’ayogera Mukama, “Ndizikiriza embalaasi zo ne nsanyaawo n’amagaali go.” (Mikka 5:10). “Ndisulika entebe ez’obwakabaka ne nzigyawo obuyinza bw’obwakabaka obunnaggwanga. Ndiwamba amagaali n’abavuzi baago, n’embalaasi na buli abazeebagala, balittibwa baganda baabwe.” (Kaggayi 2:22). Twesigama nnyo ku mukwano gwaffe omwagalwa okutuyamba okukula mu mwoyo. Kale Mukama ateekwa okutwawula ku mukwano oyo. Tukkiriza nti okukula kwaffe mu mwoyo kwesigamye ku buweereza bw’omubuulizi gwe tusinga okwagala. Kaakano ffe tuggibwawo mu ngeri ey’ekyama. Olukuŋŋaana lwaffe olw’okusaba oba ekibiina kyaffe eky’okusoma Bayibuli tukitwala ng’ensibuko yaffe enkulu ey’amaanyi ag’omwoyo. Kaakano tetukyasobola kukibaamu. Era “eggaali lya Katonda,” lyokka eriyinza okututwala mu bifo bye twali tusuubira okututwalibwamu ebyo bye twali twesigamyeko, lisangibwa mu kufiirwa kwennyini kwe twakungubagira ennyo. Katonda ateekwa okwokya n’omuliro gw’okwagala kwe buli ggaali lyaffe eriyimiridde mu kkubo ne litulemesa okulinnya mu lirye.

“Kubanga laba Mukama Katonda alijjira mu muliro, era n’amagaali ge ag’embalaasi galiba ng’empewo ey’omuyaga. Alijja n’obusungu bwe n’ekiruyi era alibanenya n’ennimi ez’omuliro.” (Isaaya 66:15). Kale tweyanzenga olwa buli kigezo ekinaayamba okuzikiriza amagaali gaffe, era ekinaatuwaliriza okuddukira mu ggaali lya Katonda, eriyimiridde nga lyetegese era nga litulindiridde ku lusegere lwaffe.

“Emmeeme yange ewummulire mu Katonda yekka; kubanga mu ye mwe muli essuubi lyange. Ye yekka lwe lwazi lwange era bwe bulokozi bwange, ye kye kigo kyange, siinyeenyezebwenga. Okulokolebwa kwange n’ekitiibwa kyange biri mu Katonda yekka; ye lwe lwazi lwange olw’amaanyi era kye kiddukiro kyange. Mumwesigenga bulijjo mmwe abantu, mumutegeezenga byonna ebiri mu mitima gyammwe, kubanga Katonda kye kiddukiro kyaffe.” (Zabbuli 62:5-8). Tuteekwa okutuusibwa mu kifo ebiddukiro ebirala byonna we bitulemera, nga tetunnasobola kugamba nti, Ye yekka. Tugamba nti, Ye n’ekintu ekirala.

“Ye n’obumanyirivu bwange,” oba “Ye n’enkolagana yange n’ekkanisa,” oba “Ye n’omulimu gwange ogw’Ekikristaayo”; era byonna ebijja oluvannyuma lwa “ne” biteekwa okutuggibwako, oba okukakasibwa nti tebiriiko kye bigasa, nga tetunnatuuka ku “Ye yekka.”” Amagaali agalabika bwe gaba nga gakyali kumpi, emmeeme tejja kulinnya mu agatalabika.

“Muyimbire Katonda, muyimbe nga mutendereza erinnya lye; mumuyimusize amaloboozi gammwe oyo atambulira mu bire. Erinnya lye ye Mukama, mujagulize mu maaso ge.” (Zabbuli 68:4). Bwe tuba twagala okwebagala wamu ne Katonda “waggulu ku ggulu,” tuteekwa okutuusibwa ku nkomerero y’okwebagala kwonna ku nsi.

“Ekibiina kyo ky’okulembedde bakirabye, Ayi Katonda, balabye abali ne Katonda wange, era Kabaka wange, ng’otambula okugenda mu watukuvu.” (Zabbuli

68:24). Okulaba entambula ya Katonda, tuteekwa okuyingira mu watukuvu w’okubeerawo kwe; era okugabana ku ntambula ye n’okutambula naye, tuteekwa okuleka entambula zonna ez’ensi.

“Amakubo g’omuntu gategekebwa Mukama, omuntu ayinza atya okutegeera ekkubo lya Mukama?” (Engero 20:24). “Nnyweredde mu makubo go, era ebigere byange tebiigalekenga.” (Zabbuli 17:5).

“Nalindirira Mukama n’obugumiikiriza, n’antegera okutu, n’awulira okukoowoola kwange.” (Zabbuli 40:1). Bwe tulinnya mu ggaali lya Katonda, entambula yaffe “enywezebwa,” kubanga tewali kiziyiza kiyinza kulemesa lugendo lwalyo olw’obuwanguzi. N’olwekyo okufiirwa kwonna okututuusa ku kino magoba.

“Naye ebyo byonna ebyali omugabo gye ndi, nabiraba nga butaliimu. Naye okusinga byonna, byonna mbiraba ng’okufiirwa, kubanga okutegeera Kristo Yesu Mukama wange, kusinga ebirala byonna. Olwa Kristo nafiirwa ebintu byonna, era mbiraba ng’ebisasiro, ndyoke ngobolole Kristo, ndabikire mu ye nga sirina butuukirivu bwange ku bwange obuva mu kukwata amateeka, wabula nga nnina obutuukirivu obuva mu kukkiriza Kristo, era obuva eri Katonda obwesigamye ku kukkiriza.” (Abafiripi 3:7-9). Pawulo kino yakitegeera, era yeenyumiririzanga mu kufiirwa okwamuleetera amagoba ag’ekitalo agatayogerekeka.

“okusingira ddala okubikkulirwa kwe nafuna. Noolwekyo olw’obutagulumizibwa nnyo, kyenava nfumitibwa eriggwa mu mubiri, ye mubaka wa Setaani, ankube nneme okugulumizibwa ennyo. Emirundi esatu egy’enjawulo nga nsaba Mukama amponye eriggwa eryo. Buli mulundi ng’aŋŋamba nti, “Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu.” Noolwekyo kyennaavanga nneegulumiza n’essanyu lingi olw’obunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke galabisibwe. Kyenva nsanyukira mu bunafu, mu kuvumibwa, mu bizibu, mu kuyigganyizibwa, mu binzitoowerera, ku lwa Kristo, kubanga buli bwe mba omunafu, olwo nga ndi wa maanyi.” (2 Abakkolinso 12:7-10) Ne “eriggwa mu mubiri,” omubaka wa Setaani eyaweerezebwa okumutawaanya, nalyo lyafuuka eggaali eri omutima gwe ogwali gwetegefu, ne limutwala ku buwanguzi bwe yali tayinza kutuukako mu ngeri ndala. Omuntu “okusanyukira” ebimubonyaabonya — ekyo kiki bwe kitaba kubifuula magaali agasinga obukulu?

Yusufu yaloota ku buwanguzi bwe obw’omu maaso n’obufuzi bwe. Naye mu maaso ag’omubiri, amagaali agaamutwalayo gaali okulemererwa okukaawa. Lyali kkubo lya kyewuunyo eridda mu bwakabaka. Lyayita mu buddu ne mu kkomera. Naye tewaali kkubo ddala Yusufu lye yandiyiseemu okutuuka ku buwanguzi bwe. Ekirooto kye, Olubereberye 37:5-10 “Lumu Yusufu n’aloota ekirooto, n’agenda n’akitegeeza baganda be, ne beeyongera nnyo okumukyawa. Yabagamba nti, “Muwulire ekirooto kino kye naloose. Twali tusiba ebinywa by’eŋŋaano nga tuli mu nnimiro, ekinywa kyange ne kiyimuka ne kiyimirira; laba ebinywa byammwe ne bikyebungulula ne bikivuunamira.” Baganda be ne bamugamba nti, “Olowooza olitufuga? Olowooleza ddala nti tulibeera baddu bo?” Olwo ne beeyongera nnyo okumukyayira ddala olw’ekirooto kye n’ebigambo bye. Ate n’aloota ekirooto ekirala n’akitegeeza baganda be, n’agamba nti, “Ndoose ekirooto ekirala: ne ndaba enjuba n’omwezi n’emmunyeenye ekkumi n’emu nga binvuunamira.” Naye bwe yakitegeeza kitaawe ng’ali wamu ne baganda be, kitaawe n’amunenya ng’agamba nti, “Kirooto ki kino ky’oloose? Ddala nze ne nnyoko awamu ne baganda bo tulijja ne tuvuunama mu maaso go?””

Amagaali ge, Olubereberye 37:19-20 “Ne bagambagana nti, “Sekalootera wuuyo ajja. Kale mujje tumutte, tumusuule mu kimu ku binnya; tuligamba nti, ‘Ensolo enkambwe ye yamulya; tulabe ebirooto bye bwe birituukirira.’ ” Olubereberye 27:28 “Katonda akuwe omusulo ogw’omu ggulu, n’obugimu bw’ensi, era akuwe emmere ey’empeke nnyingi n’envinnyo.” Olubereberye 39:19-20 “Awo mukama wa Yusufu bwe yawulira ebigambo omukazi bye yamutegeeza ng’agamba nti, “Bw’ati ne bw’ati omuddu wo bwe yampisizza,” obusungu bwa bba ne bubuubuuka. Mukama wa Yusufu n’akwata Yusufu n’amuteeka mu kkomera omwasibirwanga abazzizza emisango eri kabaka.” Mukama wa Yusufu n’akwata Yusufu n’amuteeka mu kkomera omwasibirwanga abazzizza emisango eri kabaka; engeri gye yeebagalamu amagaali ge, Olubereberye 39:1-6 “Awo Yusufu bwe yatwalibwa e Misiri, Potifali omukungu wa Falaawo, omukulu w’abambowa Omumisiri n’amugula okuva ku Bayisimayiri abaamutwala e Misiri. Mukama n’aba ne Yusufu n’aba n’omukisa ng’ali mu nnyumba ya mukama we Omumisiri. Ne mukama we n’alaba nga Mukama amuwadde omukisa mu buli ky’akola. Awo Yusufu n’aganja nnyo mu maaso ga mukama we, n’amulabiriranga, n’amufuula omukulu we nnyumba ye ne byonna bye yalina. Okuva olwo Mukama n’awa omukisa ennyumba y’Omumisiri olwa Yusufu. Omukisa gwa Mukama ne guba ku byonna bye yalina, mu nnyumba ne mu nnimiro. Awo Omumisiri n’ateeka byonna mu mikono gya Yusufu. Yusufu n’avunaanyizibwanga byonna okuggyako emmere mukama we gye yalyanga.”

Olubereberye 39:21-23 “Naye Mukama n’abeera ne Yusufu, n’amulaga okwagala kwe okutalojjeka. N’aganja nnyo mu maaso g’omukuumi w’ekkomera. Omukuumi w’ekkomera n’ateeka abasibe bonna mu mikono gya Yusufu, era buli ekyakolebwanga nga Yusufu y’akirinako obuvunaanyizibwa. Omukuumi w’ekkomera nga tafaayo ku buli ekyalinga mu mikono gya Yusufu, kubanga Mukama yali naye.

era Mukama n’amuwa omukisa mu buli kye yakolanga.” Obuwanguzi bwe.

Kaakano ekigambo ku ngeri omuntu gy’ayinza okulinnya mu magaali gano. Eky’okuddamu kyange kyandibadde kino kyokka: Zuula Katonda w’ali mu buli limu ku go, weekweke mu Ye. Oba, mu bigambo ebirala, kola omwana omuto ky’akola ng’ennaku zimutuuseeko: anoonya nnyina ne yeekweka mu mikono gye. Eggaali ery’amazima eritutwala nga tuwangula, bwe tukirowoozako obulungi, kwe kusitula kwa Katonda.

Isaaya 46:4 “Ne mu bukadde bwammwe nzija kusigala nga ye nze Nzuuyo. Ne bwe muliba mulina envi nnaabasitulanga. Nze nabakola era nze nnaabawekanga. Nnaabasitulanga era nnaabanunulanga.” Omwana omuwere asituddwa mu ggaali ly’emikono gya nnyina atambula ng’awangula mu bifo ebisingayo obuzibu, era tamanya na kumanya nti bizibu.

Isaaya 63:9 “Yabonaabonera wamu nabo mu kubonaabona kwabwe kwonna, era malayika ayimirira mu maaso ge n’abawonya. Mu kwagala kwe n’ekisa kye yabanunula; yabayimusa n’abeetikka mu nnaku zonna ez’edda.” Kale ffe, abasitulibwa mu ggaali ery’“emikono gya Katonda,” tetusingawo nnyo! N’olwekyo linnya mu ggaali lyo. Buli kintu ekikyamu mu bulamu bwo kitwale ng’eggaali lya Katonda eri ggwe. Tekifaayo ani eyazimba ekikyamu ekyo, kaakano ggaali lya Katonda eri ggwe. Liteekwa okukutwala mu kifo eky’omu ggulu eky’obuwanguzi. Ggalawo ebivaako eby’okubiri byonna, ozuule Mukama mu kyo. Gamba nti, “Ayi Mukama, zibula amaaso gange ndabe, si mulabe alabika, wabula amagaali go agatalabika ag’okununulwa.”

Kkiriza by’ayagala mu kigezo, ka kibe kya ngeri ki, weekweke mu mikono gye egy’okwagala. Gamba nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe; by’oyagala bikolebwe!” emirundi n’emirundi.

Ggalawo buli kirowoozo kirala kyonna okuggyako ekirowoozo kimu eky’okugondera by’ayagala n’okwesiga okwagala kwe.

Ekigezo kyo kifuule eggaali lyo. Olwo emmeeme yo ejja kwebagala wamu ne Katonda “waggulu ku ggulu” mu ngeri gy’otaloota nti esoboka.

Sirina kubuusabuusa. Singa amaaso gaffe gazibuliddwa, twandirabye amaka gaffe, emirimu gyaffe, n’enguudo zaffe nga bijjudde “amagaali ga Katonda.” Tewali n’omu ku ffe alina kutambula na bigere olw’okubulwa amagaali.

Omuntu oyo ow’omu maka go anyiiga amangu, afudde obulamu bwo omugugu, ayinza okuva kaakano okuba eggaali ery’ekitiibwa.

Lijja kukutwala ku ntikko z’obugumiikiriza obw’omu ggulu n’okugumira ebbanga eddene. Okutategeerwa kwo, okuswazibwa, obutali kisa, okuggwaamu essuubi, okufiirwa, n’okuwangulwa — byonna magaali. Bikulindiridde okukutwala ku ntikko z’obuwanguzi bw’obadde weegomba.

Kale, n’emitima egyebaza, mubirinnyemu. Mwerabire ebivaako eby’okubiri byonna mu kumasamasa kw’okwagala kwe.

Ajja kubasitula mu mikono gye, ng’akakasa obukuumi bwammwe era ng’ajaguza obuwanguzi ku byonna.
fields.body_text: “Mukama ava ku lusozi Sinaayi nga yeetooloddwa amagaali enkumi n’enkumi n’ajja mu kifo kye ekitukuvu. (Zabbuli 68:17.) Amagaali gakozesebwa okutambuza abantu n’okugenda mu maaso. Amagaali ag’ensi gatuusa abagalimu gye balaga, nga gawangula buli kiziyiza. Amagaali ga Katonda gasitula emyoyo. Tewali bigambo biyinza kunnyonnyola bifo bya kitiibwa emmeeme etambulira mu magaali ga Katonda gy’eriituuka. Era olunyiriri lwaffe lutubuulira nti gali “enkumi n’enkumi.” Gatwetoolodde ku buli ludda nga gatulindiridde; naye ffe, eky’ennaku, bulijjo tetugalaba. Amagaali ag’ensi galabika bulijjo, naye amagaali ga Katonda tegalabika. “Amangwago n’asindika embalaasi, n’amagaali, n’eggye ery’amaanyi, ne bajja mu kiro ne bazingiza ekibuga. Omuweereza ow’omusajja wa Katonda bwe yazuukuka ku makya n’afuluma ebweru, laba, eggye eririna embalaasi, n’amagaali nga lyetoolodde ekibuga. Omuweereza n’ayogerera waggulu nti, “Ayi mukama wange tunaakola tutya?” Nnabbi n’addamu nti, “Totya kubanga abali naffe bangi okusinga abali nabo.” Awo Erisa n’asaba ng’agamba nti, “Ayi Mukama, zibula amaaso ge asobole okulaba.” Amangwago Mukama n’azibula amaaso ag’omuweereza, laba ng’ensozi zijjudde embalaasi n’amagaali ag’omuliro nga geetoolodde Erisa.” (2 Bassekabaka 6:14-17) Kuno kwe kusaba kwe twetaaga okwesabira ffe bennyini n’okusabiragana: “Ayi Mukama, zibula amaaso gaffe tulabe.” Kubanga ensi etwetoolodde ku buli ludda ejjudde embalaasi n’amagaali ga Katonda, nga galindiridde okututwala mu bifo eby’obuwanguzi obw’ekitiibwa. Naye tegafaanana ng’amagaali. Wabula gafaanana ng’abalabe, okubonaabona, ebigezo, okuwangulwa, okutategeerwa, okuggwaamu essuubi, n’obutali kisa. Gafaanana ng’ebigaali ebinene eby’ennaku ebirindiridde okutubetenta. Naye ddala magaali ga buwanguzi. Gasobola okututwala ku ntikko z’obuwanguzi emyoyo gyaffe ze gyegomba. Bwe tuba twagala okutambulira “mu bifo by’ensi ebya waggulu,” tuteekwa okulinnya mu magaali agasobola okututwalayo; era “amagaali ga Katonda” gokka ge gasobola okututwala mu lugendo olw’ebugulumivu bwe lutyo. (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 32:12-13) “Mukama Katonda yekka ye yamukulemberanga; so tewabangawo katonda mulala. Yamuteeka ku ntikko z’ensozi ez’ensi eyo, n’amuliisanga ku bibala by’omu nnimiro. Yamukulizanga ku mubisi gw’enjuki ogw’omu njatika z’enjazi n’amafuta agaavanga mu mayinja amagumu.” “awo olifuna essanyu eriva eri Mukama era olitambulira mu bifo by’ensi ebya waggulu era ndikuwa obusika bwa kitaawo Yakobo” Akamwa ka Mukama ke kakyogedde. (Isaaya 58:14). Buli kintu ekibaawo mu bulamu bwaffe tuyinza okukifuula oba ekigaali kya Juggernaut ekitubetenta, oba eggaali lye twebagalamu okutuuka ku ntikko z’obuwanguzi.
